title: Senior Product Manager, PV Commerce & Int'l Product
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Prime Video's vision is to be the world's favorite entertainment brand and the first-choice entertainment hub globally. Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows, movies and live sports, all in one place where it is easy to find what they love to watch. Members can also subscribe to add-on channels (third-party streaming services) and rent new-release movies on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is at the forefront of the entertainment industry and growing fast, now available in 240 countries and territories worldwide. We work in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do.  
  
As a Senior Product Manager for Prime Video in India, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for one of our largest international markets. You will build a deep understanding of local customers, including how they discover content, choose plans and pay. You will turn those insights into products that grow and retain Prime Video customers. You will define what we build and why, write the documents that earn alignment, and partner with regional business teams and worldwide product and engineering teams to launch and scale features. We are looking for a customer-obsessed product manager with a strong track record of shipping products, using data to make decisions, and leading across teams without direct authority.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own the multi-year product vision and roadmap for India and other emerging priority countries, and prioritize investments by customer and business impact.  
  
Write PRFAQs, product requirements and business cases that define the customer problem, the solution and the success metrics.  
  
Partner with engineering, UX, science, and the worldwide Payments, Subscriptions, Personalization and App Experience teams to deliver local features on global platforms.  
  
Design and read experiments (weblabs), and use the results to decide what to launch, iterate on or stop.  
  
Build products that fit local needs, such as local payment methods, plans and pricing, partner bundles and local content discovery.  
  
Report progress, risks and results to senior leadership through regular business reviews.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Master's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products
* Experience leading projects across multiple stakeholders

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Techno-Functional Manager – Field Digital Transformation, Data & AI
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**The Role**

* Act as the bridge between business and technology across several retail divisions
* Own digital products, analytics, customer data and AI end to end
* Understand business needs, shape solutions, and make sure they are delivered and actually used
* Build solutions hands-on or lead vendor teams and interns
* Combine the roles of Business Analyst, Product Owner, Project Manager, Data & BI Lead and AI builder
* Work comfortably across stores, boardrooms and tech reviews

**Key Responsibilities**

* Techno-Functional Manager – Field Digital Transformation, Data & AI**:** Own field-facing digital products end to end to raise sales-force productivity
* **Delivery:** Run roadmap and sprint execution for predictable, high-quality releases
* **Platform Health:** Keep platforms stable and fast, with fresh data and a reliable user experience
* **BI & Analytics:** Build leadership dashboards and KPIs that give trusted, actionable insights
* **AI & Innovation:** Design and build GenAI and agentic solutions that automate work and add business value
* **Data Governance:** Ensure data quality, privacy and compliance for customer master data

**How Success Is Measured**

* Active users %, retention and field CSAT
* Roadmap adherence, sprint predictability and production defects
* Uptime, load time and data freshness
* On-time dashboard delivery, dashboard usage and manual reports retired
* PoC-to-production conversion and measured business impact
* Reconciliation accuracy and compliance adherence
  

**Key Interfaces**

* **External:** Technology vendors, implementation partners, product and platform partners, consulting agencies
* **Internal:** Business teams, sales and field force, marketing, IT and digital, BI and analytics, information security, PMO and leadership, data governance and privacy teams

**Why Join Us**

* Wide scope across products, data, customer master data and AI in several divisions
* Own a business-critical platform used daily by sales teams across India
* Direct visibility with CXO-level leadership
* Build AI that real users adopt, not just presentations
* A fast-track path to larger digital product and AI leadership roles
  

  
  
**Work Experience**  

**Ideal Candidate**

* A high-potential techno-functional professional who bridges business and technology
* Understands application architecture, data and GenAI well enough to design solutions and challenge partners
* Can personally build AI prototypes and connect with field teams to drive adoption

**Education & Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Data Science or a related discipline (MCA or equivalent also considered)
* MBA in Sales, Marketing, Systems or Analytics preferred

**Experience**

* 3–10 years across Product/Project Management, Business Analysis, BI & Analytics, Software Development or Digital Transformation
* Proven delivery of web/mobile applications with development teams, ideally including vendor management
* Hands-on experience building AI/ML or GenAI solutions; production deployment is a strong plus
* Retail, consumer or Sales Force Automation (SFA) exposure preferred

**Must-have Skills**

* **Data & BI:** SQL, Data Modeling, Data Warehousing, Tableau, Power BI
* **AI & GenAI:** Python, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLM), Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents
* **Customer Master Data:** Master Data Management, Data Quality, Data Governance, deduplication
* **Application & Cloud:** AWS, REST APIs, ReactJS, Node.js, Mobile app releases
* **Delivery:** Agile / Scrum, Product Management, Business Analysis, Requirements Management, UAT, Jira, Confluence
* **Functional:** Retail sales KPIs (target vs achievement, footfall, conversion, ATV, UPT, LFL growth)

**Nice-to-have Skills**

* **Data:** dbt, Datastage, Airflow, AWS Glue, Google Analytics (GA4), Mixpanel, CleverTap
* **MDM/CDP tools:** Informatica, Reltio, SAP MDG, Salesforce Data Cloud
* **AI:** LangChain / LangGraph, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, vector databases, machine learning
* **Engineering:** Microservices, serverless, CI/CD
* **Other:** Figma; CSPO/PSPO, PMP, CSM, Tableau or AWS certifications; DPDP Act; CRM / SFA platforms

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Clear communication and storytelling with data, from the store floor to the boardroom
* Stakeholder management and influencing without authority
* Ownership, bias for action and comfort with ambiguity
* Empathy and a field-user-first mindset
* Analytical, data-driven decision making
* Continuous learning and an innovation mindset

**Other Requirements**

* **Languages:** Professional fluency in English and Hindi; knowledge of other Indian regional languages is good to have
* **Travel:** Willingness to travel to stores, field teams and regional offices as needed

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Role Description:

**About the role**
------------------

As a Senior Product Manager in the Pay-in Payment Methods team, you’ll shape and grow payment experiences that help travellers pay in ways that work for them. You’ll lead the launch of alternative and local payment methods in priority markets, and use customer, partner and performance insights to improve our products across Booking.com’s business.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Set the product vision, strategy and roadmap for a complex product area or portfolio, aligning priorities with customer needs and business goals.
* Identify opportunities, build go-to-market plans and lead the launch of new alternative and local payment methods in key markets.
* Monitor product performance, define success and counter-metrics, and use analytics and experimentation to guide decisions and optimise outcomes.
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science and partners across Finance, Risk, Legal, Customer Service and Operations to deliver high-quality products.
* Align teams and senior stakeholders on priorities, dependencies, risks and progress; plan ahead and resolve issues that could affect delivery.
* Translate customer research, feedback and operational insights into clear problems, hypotheses and product improvements.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* 8–10 years of relevant product management experience and a bachelor’s or master’s degree.
* Experience setting product strategy and delivering complex products or portfolios from discovery through launch and optimisation.
* Strong analytical judgement: you can define meaningful metrics, assess experiments and turn complex data into clear decisions.
* A customer-focused approach, with experience using research and feedback to identify needs and validate solutions.
* The ability to work through technical and organisational complexity, manage cross-team dependencies and influence without relying on formal authority.
* Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to build alignment across teams and with senior leaders.

You’ll thrive in this role if you combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, and can bring diverse teams together around measurable outcomes.

title: Product Leader / Product Manager -SDS2
description:
**Company Description**

The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.

 **Job Description**

What we are looking for

We are hiring a **Product Manager for SDS2** who combines strong product-management fundamentals with practical understanding of **structural steel fabrication, detailing, or manufacturing**. This is not intended to be a general-purpose software PM role.

The ideal candidate understands how engineering software fits into real fabrication workflows and has an **AI-first mindset**, actively looking for ways AI can improve detailing, automation, decision-making, user productivity, and the way we build products.

Industry & Technical Background

* Strong experience with **structural steel fabrication, steel detailing, manufacturing, or closely related industrial engineering workflows**
* Ability to communicate credibly with detailers, fabricators, engineers, developers, and customers
* Bachelor's degree in **engineering, architecture, or a closely related technical field**
* Understanding of complex engineering/manufacturing workflows and the ability to translate them into software requirements

Product Management

* Ideally **5+ years of Product Management / Product Ownership experience**, preferably with AEC, engineering, manufacturing, or technical B2B software
* Demonstrated ownership of:
  + Product vision and roadmap
  + Customer discovery and requirements
  + Epics and backlog prioritization
  + Agile product development
  + Product lifecycle
  + Market and competitive analysis
  + Product launches / GTM
  + Product metrics and business outcomes
* Strong project-management capability across distributed, cross-functional teams
* Excellent written, verbal, and customer-facing communication skills
* Comfortable working directly with Engineering, UX, Sales, Support, Marketing, customers, and senior leadership.
* **Jira** for requirements, epics, backlog, and Agile development
* **Basecamp** for project/program coordination
* Customer-facing product discovery
* Structural engineering knowledge
* Fabrication shop experience
* BIM / digital fabrication workflows
* APIs, interoperability, or integrations
* Enterprise B2B software experience
* Data-driven product management

AI-First Mindset

We want someone who views **AI as a fundamental part of the future of SDS2**, not simply another feature.

Look for candidates who:

* Routinely use AI tools in their own work
* Understand practical applications of **AI/ML, copilots, agents, automation, or intelligent workflows**
* Can identify repetitive or knowledge-intensive detailing tasks that could be automated or augmented
* Can translate AI opportunities into customer problems, workflows, requirements, and measurable outcomes
* Are curious and willing to experiment rather than waiting for established industry solutions

Direct AI product experience is highly desirable but should **not outweigh steel-industry/domain knowledge**.

Strong Differentiators

Experience with one or more of the following should move a candidate **significantly higher in the recruiting funnel**:

**Steel / Detailing Software**

* SDS2
* Tekla Structures
* Advance Steel
* Bocad
* ProSteel
* Other structural steel detailing / fabrication systems

**Engineering / Manufacturing Software**

* SolidWorks
* Autodesk Inventor
* Creo
* CATIA
* Bentley engineering products
* Other CAD/CAM/CAE, BIM, PLM, or fabrication software

  
**Additional Information**

title: R&D Data Product Manager
description:
Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com (https://www.astellas.com/en)
  
Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?
  
We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

**Purpose and Scope:**

The R&D Domain Data Product Manager develops recommendations for and activates the approved data product strategy for an assigned biopharma R&D domain. Working with the Data Domain Owner and scientific, clinical, data, architecture, governance, engineering and platform stakeholders, the role identifies high-value user and business needs and translates them into a coherent portfolio of reusable data products. It establishes proposed product boundaries, value hypotheses and roadmaps, incorporates quality and governance expectations defined with data stewards and relevant specialists, and recommends investment priorities for approval by the Data Domain Owner.
  
The role owns domain-level product discovery, portfolio prioritization recommendations, product mobilization and cross-product dependency management within approved priorities and investment guardrails. It coordinates validation of scientific relevance and consumer needs with scientific and clinical stakeholders; technical feasibility and interoperability with architecture, modeling, engineering and platform teams; and quality, governance, privacy and analytical and AI-use readiness with data stewards, governance specialists and relevant privacy and technical authorities. Once a product is approved and sufficiently defined, detailed delivery and lifecycle accountability transitions to a designated Data Product Owner. The Domain Data Product Manager retains responsibility for domain-wide portfolio coherence, cross-product dependencies, portfolio-level value tracking, identification of reuse opportunities and alignment with the approved domain strategy.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Partner with the Data Domain Owner to translate domain outcomes, use cases, investment priorities, and OKRs into a clear domain data product vision, roadmap, and strategic backlog.
* Establish and continuously refine a prioritized domain backlog covering candidate data products, domain blueprint work, source dependencies, data contracts, governance needs, and enabling platform capabilities.
* Work with the Domain Data Architect and Domain Data Modelers to develop and maintain the domain blueprint, product decomposition, canonical/semantic modeling priorities, interoperability needs, and reusable architecture patterns.
* Facilitate use-case decomposition into required data products, MVP boundaries, capabilities, sequencing, business value hypotheses, and measurable success criteria.
* Coordinate demand intake, opportunity evaluation, value/effort prioritization, dependency mapping, and escalation of cross-domain or platform constraints; make trade-offs transparent to the Domain Owner.
* Maintain a consolidated view of domain initiatives, product status, backlog readiness, delivery milestones, capacity assumptions, risks, decisions, and strategic dependencies.
* Engage the Foundation Data Platform team to align on source availability, ingestion needs, technical readiness, shared standards, and planned capability changes without taking ownership of platform engineering.
* Partner with Data Governance Specialists and stewards to embed ownership, business glossary, metadata, data quality, lineage, contract, certification, privacy, and AI-readiness expectations into domain planning.
* Define product initiation and handoff criteria; identify and onboard the accountable Data Product Owner before detailed product delivery begins.
* Transition each approved product's delivery backlog, acceptance criteria, releases, consumer engagement, adoption, and ongoing lifecycle management to its Data Product Owner; provide portfolio-level coordination thereafter.
* Facilitate domain planning, backlog refinement, roadmap reviews and cross-team dependency forums with Core and Value Teams.
* Serve as Value Team (VT) captain to align team objectives with approved domain priorities, facilitate planning and progress reviews, coordinate commitments and dependencies, and escalate risks and decisions.
* Where assigned, perform Scrum Master responsibilities, including facilitating Scrum events, supporting impediment resolution, coaching the team in Scrum practices and enabling continuous improvement.
* Monitor domain-level business value, roadmap progress, adoption, reuse, and bottlenecks; recommend adjustments and improvements to the operating model and ways of working.
* Support cross-domain alignment and portfolio scaling while preserving the Data Domain Owner's authority over outcomes, investments, and major prioritization decisions.
* When required, provide Business Analyst (BA) support during discovery and mobilization by eliciting user needs, analyzing business processes, and developing requirements, user stories and initial acceptance criteria with stakeholders and the designated Data Product Owner.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in information systems, Data Science, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
* Seven or more years of relevant experience, including at least three years directly defining or managing data, analytics, platform, scientific-informatics or AI-enabled products
* Demonstrated experience translating business outcomes and use cases into roadmaps, strategic backlogs, product definitions, and phased delivery plans.
* Experience facilitating prioritization, managing cross-team dependencies, and coordinating stakeholders across business, architecture, governance, platform, and engineering teams.
* Understanding of domain-oriented data products, data contracts, canonical models, metadata, governance, and medallion architecture.
* Working knowledge of scientific and regulated-data principles, including provenance, traceability, FAIR practices, privacy by design and, where applicable, GxP and ALCOA+ expectations.
* Strong facilitation, communication, executive storytelling, negotiation, and Agile/product delivery skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Broader experience across multiple pharmaceutical or biotechnology R&D functions and data domains.[MCR7.1]
* Experience with scientific, clinical, operational, safety or regulatory data products and AI-enabled R&D use cases.
* Experience with federated or data-mesh operating models, domain blueprints, product certification and enterprise governance.
* Familiarity with Databricks, Unity Catalog, Jira or Azure DevOps, metadata and catalog platforms, product analytics, SQL or business-intelligence tools.
* Experience defining responsible-AI, model-evaluation, data-suitability or AI-observability requirements in regulated or high-impact settings.
* Experience incorporating privacy, security, cross-border data-use constraints and purpose-based access requirements into global data-product planning.
* Experience leading global, geographically distributed teams and organizational change.

**What awaits you at Astellas?**

**Global collaboration:** Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.

**Real-world patient impact** : Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.

**Relentless Innovation:** Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.

**A Culture of Growth** : Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

**Values** : Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

**Behaviors** : We come together as ‘One Astellas, working with courage and a sense of urgency . We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

"Beware of recruitment scams impersonating Astellas recruiters or representatives. Authentic communication will only originate from an official Astellas LinkedIn profile or a verified company email address. If you encounter a fake profile or anything suspicious, report it promptly to LinkedIn's support team through LinkedIn Help”

title: Sr. Product Manager, IN Prime
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Sr. Product Manager, IN Prime Acquisitions  
  
How often have you had an opportunity to build the acquisition growth engine for Prime - one of the largest and loved subscription programs in India? We are looking for someone who is passionate and obsessed about customers, understands their needs and is looking for opportunities to build world class products that will help customers join Prime and get the best of benefits across shopping, shipping, entertainment, music and more. If you are someone who thrives in ambiguity, and balances dive deep with high judgement, looking around the corners to invent around constraints - we have the role for you. The Senior Product Manager for India Prime Acquisitions will manage and define the end to end roadmap of who, how and when we upsell Prime to customers on the Amazon app. Not only will the role play a defining role in devising the growth strategy for Prime in India, the role is expected to influence other worldwide locales with worldwide first innovations.

title: Staff Product Manager, Time & Attendance
description:
**Overview**
------------

**Overview**

Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. However, the stakes are high, as 1 in 2 businesses will fail to survive within their first five years. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.

Within QuickBooks, our Workforce platform fuels productivity for growing teams — from time tracking and scheduling to project management and field operations. With 30M+ employees in the QuickBooks ecosystem and 18M paid through Workforce Solutions, we are building the essential tools that empower frontline teams and help businesses turn time into money.

**Opportunity**

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.

We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.

**Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* **Vertical Strategy.** Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
* **Time to Payroll.** Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees.
* **Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals.** Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
* **Worker Time Tracking.** Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.
* **Commercial Impact.** Own the metrics for your area: Time adoption within Workforce Premium and Elite offerings, attached in mid-market and industry editions. Plus worker engagement across web, kiosk, and mobile. Use data and customer evidence to prioritize, measure what ships, and make Time and real-time job costing a central part of how QuickBooks is sold to construction and field services customers, a market where competitors generate $150M+ ARR.
* **Operational Velocity.** Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: write crisp requirements, pressure-test designs, manage edge cases, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and customer success teams in the US and India. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you are fluent in AI-native tools like Claude and Cursor, using them to move faster from insight to shipped product.
* **Customer Empathy.** Be the voice of the business owner, the payroll admin, and the frontline worker. Spend time with customers on their job sites and with the accountants who recommend HCM products to their clients, and make sure every feature removes a real pain point in how they bid, schedule, track, pay, and get paid.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* **A Product Leader.** 8+ years of product management craft, including ownership of a complex, multi-team product area as a senior individual contributor. You have a proven track record of building and scaling customer-facing products in HCM, workforce management, construction or field service software, or fintech.
* **Strategic & Influential.** You possess strong executive presence, translating market and customer insight into a strategy and roadmap that align senior stakeholders and technical teams. You make bold bets and bring partner teams along without direct authority.
* **Domain Depth.** You understand how labor-intensive businesses run: how hours become payroll, how time, cost rates, and pay types become job costs, and how estimates compare to actuals. Experience with payroll, time and attendance, job costing, or construction and field service workflows is a strong advantage.
* **A Proven Growth Driver.** You have a track record of spearheading complex initiatives that deliver measurable business growth. You understand the levers of adoption, attach, ARPC, and retention, and you use them to prioritize and to drive P&L growth.
* **An Ambitious Problem Solver.** You proactively anticipate customer and stakeholder needs, thrive in ambiguity and turn complex, messy friction into clear roadmaps. You are scrappy and effective at managing a portfolio of bets across the lifecycle, from 0-1 innovations to products at scale. You know when to push forward and when to pivot based on evidence and stakeholder feedback.
* **Customer Obsessed & Analytical.** You possess deep empathy for small and mid-market business operations and frontline workforce challenges. You combine this heart with rigorous analytical aptitude, storytelling with data to prioritize investments.
* **Technical Fluency.** You demonstrate strong product judgment and comfort engaging across technical topics to build reliable web, mobile, and kiosk products on a shared platform, including APIs, data models, and integrations with payroll and accounting systems. Experience with agentic AI, payment systems, or HCM platforms is an advantage.
* **Education.** BA or BS degree is required, and an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

**About PhonePe Ads**

**PhonePe is India’s leading digital payments platform, and PhonePe Ads is at the forefront of connecting brands with millions of highly engaged users. We offer highly targeted, data-driven advertising solutions to top advertisers and agencies. As our programmatic footprint expands, we are looking for a dedicated Operations Analyst to drive the execution and success of our programmatic ad campaigns.**

 **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

**We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Operations Analyst with 1-2 years of experience in programmatic campaign management. In this role, you will be the backbone of our programmatic execution, responsible for setting up, monitoring, and optimizing campaigns across various Supply-Side Platforms (SSPs). You will act as the crucial link between internal teams, external advertisers, and tech platforms, ensuring seamless delivery and performance for our clients.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Campaign Setup & Execution**

* **Take ownership of end-to-end programmatic campaign setup, trafficking, and launch across multiple SSP platforms, including Google Ad Manager (GAM), Pubmatic, InMobi, and others.**
* **Ensure all campaign configurations (targeting, budget, pacing, creatives, and tracking parameters) align with advertiser expectations and internal yield guidelines.**
* **Conduct pre-launch QA to troubleshoot creative and technical issues, ensuring smooth campaign activation.**

**Campaign Monitoring & Optimization**

* **Actively monitor daily campaign performance, delivery, and pacing to ensure KPIs and SLA requirements are met consistently.**
* **Identify underperforming campaigns and proactively implement optimization strategies to improve yield, fill rates, and advertiser ROI.**
* **Troubleshoot delivery anomalies, discrepancies, and platform-related technical errors in real-time.**

**Advertiser & Stakeholder Management**

* **Serve as the operational point of contact for external advertisers and agency partners, providing timely updates, performance reports, and actionable insights.**
* **Manage internal stakeholder expectations by sharing regular progress reports, addressing delivery concerns, and highlighting revenue opportunities.**

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* **Collaborate extensively with internal Ad Sales, Account Management, Product, and Tech teams to streamline campaign execution and address complex integration issues.**
* **Work closely with Product and Analytics teams to provide feedback on platform capabilities, internal tools, and feature enhancements based on daily operational insights.**

 **Qualifications**

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience: 1 to 2 years of relevant, hands-on experience in programmatic ad operations, campaign management, or yield management.**
* **Platform Expertise: Strong working knowledge of setting up and managing campaigns on SSPs (e.g., GAM, Pubmatic, InMobi). Understanding of the broader programmatic ecosystem (DSPs, DMPs, Ad Exchanges) is highly preferred.**

* **Operational Excellence: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple high-priority campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.**
* **Team Player: A collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally and drive consensus among diverse teams.**

title: Principal Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We're after a hands-on engineer for our Forward Deployed team in Labs & CMC Digital & Tech, building the automation, data pipelines and AI tooling that take manual work out of the lab. You'll typically work closely alongside a Senior Principal Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer on the approach, coordinating with stakeholders as needed, while your own focus stays on turning that direction into working software: quickly, securely, and in a way that still holds up once it's live. As you build experience, you may take on more of that stakeholder relationship yourself, with support and guidance from leadership. Expect a lot of coding, pipeline work and cloud infrastructure, with security and testing built in as you go rather than bolted on at the end.

Most weeks you'll be deep in one piece of the build: automating a lab workflow, wiring up a data pipeline, or getting an agentic prototype into decent shape, while staying close enough to the rest of the engagement to flag problems before they land on someone else's desk. As you get more experience, you'll be trusted with a bigger slice of the problem yourself, and eventually the whole thing.

We care about software that scientists actually use. Less manual lab work, fewer errors, better data, medicines and vaccines moving faster through the pipeline.

**Why This Role Exists**

Labs & CMC is rebuilding how laboratory science and CMC work gets done, with automation, data and AI doing jobs scientists used to do by hand. Senior engineers typically lead and coordinate the relationship with the business side of that, working in close partnership with the wider team; this role exists to give them the extra hands to actually build what's agreed, while staying closely involved in how the work takes shape. You'll spend most of your time writing code, wiring up pipelines and getting things into production, picking up more ownership of the problem, and potentially of the stakeholder relationship itself, as you grow into the role and build a deeper understanding of what's needed.

* Turning direction into software: working with a Senior Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer to agree an approach, coordinating with stakeholders as needed, then building it properly rather than knocking together a demo.
* Keeping pace: most of what you'll build needs to land in days, not sprints, so you'll want to be comfortable shipping fast and adjusting as scientist feedback comes in.
* Automation that actually sticks: wiring up instruments, lab systems and data platforms so what you build is still running after the project wraps up.
* Getting the data right: pairing with data engineering so whatever you're building sits on data that's actually trustworthy.
* Production-ready by default: security, testing and monitoring go in as you build, not after something's already gone wrong.
* Leaving something behind: writing components and patterns that the next engineer, on this engagement or another one, can actually pick up and use.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Working the Problem**

* Partner with Product Owners, Product Managers, Business Owners and scientists to understand laboratory and CMC workflows first-hand, clarify the required outcome and identify delivery, data, security or compliance risks early.
* Translate the agreed approach into a realistic technical plan, build rapid prototypes using representative laboratory data and incorporate scientist feedback before progressing the solution.

**Building and Shipping**

* Design, code and test software, integrations, automation and data pipelines, taking ownership of day-to-day technical decisions within the agreed architecture.
* Develop successful prototypes into secure, reliable and supportable production solutions, confirming significant architectural decisions with a Senior Principal Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer or the relevant technical leader.
* Coordinate dependencies with internal, vendor and contract engineers, communicate delivery risks promptly and provide clear code, documentation and handover materials.

**Keeping It Secure and Reliable**

* Build continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines that enable frequent, controlled and traceable releases.
* Implement unit, integration and end-to-end testing, together with dependency scanning, secrets management and least-privilege access.
* Apply relevant GxP, data-integrity, privacy and security requirements, documenting technical decisions and obtaining specialist guidance where needed.
* Establish production observability using appropriate logging, metrics and alerting tools, and connect solutions with ServiceNow processes to support operational readiness and incident management.

**Cloud Infrastructure**

* Provision approved Azure or Google Cloud Platform infrastructure through the central Digital Platforms team, following established architecture, networking, identity, security and cost-management guardrails.
* Define infrastructure using Terraform and deploy applications using Kubernetes or Helm, applying appropriate settings for resilience, scaling and cost.
* Maintain consistency across development, test and production environments by managing configuration and infrastructure changes through automated pipelines.

**Contributing to Labs & CMC Solutions**

* Build and extend workflows and integrations within laboratory orchestration platforms, enabling scientists to manage and track work through connected systems.
* Integrate laboratory instruments and systems to automate data capture and reduce manual entry.
* Develop AI agents and workflow automation that reduce repetitive scientific and operational tasks.
* Partner with data engineers to make laboratory, analytical and inventory data accessible and trustworthy for the solutions being developed.
* Build Generative AI capabilities that support activities such as experiment planning, information retrieval and scientific decision-making.

**Building With AI**

* Use approved AI-assisted software-development tools and agent workflows, reviewing, testing and validating generated outputs before use.
* Reuse existing skills, prompts, components and Model Context Protocol connections, and contribute identified capability gaps to the wider team.
* Build AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines and Model Context Protocol integrations, seeking technical guidance for complex evaluation or data-access decisions.
* Apply appropriate guardrails, evaluation, traceability and human review to AI-enabled capabilities, particularly where scientific, regulated or GxP-relevant information is involved.

**Working Well With Others**

* Escalate Responsible AI, data-integrity, security or validation concerns as soon as they are identified.
* Contribute reusable components, agents and engineering patterns to the Labs & CMC library, supported by documentation that enables adoption by other engineers.
* Support internal, vendor and contract engineering colleagues with technical problem-solving and knowledge sharing.
* Share delivery lessons, recurring risks and improvement opportunities with technical leaders so that they can inform broader engineering decisions.

**What You Bring**

**Required Experience:**

  

* 5+ years building software professionally, across full-stack, data or AI/ML work, including some time on systems that actually reached production, not just proofs of concept.
* Comfortable taking a reasonably well-defined problem and shipping working software against it quickly.
* Solid Python, plus at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or similar.
* Hands-on with GenAI patterns, including agents, RAG, prompt engineering and evaluation, not just familiar with the terms.
* Some experience with workflow orchestration tools (n8n, Airflow, Temporal) and working alongside data engineers.
* DevSecOps basics: CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security scanning built into how you work rather than applied afterwards.
* Cloud experience on Azure or GCP, our preferred platforms, including provisioning with Terraform and deploying with Kubernetes or Helm.
* Comfortable setting up observability with Grafana, Prometheus or Elastic, and familiar with how ServiceNow fits into incident and change processes.
* Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot daily, not occasionally.
* Comfortable working closely with a more senior engineer on the shape of a problem, while owning how you build the solution yourself, and ready to take on more of that framing role as you gain experience.
* Comfortable working across time zones with a distributed team.
* Some exposure to regulated environments, so security, privacy and quality considerations aren't new territory.

**Preferred Experience:**

  

* A background in pharma, biotech or life sciences.
* Instrument integration, robotics or closed-loop experimentation experience.
* Familiarity with GxP, computer system validation or data integrity requirements.
* Hybrid cloud experience.
* A previous stint as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Customer Engineer or Solutions Architect.
* Have worked alongside vendor or contract engineers on a shared piece of delivery.
* Contributed a pattern or component that someone else actually reused.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Engineering or a related subject, or relevant industry experience.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, API Management, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Containerization, Database Management, High Availability (Inactive), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Microservices Architecture, Network Security, Operating Systems (OS), System Monitors, Version Control System

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Technical Product Manager – AI Platform, Interoperability & & Revenue Cycle Data
description:
**The Role**
============

We are building a scalable, AI-first healthcare data platform that turns raw clinical and financial data into actionable intelligence.

As a Technical Product Manager, you will drive the development of core platform capabilities spanning:

* Healthcare data ingestion and interoperability across clinical and revenue cycle sources
* Data normalization and canonical modeling that connects clinical, claims, and financial data
* Temporal data processing and workflow orchestration
* AI-ready data pipelines powering recommendations, patient insights, and revenue cycle intelligence

This is a highly technical, execution-focused role. You will work closely with architects and engineering teams to design and deliver high-scale, reliable platform systems.

**What You'll Own**
===================

**Healthcare Data Ingestion & Interoperability**
------------------------------------------------

* Define and deliver scalable ingestion pipelines for clinical and administrative data: HL7 v2, X12 EDI transactions (837, 835, 270/271, 276/277, 278), claims and remittance feeds, flat files, and FHIR R4 APIs where applicable
* Drive integration with interoperability platforms (e.g., Redox, Mirth) and with EHR, practice management, and clearinghouse systems
* Ensure high data quality, schema validation, and fault-tolerant ingestion

**Revenue Cycle Data & Intelligence**
-------------------------------------

* Own the platform capabilities that support RCM workflows across patient access, mid-cycle, and back end: eligibility and benefits, prior authorization, charge capture, coding, claims submission, denials, and payment posting
* Link clinical documentation and encounters to charges, claims, and remittances to create a complete view from encounter to payment
* Enable data foundations for AI use cases such as denial prediction and prevention, coding and documentation gap detection, under-payment identification, and prior authorization automation
* Partner with RCM operations, coding, and finance stakeholders to turn revenue cycle pain points into platform requirements

**Data Normalization & Canonical Data Model**
---------------------------------------------

* Own the design and evolution of a canonical data model across clinical domains (encounters, medications, labs, notes) and financial domains (charges, claims, remittances, payers, contracts)
* Define mapping frameworks for clinical and billing terminologies and coding systems (ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, DRG, CARC/RARC, SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm)
* Ensure consistent representation of structured and semi-structured data, aligned with industry standards (including FHIR resources where appropriate)

**Data Processing & Workflow Orchestration**
--------------------------------------------

* Define systems for event-driven and batch data processing pipelines
* Drive temporal alignment of clinical and financial events to support longitudinal patient views and claim lifecycle tracking
* Partner with engineering to implement scalable workflows using orchestration frameworks (e.g., Temporal)

**Platform APIs & Data Services**
---------------------------------

* Define APIs for:
* Data ingestion and transformation
* Access to normalized patient, encounter, and claims data
* Downstream consumption for analytics, RCM applications, and AI use cases
* Ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability of platform services

**AI-Ready Data Foundation**
----------------------------

* Enable data pipelines that support:
* Clinical decision support
* Patient summaries
* Recommendation systems
* Revenue cycle automation and financial insights
* Collaborate with AI/ML teams to ensure data is structured, contextualized, and usable for model development

**Execution, Roadmap & Delivery**
---------------------------------

* Translate platform vision into a clear product backlog (epics, user stories, acceptance criteria)
* Prioritize and sequence work across ingestion, processing, RCM data capabilities, and platform services
* Drive execution with engineering teams from 0 1 scale
* Track success through platform reliability, performance, and downstream clinical and financial impact

**Examples of Problem Spaces You'll Tackle**
============================================

* Designing a unified data model that connects fragmented clinical and claims sources
* Building high-throughput ingestion systems for real-time and batch clinical, EDI, and remittance data
* Creating temporal patient timelines and encounter-to-payment views from multi-source events
* Enabling AI-driven insights that reduce denials, improve coding accuracy, and speed up reimbursement
* Solving data consistency, mapping, and interoperability challenges at scale

**Required Experience**
=======================

**Technical Product Management (Must-Have)**
--------------------------------------------

* 5–8+ years of product management experience in a technical domain
* Strong experience building platforms, APIs, or data infrastructure products
* Ability to work deeply with engineers on architecture, system design, and trade-offs
* Proven track record of delivering scalable systems from concept to production

**Revenue Cycle Management (Must-Have)**
----------------------------------------

* Hands-on experience building products or data platforms for healthcare RCM (provider, payer, or RCM vendor side)
* Solid understanding of the end-to-end revenue cycle: registration and eligibility, prior authorization, charge capture, coding, claims, denials management, and payment posting
* Working knowledge of X12 EDI transactions (837, 835, 270/271, 276/277) and clearinghouse workflows
* Familiarity with billing code sets and payer concepts (CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, DRG, CARC/RARC, payer contracts, and fee schedules)

**Healthcare & Interoperability (Strongly Preferred)**
------------------------------------------------------

* Experience with HL7 v2 messaging and healthcare data exchange

title: Principal Technical Product Manager, ITC
description:

Full Time

Career area

R-97034

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

As Principal Product Manager in Nike's India Technology Center (ITC), you will own the long-term product direction of one of the foundational platforms behind Nike's merchandising. You will sit within Consumer Product & Innovation (CP&I), the technology engine behind Nike's product creation, merchandising, design, and innovation, and report to a Director of Product Management. You will partner closely with global Product, Engineering, Program Management, and Business stakeholders across Nike's matrixed environment. You will also work shoulder-to-shoulder with peers across CP&I and adjacent product organizations to align platform capabilities, evolve foundational tools, and shape the next generation of Nike's merchandising experience across Footwear, Apparel, and Accessories.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a seasoned product leader who leads through deep craft, technical fluency, and broad influence, not through direct authority. You bring a multi-year view of where platforms should go, with the discipline to deliver outcomes one quarter at a time. You are equally comfortable shaping the future architecture with engineering leaders, simplifying complex problems for executives, and partnering with global merchants to turn workflow needs into product.

You have led enterprise-scale platform and internal products before, where the technical and operational depth is real. You have earned the credibility to influence across product organizations you do not directly manage. This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, raise the bar of PMs across CP&I through informal mentorship, and lead through expertise rather than people management.

Key Qualifications :

* 9 to 12+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years on enterprise platforms, data products, or complex internal tools
* Track record of leading platform evolution, modernization, or migration across multiple teams or product organizations
* Technical depth across data architecture, APIs, integrations, and platform engineering trade-offs, with the ability to partner with engineering and architecture as a peer
* Proven ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across business and technology in a global, matrixed environment
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, experience or training; advanced degree preferred Ideally, you also have:

* Experience working on global products in consumer, footwear, apparel, or retail domains
* Exposure to AI/ML or Generative AI applied to enterprise product workflows

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**

As Principal Product Manager for Merchandising in CP&I, you will own one of CP&I's foundational platforms in the Merchandising space. You will lead its long-term product direction, technical evolution, delivery, and adoption. You will be a hands-on product leader, defining how the platform integrates with the broader Merchandising ecosystem and delivers measurable value to global merchants and the business.

* Define and own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for your platform area within Merchandising

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Prioritizes products and features by evaluating business value, feasibility, and user needs, ensuring alignment with Oracle's goals and strategies. Engages customers, non-customers, partners and industry analysts to obtain market information and discover opportunities for products. Leads efforts to identify customer needs and market opportunities, guiding teams to develop solutions and validate them. Owns the product development and road mapping processes for multiple products/features, ensuring feature requirements and best practices are met while driving delivery excellence. Acts as an innovation leader within the organization to influence overall strategy and direction of products, driving new feature development. Ensures alignment through cross-functional collaboration, drives business impact across organizations, and oversees success metrics criteria and performance metrics (e.g., OKRs, KPIs) for multiple products/features. Advocates for customers, anticipates their needs, and prioritizes customer issues throughout the product lifecycle. Gathers extensive feedback and aligns product capabilities with customers' business goals. Performs go-to-market activities, recruits and supports early adopters, and tracks product adoption metrics to optimize adoption and user satisfaction.
  

**Key Responsibilities**  
**Product Analysis – Market Analysis:**  
–Prioritizes products/features based on evaluations of business value, feasibility, and user needs (internal and/or external).
  
–Ensures alignment between the customer, the market, and Oracle's goals and strategy.
  
–Analyzes market trends and the competitive landscape to maintain a competitive position.
  
–Engages customers, non-customers, partners, and industry analysts to gather market information and identify opportunities for products.
  
**Product Analysis – Solution Identification:**  
–Leads efforts to identify customers' unmet or unknown needs, market opportunities, and regulatory requirements.
  
–Guides internal teams to define problem statements for complex products and develops hypotheses for new products.
  
–Independently owns and drives the solutioning process by collaborating with stakeholders.
  
–Drives evaluation and validation of solutions to inform decisions on enhancing products/features.
  
–Creates, maintains, and reviews solution artifacts (e.g., regulatory, functional, and non-functional requirements).
  
**Product Ownership – Product Development and Roadmapping:**  
–Takes ownership of planning, execution, and release processes.
  
–Owns roadmaps for multiple products/features, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  
–Develops feature requirements, resources, and best practices for stakeholders.
  
–Drives delivery excellence and resolves risks and issues.
  
–Tracks and analyzes metrics (e.g., service requests, bugs, feedback) to make data-driven product decisions.
  
–Writes and reviews user stories and acceptance criteria.
  
–Determines feature and experience priorities to support OKRs (Objectives and Key Results).
  
**Product Ownership – Product Leadership and Influence:**  
–Acts as an innovation leader, shaping product strategy and direction.
  
–Guides product development to improve customer experience and achieve business goals.
  
–Drives new feature development using agile and continuous-delivery methodologies.
  
**Alignment and Collaboration:**  
–Shares insights with partners and ensures cross-team alignment.
  
–Anticipates and manages stakeholder pushback using expertise and data.
  
–Partners with engineering and senior teams to identify solutions linked to OKRs and KPIs.
  
–Oversees business impact across organizations, managing success criteria and performance metrics.
  
–Establishes parameters for user testing and product iteration.
  
**Customer-Centricity:**  
–Serves as the primary customer advocate throughout the product lifecycle.
  
–Actively engages with customers to gather feedback and insights.
  
–Works with customers to align Oracle products to business goals.
  
–Captures and analyzes customer requirements for new product capabilities and feature designs.
  
–Ensures products are tailored to consumer needs during implementations.
  
–Reviews and prioritizes customer issues for satisfaction and quality, coordinating resolutions.
  
**Product Release – Go-to-Market:**  
–Develops release overviews, presentations, and demos for field teams.
  
–Recruits and supports early adopters to validate solutions.
  
–Contributes to the development of user documentation.
  
–Defines and tracks product adoption metrics, identifying user behavior trends.
  
–Presents demos to customers, partners, analysts, and field teams to promote value.  
  
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**  
**Planning & Execution:**  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables for projects.
  
–Delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans as needed.
  
**Collaboration & Partnership:**  
–Collaborates across the organization to align expectations and achieve objectives.
  
–Leverages understanding of leaders, stakeholders, and customers to ensure solutions meet needs.
  
–Supports inclusivity by seeking and respecting diverse perspectives.
  
**Problem Solving:**  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a range of data/information.
  
–Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with assessments and suggested solutions.
  
–Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem-solving strategies.
  
**Continuous Learning:**  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge, skills, and tools.
  
–Stays updated with industry trends and best practices.
  
–Seeks and uses ongoing feedback and training; coaches and mentors junior team members.
  
**Continuous Improvement:**  
–Develops and recommends process improvements to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  
–Evaluates the impact on key stakeholders and solicits feedback for continued improvement.
  
**Performance and Development:**  
–Contributes to the talent pipeline by participating in interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

title: Customer Experience & Retention Manager
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**About the Role**

Harness is growing its Digital and Commercial customer base, and we will not scale it by adding people in proportion. This role owns **customer experience and retention for a large book of Digital and Commercial customers**, and its main job is to **build and run the tech-touch engine that serves them**.

You will design automated journeys, health signals, in-product and email programs, and self-service resources that deliver onboarding, adoption, risk detection, renewal and expansion without a person in every interaction. You will use human time on the moments that matter: a customer stuck on a technical blocker, an at-risk account, a renewal negotiation. You will also feed what you learn back into the automation so those moments become rarer.

**Operating principle:** Automate by default, involve a human by exception. Every manual touch should either solve a high-value problem or teach us what to automate next.

**What You'll Own**

* **Tech-Touch Customer Experience Engine**

* Design, scale and optimize automated lifecycle programs: onboarding, activation, adoption, renewal and win-back. Run them through the CRM, the CS platform, email and in-product channels. Build triggered plays driven by product usage, milestones, health score, support signals and contract events.
* Own the segmentation and coverage model: which customers get automation only, automation plus on-demand human help, or direct engagement.
* Build the self-service layer: guides, templates, pipeline examples, office hours, webinars, community content and a knowledge base. Measure what gets used and fill the gaps.
* Run experiments (A/B tests on messaging, timing and channel) and report on what changes adoption and retention.
* Use AI-assisted workflows for summarisation, content personalisation, ticket and usage insight, and outreach drafting to raise throughput without losing quality.

* **Data-Driven Health, Risk & Prioritisation**

* Own the customer health model: define, validate and tune the signals (usage depth, feature adoption, engagement, support trends, sentiment and commercial indicators).
* Turn the data into automated risk and opportunity alerts, and route them to the right play or person. Build dashboards that show portfolio health, coverage efficiency, adoption funnels and renewal risk. Run recovery plans for at-risk accounts, then capture the pattern as a repeatable, automated play.

* **Technical Enablement & Hands-On Support**

* Guide customers through product configuration, integrations (GitHub, GitLab, cloud platforms, CI/CD tools) and common pipeline issues when automation and self-service are not enough.
* Join technical discovery and proof-of-value work with Solutions Engineering and forward-deployed teams.
* Reproduce common issues, gather logs and configuration details, and escalate cleanly to Support and Engineering.
* Convert every recurring technical question into reusable enablement: a guide, template, in-product prompt or automated play.
* Turn recurring customer challenges into product feedback and prioritised requests.

* **Renewals, Retention & Commercial Ownership**

* Own renewal execution end to end: automated renewal journeys and reminders, risk assessment, commercial discussion and close, with human involvement focused on at-risk and strategic renewals. Identify expansion, cross-sell and right-sizing opportunities from usage signals, and trigger plays and handoffs to Account Executives.
* Coordinate quotes, Order Forms, approvals and procurement with internal stakeholders. Keep renewal forecasts, customer records and risk assessments accurate and current. Work with Account Executives and Revenue Operations to improve gross revenue retention and reduce preventable churn.

* **Continuous Improvement & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Work with Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing and Revenue Operations to connect data, systems and messaging across the customer journey.
* Find manual, repetitive tasks and remove them through automation, integrations and tooling. Document playbooks and share best practices so the model scales across teams and segments.

**Required Qualifications**

* **3+ years required (5+ years preferred)** in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Digital/Scaled CS, Solutions Consulting or a similar SaaS role. Experience managing a high-volume B2B SaaS portfolio, ideally in a digital, SMB, mid-market or commercial segment.
* Hands-on experience building automation in a CRM or CS platform (Salesforce, Gainsight, HubSpot, Totango or similar), including journeys, triggers and health scoring.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with usage and engagement data, dashboards, funnels and cohort or segment analysis.
* Working knowledge of DevOps fundamentals: Git, CI/CD pipelines, APIs and cloud platforms. Experience with SaaS renewals, retention and commercial discussions, and an understanding of subscription, licensing and billing models.
* Strong communication, troubleshooting and prioritisation skills in a high-volume environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with digital CS tooling: in-app guidance, email and marketing automation, community platforms and knowledge-base or content systems.
* Experience using SQL, BI tools, scripting or low-code automation to build and improve workflows. Experience applying AI or LLM-assisted workflows to customer communication, support or insight. Hands-on exposure to Harness, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar CI/CD platforms. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure or GCP; REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and YAML configuration.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, Terraform or DevSecOps concepts.
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects or implementation teams.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Area**

**Outcomes**

  

**Scale & efficiency**

Higher customers-per-manager coverage with stable or improving satisfaction. A growing share of lifecycle touches and renewals handled through automation. Fewer repeat manual tasks.

  

**Adoption &**

**experience**

Faster onboarding and time to value, higher activation and feature adoption, and measurable use of self-service content.

  

**Retention &**

**commercial**

Improved gross revenue retention, lower preventable churn, accurate renewal forecasts and expansion opportunities identified from signals.

  

**Risk & health**

Earlier risk detection through a validated health model, and more recoveries run from standard plays.

  

**Technical**

Routine technical questions resolved through self-service or by you, and less reliance on Engineering for them.

**Ideal Candidate**

You think in systems, not accounts. You are as comfortable building a triggered journey and reading a usage cohort as you are leading a renewal conversation or debugging a CI/CD workflow with a developer. You do not need to be a software developer, but you are curious about how customers build and ship software, and you ask what a repeated touch tells you about what to automate or fix in the product.

### **Harness in the news:**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.
