title: Staff Product Manager
description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**Job Introduction**

Tekion is expanding its platform into security and compliance products for automotive retail, and we are hiring a senior product professional to own this new product area end to end. This role will build across two connected domains:

* **Compliance / GRC:** Products that help dealerships meet regulatory obligations, including F&I deal compliance, privacy and data governance, and evolving federal and state requirements, directly within the systems they already use.

* **Cybersecurity:** A modular suite of security capabilities delivered as independent products over time, including vulnerability and network scanning, continuous exposure management, endpoint detection and response, email security, credential-exposure monitoring, data-loss prevention, and log analytics / SIEM.

This is both a zero-to-one and scaling mandate. The role will define strategy, roadmap, packaging, pricing, and go-to-market approach, turning validated customer demand into shippable, monetizable products. The role requires close collaboration with US-based stakeholders and customers, including periodic time-zone overlap.

What You’ll Own

* Product strategy for Tekion’s security and compliance product lines, including the vision, boundaries, and how the two domains reinforce one another.

* Roadmaps for both domains, including sequencing of a modular, SKU-based product portfolio and defining the scope of each release.

* Packaging and pricing models, including subscriptions, consumption-based models, entitlements, and bundling.

* Voice of customer through continuous discovery with dealerships and dealer groups to validate demand before build.

* Cross-functional delivery in partnership with engineering, design, GTM, legal/compliance, security, and platform teams.

Key Responsibilities

Product Development & Strategy

* Own the holistic vision, roadmap, strategy, and launch plan for Automotive Security Cloud across security and compliance workstreams.

* Conduct market and competitive research to identify customer needs, product opportunities, market size, and differentiation.

* Define product positioning, messaging, and business rationale for new security and compliance offerings.

* Build alignment across product, engineering, security, compliance, GTM, legal, and leadership stakeholders.

Requirements & Analysis

* Run continuous customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized, well-specified product requirements.

* Write clear PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and launch requirements; partner with engineering on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.

* Track relevant regulatory requirements, including GLBA Safeguards, FTC rules, CCPA/CPRA, and GDPR, and translate obligations into product capabilities.

* Assess feasibility, risks, dependencies, costs, infrastructure needs, and resource requirements for proposed capabilities.

Go-to-Market & Commercialization

* Define the product/SKU catalog, entitlements, packaging, and pricing models for individual offerings and bundles.

* Build business cases and revenue models for new products, including subscription, usage-based, or modular SKU approaches.

* Recruit and manage design partners, run pilots, and convert validated pilots into referenceable customers and GA launches.

* Represent the product area to executives, sales, customers, and partners; support enablement, launch planning, and market entry.

* Define success metrics such as adoption, attach rate, retention, revenue, and risk reduction, and ensure products are instrumented to measure outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Lead collaboration across technical teams working on areas such as email security, vulnerability management, continuous testing, detection, compliance, and platform integration.

* Maintain alignment with leadership stakeholders on product progress, roadmap decisions, customer feedback, and market dynamics.

* Make independent product decisions with strong ownership, accountability, and clear communication.

* Set and communicate a multi-quarter vision and roadmap with measurable outcomes.

Must-Have Qualifications

* 7+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning security, compliance/GRC, infrastructure, platform, or B2B SaaS products.

* Strong product management fundamentals, including discovery, roadmap definition, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and translating business goals into executable requirements.

* Domain knowledge in at least one of the following: US automotive retail, dealership operations, F&I, DMS/CRM ecosystems, cybersecurity, GRC/privacy tooling, SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability/exposure management, or DLP.

* Demonstrated experience taking a zero-to-one product to market or scaling an existing product line.

* Working knowledge of security architectures, threat models, security controls, and relevant compliance frameworks.

* Experience with subscription, usage-based, or modular SKU packaging and pricing for B2B SaaS products.

* Proven ability to work autonomously, make decisions independently, and drive products from concept through launch.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical, business, and regulatory requirements into clear product decisions.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.

* Comfortable working with US-based teams and customers, including periodic time-zone overlap.

Good-to-Have Qualifications

* Experience selling into or building products for regulated SMB or mid-market verticals.

* Familiarity with building on a platform or system of record such as DMS, CRM, or ERP.

* Experience productizing an internal capability into a customer-facing offering.

* Familiarity with ISO standards, SOC 2, dealership compliance, privacy regulations, and broader security governance needs.

* Hands-on exposure to security product categories such as vulnerability scanners, continuous penetration testing platforms, email security, threat detection, endpoint security, cloud security, or SIEM/log analytics.

* Experience evaluating build, buy, or partner decisions based on technical feasibility, cost, time-to-market, integration effort, vendor maturity, and long-term differentiation.

* Track record launching greenfield products, entering new markets, or operating in early-stage or 0-to-1 environments.

* Experience with pricing strategy, cost analysis, revenue modeling, or budget planning for security or compliance products.

title: Director, Renewals & Scaled Programs
description:

**Company Overview**

At Poppulo, we help the world's leading organizations reach every employee, wherever they work.

For a large, distributed workforce, that's harder than it sounds. Today's workforce is spread across offices, factories, retail stores, hospitals and other frontline locations. No single communication channel can reach everyone. Poppulo brings those channels together in one AI-powered employee experience platform, helping companies deliver relevant communications wherever their people are located.

More than 10,000 organizations trust us to connect with their workforce across email, mobile, intranet, Microsoft Teams, and digital signage. Our communications reach more than 50 million employees worldwide, and the platform delivers content to more than 600,000 digital signs around the globe. We also help employees engage with their company, celebrate one another's contributions, and stay connected wherever they work.

We know there's no such thing as a "perfect" candidate—we're all works in progress, picking up new skills as we go. So apply even if you don't tick every box. We want people who see things differently—because that's how we see things too.

**Job Summary**

The Director, Global Renewals, is responsible for defining and executing the global renewals strategy to drive customer retention, expansion, and revenue predictability. This leader oversees global renewals performance and the development of scalable retention motions, including digital-first engagement for long-tail customers. The role combines commercial accountability, people leadership, and operational discipline to maximize customer lifetime value.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Global Leadership & Strategy**

* Set and execute the global renewals vision and strategy, aligned with Poppulo's corporate and revenue objectives.

* Own global outcomes for renewal rates, churn forecasting accuracy, contract value growth, and multi-year deal penetration.

* Present renewal performance, risks, and insights to executive leadership and inform business planning and forecasting cycles.

* Serve as a senior escalation point for complex renewals, strategic negotiations, and executive-level retention efforts.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop global Renewals leaders and managers, with clear performance expectations and accountability.

* Provide leadership for scaled Customer Success Associates where this function falls within the role's remit, aligning renewal and customer engagement teams.

* Build leadership capability through hiring, coaching, succession planning, and career development.

* Partner with Customer Success and People teams to align coverage models and team capacity with customer segmentation and growth priorities.

**Scaled Customer Success & Retention Programs**

* Define a scalable engagement strategy for long-tail customers, combining one-to-many digital programs with targeted high-touch intervention.

* Oversee retention playbooks using customer health signals, product adoption insights, early-warning triggers, and at-risk escalation paths.

* Sponsor automated customer communications, enablement campaigns, webinars, and other programs that improve adoption and time-to-value.

* Measure the effectiveness of scaled engagement and translate customer feedback into improvements in retention strategy and customer experience.

**Operational Excellence**

* Oversee the global renewals operating model, standardizing renewal playbooks, processes, and execution discipline.

* Establish governance for renewal pipeline health, churn forecasts, coverage, risk identification, and performance reporting.

* Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations on ARR reporting, pricing guidelines, CRM data quality, and commercial controls.

* Drive improvements in Salesforce, Customer Success platforms, dashboards, analytics, and automation to increase accuracy and efficiency.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Commercial Growth**

* Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to optimize retention and renewal outcomes.

* Identify and operationalize cross-sell and upsell opportunities using customer insights and coordinated account planning.

* Support multi-year and multi-product renewal strategies that strengthen retention and revenue visibility.

**Key Metrics You Will Own**

Gross Renewal Rate (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention / Net Renewal Rate (NRR),Churn Forecast Accuracy,Contract Value Growth % ;Multi-Year Deal Penetration % ,Timely Renewal Closure % ,Renewals Forecast Coverage and Scaled customer health, engagement effectiveness, and retention outcomes (where applicable)

**Requirements for Success**

* 10+ years of experience in SaaS or IT renewals, revenue management, or Customer Success leadership, including 5+ years managing global or distributed teams.

* Proven track record of leading renewal organizations at scale, delivering strong retention, accurate forecasts, and measurable contract value growth.

* Experience designing or overseeing scaled, digital-first Customer Success and retention programs, including customer segmentation and health-based engagement.

* Strong commercial judgment and executive negotiation skills, including complex renewals and multi-year agreements.

* Deep analytical acumen and working knowledge of ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, and renewal pipeline management.

* Salesforce proficiency required; experience with ChurnZero, Gainsight, Totango, or similar platforms is a plus.

* Demonstrated success driving organizational transformation, operational excellence, and cross-functional alignment.

* Ability to inspire geographically distributed teams and communicate effectively with executive stakeholders.

**Who We Are**

We're a values-driven company. We want people to bring their best selves to work and have a real hand in the products we build and the culture we build together. You'll be surrounded by smart, warm people who like a challenge, take ownership, and care about doing work that matters. If that sounds like your kind of place, come join us.

We live the Poppulo values each day because they are central to everything we do.

* **Bring Your Best Self** - We show up authentically, remain self-aware, and always strive to improve.

* **See It. Own It. Solve It** - We proactively innovate and solve problems for our customers and one another. We set high standards for our work, build a culture of learning, and acknowledge both our successes and our failures.

* **Together, We're Better** - We value and celebrate our diversity. We learn from others, respect their expertise, and focus on building trust. That's what makes us a team.

We've been recognized as a Top 10 Great Place to Work company and named one of the Best Workplaces in Tech and Best Workplaces for Women. We're a fast-growing global technology company with teams in the United States, Ireland, France, the United Kingdom, and India.

title: Senior Manager - Design Assurance & Product Management
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Domain focus: Design Assurance practice delivery across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains.**

**Job Purpose:**

  

The delivery management layer in the Design Assurance practice, between the Principals and the analysts. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against demand, track findings to closure across the practice, and manage the assurance throughput and turnaround metrics the function is judged on. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load.

**About the team:**

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles.

**What makes this role different. The delivery management layer between the Principals and the analysts in a practice judged on throughput and turnaround, not just rigour. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against incoming demand, drive findings to closure across every domain, and run the governance reporting and audit evidence packs. Workflow automation in ServiceNow is how the practice scales, and improving it is part of the role. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load, so this is not a pure coordination job.**

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Manage the demand pipeline across two Principals and the domain analysts, and decide what gets expedited — including telling a programme director that their review will not be.
* Manage assurance throughput, turnaround and SLA metrics the function is judged on, and escalate capacity pressure before turnaround slips quietly.
* Drive findings and time-bound conditions to closure across all domains, chasing the ones that stall and escalating aged items by name.
* Develop the analyst team's domain depth and progression, in a practice where most reviewers arrive strong in one domain and need two.
* Own the quality of what the practice produces — review rigour, finding clarity and closure discipline — and correct it at the individual level when it drops.
* Carry a review caseload alongside the management load, so technical credibility with the Principals is maintained.
* Manage the analyst team's day-to-day workload, quality and development across their domain specialisms.
* Carry roughly a third of a reviewer caseload yourself on Tier 2 designs, so allocation decisions are informed by current technical judgement rather than administration.
* Verify against standards the practice does not write, and protect that separation in how work is allocated.
* Spot capacity pressure in the pipeline two sprints out and escalate it, rather than letting turnaround slip quietly and explaining it afterwards.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

description:

description:
**Director Product Management – Customer Data Platform**

**About us:**  
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Guest Experience organization. Target is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our business objectives, guest segments and behaviors, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target.

The Customer Data Platform (CDP) Product team is a global organization within Guest Experience that builds Target’s next-generation connected enterprise and guest experience platforms. As Target’s enterprise foundation for trusted, actionable guest and marketing data, the CDP unifies data into reusable profiles and connects upstream sources with downstream decisioning, analytics, personalization, activation, social commerce, and emerging agentic systems. Through Guest Data Foundations, the team enables AI-first, real-time personalization, improves marketing effectiveness, and scales horizontal capabilities across Target with strong governance, reliability, scalability, and privacy—fueling growth and transforming guest experiences through a modern, human-centered, uniquely Target approach.

**About the role:** This Director of Product Management role will be based in Target in India (TII) and will lead a product team in close partnership with leaders and teams across Target.

* **Decisioning & Intelligence:** 30+ models built off the silver and bronze layers, powering data science, AI/ML decisioning, and analytics.
* **Activation & Personalization:** Data and services enabling Audience Platform, personalization models, Next Best Action, experimentation through A/B tests, real-time triggers, and Customer360-powered marketing activations.
* **Marketing Data Centralization:** Centralized marketing data across channels, including DAV, organic and paid social, and search through Funnel.io, enabling stronger channel relationships and unified reporting.
* **Creative & Asset Data Enablement:** Availability of CDMS creative and asset data for activation and performance marketing reporting.
* **Taxonomy Definition:** Definition and governance of marketing data taxonomy to ensure consistent classification, channel alignment, reporting accuracy, and scalable activation across Marketing 360 datasets.
* **Social Commerce:** Unified datasets supporting Club Target, creator programs, affiliates, and off-platform data integration and activation centralized in Marketing 360.
* **ML & Agentic Systems:** Production ML applications with expanding agentic capabilities in partnership with enterprise engineering teams.

As Product Director, you will set the product vision and own the strategy and roadmap for core CDP capabilities, including data sourcing, identity resolution, third-party data, marketing and CRM data assets, guest preferences, sales enablement, and enterprise activation. You will deliver trusted, interoperable products that accelerate value across Target; manage product financials, goals, and OKRs; and ensure the platform meets enterprise standards for reliability, usability, scalability, and modern architecture.

You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of product managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance through insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback, and partner with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to negotiate priorities and remove execution barriers.

You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders to validate hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide highly complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialties, using data and analytics to assess product health, evaluate competitive dynamics and P&L impact, inform decisions, and deliver recommendations to key stakeholders.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of product management experience
* Experience leading, coaching, and developing product teams while fostering a culture of transparency, accountability, and enterprise collaboration
* Proven experience leading enterprise Customer Data Platform capabilities that unify customer profiles, enable audience creation and activation, support real-time decisioning and personalization, and drive measurable adoption across business teams and channels
* Experience defining strategy and roadmaps for foundational customer data capabilities, including data sourcing and ingestion, identity resolution, unified guest profiles, consent and preference management, CRM data assets, and third-party data integration
* Experience building and scaling data platforms in e-commerce, retail, martech, or adtech
* Demonstrated ability to partner with engineering, data science, and architecture teams to develop scalable, cloud-native data pipelines and highly reliable systems
* Strong communication skills with a proven track record of influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders across large enterprise organizations
* Expertise in agile product development, including user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, and personas, with experience shaping complex, multi-pyramid initiatives
* Strategic mindset and bias for action with a strong ability to define OKRs, drive measurable outcomes, and lead product discovery using data-driven decision making
* Proven success modernizing enterprise data platforms through cloud migration, real-time processing and analytics, data quality frameworks, governance, consent and identity controls, privacy-forward design, responsible data use, and sustainable operating models
* Strong ability to build relationships and align diverse teams across Marketing, Digital, Retail Media, Engineering, Target in India, and external media and technology partners

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager, Product Security
description:
Senior Software Engineering Manager, Product SecurityThis role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**About the Role**
==================

As a Senior Software Engineering Manager within HPE’s Product Security Office (PSO), you will build and lead a high-performing development team responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and operating secure, reliable, and scalable software. Your team will deliver applications, platforms, APIs, automation, and integrations that enable product teams to identify, manage, and reduce security risk across the product lifecycle.

This is a build-and-scale people leadership role. You will create the team environment, delivery discipline, and engineering practices needed to turn product security priorities into dependable capabilities used across HPE. You will set clear priorities, develop engineering talent, establish repeatable operating mechanisms, and ensure the team delivers measurable outcomes with strong security, quality, reliability, and maintainability.

Operating within PSO’s matrixed model, you will balance shared engineering capacity across multiple product security capabilities, partnering with capability owners who define business outcomes and priorities while retaining accountability for people leadership, engineering execution, and technical delivery. You will bring enough technical depth to guide decisions, challenge approaches, review engineering quality, and remove obstacles while holding engineers accountable for technical ownership and execution.

You will partner with PSO leaders, product and capability owners, architects, program managers, product engineering teams, and adjacent cybersecurity organizations to align roadmaps, manage dependencies, and scale solutions across diverse product environments. The role manages individual contributors and succeeds by building a capable team—not by acting as the primary architect or personally owning every technical decision.

**What you’ll do:**
===================

**Build and Lead the Engineering Team**

* Hire, onboard, lead, and develop a team of individual-contributor software and security engineers, setting clear expectations, goals, development plans, and accountability for results.
* Create an inclusive, high-trust engineering culture grounded in ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenge.
* Provide regular coaching, feedback, career development, and performance support while building succession strength and expanding the team’s technical capabilities.
* Match work to skills and development needs, delegate meaningful ownership, and ensure senior engineers lead design and implementation within clear decision boundaries.
* Plan team capacity, workload, and skill coverage; identify resourcing risks and recommend hiring, development, or partner strategies.

**Drive Engineering Delivery and Operations**

* Translate Product Security Office priorities and capability roadmaps into clear engineering plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead day-to-day engineering execution, including prioritization, sprint and release planning, dependency management, risk tracking, escalation, and delivery reviews.
* Ensure the team builds and operates secure, reliable, maintainable, and scalable software, services, automation, APIs, data integrations, and product security tooling.
* Establish effective engineering practices for design review, source control, testing, CI/CD, secure development, release management, observability, incident response, and operational support.
* Balance new capability development with operational reliability, technical debt reduction, defect remediation, platform modernization, and lifecycle maintenance.
* Define and monitor meaningful measures for delivery predictability, quality, reliability, security, adoption, and engineering effectiveness.

**Shape Product Security Capabilities**

* Partner with product and capability owners to understand user needs, clarify requirements, prioritize engineering investments, and sequence delivery across the Product Security Office capability portfolio.
* Guide development of reusable product security platforms and services that improve vulnerability management, security assessment, secure development, reporting, workflow automation, or related security outcomes.
* Promote automation and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering where they improve speed, consistency, coverage, or user experience while preserving validation, traceability, security, and human accountability.
* Ensure security, privacy, data-handling, resilience, and compliance considerations are incorporated into solution design and delivery.
* Use stakeholder feedback, operational data, and engineering insights to identify opportunities for simplification, reuse, integration, and continuous improvement.

**Lead Across Teams and Boundaries**

* Build strong working relationships across Product Security, product engineering, security research, vulnerability response, infrastructure, architecture, and enterprise technology teams.
* Align stakeholders on priorities, scope, tradeoffs, dependencies, and delivery commitments, escalating material risks with clear options and recommendations.
* Provide transparent capacity, dependency, and engineering investment tradeoffs across the PSO portfolio, helping leadership determine when capabilities should be built, integrated, scaled, modernized, consolidated, or retired.
* Coordinate effectively with globally distributed teams and partners while establishing clear ownership, handoffs, documentation, and operating rhythms.
* Communicate engineering progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to technical teams, product leaders, and senior stakeholders.
* Represent the team in planning, architecture, operational, and leadership forums while ensuring individual contributors retain appropriate technical visibility and ownership.

**What you need to bring:**
===========================

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, software engineering, cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 10 or more years of relevant software engineering, security engineering, or technology experience, including 3+ years of people management experience directly managing software engineers.
* Proven experience leading teams that design, build, release, and operate enterprise software, platforms, services, automation, or developer-facing capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage individual contributors, develop talent, set clear priorities, address performance issues, and create accountability for delivery and engineering quality.
* Experience establishing or improving engineering practices across software design, code review, testing, CI/CD, secure development, release management, observability, and operational support.
* Experience managing roadmaps, delivery plans, dependencies, technical debt, operational risk, and competing stakeholder priorities in a complex or matrixed organization.
* Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, cloud environments, containers, data platforms, source control, CI/CD, and secure software development practices.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams and collaborating across time zones, cultures, and organizational boundaries.
* Experience with Python, Java, JavaScript or TypeScript, React, Node.js, SQL or NoSQL data platforms, REST APIs, Linux, GitHub, Jenkins or GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, or comparable technologies.
* Experience applying AI-assisted development, intelligent automation, or agentic methods within secure engineering workflows, including appropriate validation and human oversight.
* Experience improving engineering operating models, building a new team or capability, or scaling a platform from project-based delivery to sustainable operations.
* Working knowledge of common software weaknesses, OWASP guidance, threat modeling, software supply-chain security, and secure development lifecycle principles.
* Relevant engineering, cloud, agile, or security certifications are helpful but not required.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* A capable, engaged engineering team has clear priorities, meaningful ownership, strong development support, and accountability for outcomes.
* Product security capabilities move from ambiguous needs to predictable delivery through clear roadmaps, operating rhythms, engineering standards, and decision ownership.
* Software and automation are secure, reliable, maintainable, measurable, and supported through disciplined lifecycle and operational practices.
* Product and capability owners have a trusted engineering partner that provides transparent delivery commitments, credible tradeoffs, and timely escalation of risks.
* Reusable platforms, integrations, automation, and engineering practices reduce fragmentation and improve the scale and effectiveness of Product Security Office capabilities.
* The team becomes increasingly self-sufficient as engineers grow in technical ownership, judgment, collaboration, and leadership.

**Accessibility**

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health & Wellbeing**

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal & Professional Development**

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
The Opportunity

RoaDo helps shippers and logistics teams run domestic and cross-border freight on one connected platform. As a Product Manager, you'll take charge of one area of that platform. Depending on business needs at the time you join, it could be load planning, carrier sourcing and spot bidding, shipment visibility, our AI-driven control tower, digital proof of delivery, freight billing, or our export-import (EXIM) workflows. You'll partner with engineers, operations teams, and enterprise clients to turn real logistics problems into products that deliver clear business results.

Your Responsibilities

* Set the product direction and quarterly priorities for your area, and see them through to delivery

* Take full ownership of how users get work done in your module, from first sketch to everyday adoption

* Strengthen how RoaDo connects with the outside world: client ERPs, transporter systems, GPS and telematics devices, shipping lines, forwarders, customs brokers, and port terminals

* Give customers a single view of their international shipments, from factory gate to port, across the sea or air leg, and on to final delivery

* Spend regular time with exporters, importers, transporters, forwarders, and finance teams to find where work breaks down and decide what to fix first

* Write detailed requirement documents that leave little room for interpretation, and stay close to the engineering team through each sprint

* Choose the right success measures, such as usage, turnaround time, port dwell, and cost per shipment, and report on them consistently

What We're Looking For

* 3 to 5 years in product management, including at least 2 years running a B2B software product with full accountability

* Solid knowledge of road freight in India, both full-truckload and part-load, including how loads are planned, how transporters are selected, how trips are tracked, and how freight bills are settled

* Practical understanding of the truckload lifecycle: placing orders with transporters, monitoring trip milestones, handling waiting charges, and closing payments

* Good knowledge of export-import operations, including space booking, container handling at CFS and ICD, port movement, customs filing, and coordination with shipping lines and forwarders

* Comfort with core trade documents and terms such as Bill of Lading, Shipping Bill, Bill of Entry, Incoterms, and demurrage and detention charges

* Experience with exception alerts, live visibility, or control-tower style products will set you apart

* Able to read API docs and work through integration details with engineers, including GPS and SIM-based tracking, container tracking feeds, webhooks, and ERP connections

* A data-driven mindset: you can estimate the size of a problem, pick the metric that matters, and build a persuasive case from numbers

* Strong written communication and the ability to align engineering and business teams around a spec

How You Use AI

We give real weight to this. RoaDo PMs are expected to use AI as part of their everyday toolkit.

* You regularly use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor to analyse data and find patterns in product logs, customer tickets, and call notes

* You can quickly build a working prototype or demo to test an idea before engineering time is spent

* You use AI to speed up research, produce first drafts of specs, and challenge your own assumptions early

* You think about how AI can change what our product does for customers, such as reading trade documents automatically or predicting delays, and not only how it speeds up building

Bonus Points

* Background in multi-tenant enterprise SaaS

* Hands-on experience with freight forwarding, 3PL, or shipping line software, or with platforms like ICEGATE, PCS, or ULIP

* Exposure to multimodal freight across road, rail, sea, and air

* Working knowledge of Mixpanel, Metabase, Jira, or similar tools

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. title: Senior Product Owner
description:
**About Vista Equity Partners**

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.

**About Amtech**

Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.

With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.

**Our Employee Value Proposition**

At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:

**Purpose**

Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations.

**Growth**

Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.

**Culture**

Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.

**Innovation**

Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Sr Product Owner, based in Amtech India, to support product execution for our labeling ERP product line and to coordinate and support the product owners working across our labeling and corrugated ERP product lines.

On the product side, this role performs the product-management execution work for the labeling line of business in close partnership with in-market product leadership. Working with product management and market-facing stakeholders, the Senior Product Owner translates roadmap initiatives and projects into actionable development work, produces and maintains product artifacts, and drives delivery — while market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set jointly with in-market leadership.

On the coordination side, this role supports and oversees the product-owner process for the India-based team: scheduling and facilitating agile ceremonies, acting as a quality gate on product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts, and building a strong product-owner community of practice. This is a coordination and enablement role; it does not carry direct people-management responsibility.

The ideal candidate understands manufacturing operations, ERP systems, and agile product development, and is comfortable working across technical teams, product owners, and in-market product leadership.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Product Execution (Labeling Product Line)**

* Perform product-management execution for the labeling product line in partnership with in-market product leadership.

* Translate roadmap initiatives and projects into epics, user stories, and a well-formed backlog.

* Produce and maintain product artifacts, working with in-market leadership to close market-facing gaps.

* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes in line with roadmap direction set with in-market leadership.

* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan sprints across multiple months.

**Product Owner Coordination & Enablement (Both Product Lines)**

* Coordinate and support the product owners working across the labeling and corrugated product lines in India.

* Schedule, facilitate, and oversee agile ceremonies — Program Increment (PI) Planning, Sprint Planning, and Sprint Reviews.

* Review and act as a quality gate on the completeness and quality of PDLC artifacts.

* Build and support a product-owner community of practice — shared standards, templates, and continuous improvement.

* Help product owners grow in their craft through coaching, feedback, and shared best practices.

**Agile Development Collaboration**

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during sprint planning, development, and release cycles.

* Coordinate with product managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment planning.

* Participate in sprint ceremonies including planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

* Clarify requirements and ensure development teams understand the desired product outcomes.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work with in-market product leadership (product management and market-facing stakeholders) to align execution with roadmap and customer needs.

* Work with implementation, support, and sales teams to ensure product features align with customer needs.

* Provide product expertise for internal stakeholders and help drive continuous improvement of product capabilities.

**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 7+ years experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst in a software environment, including experience leading or coordinating other product owners.

* Strong experience working in Agile / Scrum development environments and facilitating agile ceremonies, including PI planning.

* Experience with ERP systems.

* Strong experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining and reviewing product requirements.

* Demonstrated ability to set and uphold quality standards for product artifacts.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with distributed and in-market teams.

* Product backlog and requirements management

* Agile / Scrum facilitation and PI planning

* Product-owner coordination and enablement

* PDLC artifact quality and standards

* Stakeholder communication across distributed teams

* ERP / manufacturing domain

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with manufacturing, ERP, or scheduling applications.

* Knowledge of production operations, shop floor workflows, or manufacturing analytics.

* Experience working in a distributed / offshore model in partnership with in-market product leadership.

* Experience establishing or supporting a product-owner community of practice.
* Experience with tools such as Jira or similar backlog management systems.

**Why Join Amtech**

At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About the role**  
  
We are hiring a Product Manager — Household Data Products to own a portfolio of data products within Target's Household product line: from household definitions and taxonomy, through certified datasets, pipelines, quality and governance, to the applications that Media, Promotions, Merchandising and Loyalty teams use to make decisions.  
  
Household is how Target understands its guests as the real-world units that shop together. This role takes the household foundation and turns it into trusted, reusable data products and decision-ready applications — answering questions like which households we acquired, retained or reactivated, what drove it, and how we should market, promote and assort for them.  
  
This is a hands-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Identity and business partners. You will partner with DE day-to-day across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and data contracts, and make sure household data products are trusted, well-governed and adopted. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes.  
  
**What you’ll own**  
  
**Household Foundations – Must Have**  
  
You will help build and own the household foundation layer that every downstream use case depends on: stable, certified household datasets built on the enterprise household identity (owned by the Identity team), with consistent definitions that business partners can trust and reuse.

* Household lifecycle definitions and formats — acquisition, retention, reactivation and new-to-category — agreed with Analytics and Finance and published as certified data products.
* Household attributes and taxonomy — life stage, composition, demographics, interests and purchase behaviour, including third-party enrichment — with clear ownership, lineage and refresh cadence.
* Household-level enterprise KPIs such as household-based conversion, taken from definition through UAT, sign-off and production.

**Household Applications – Must Have**  
  
You will help turn the foundation into applications that change decisions across the enterprise, delivering against a roadmap shaped with your manager and business partners:

* Media — map household cohorts to the campaigns they were exposed to, starting with diagnostics and extending to Roundel (retail media) audiences and measurement.
* Promotions — connect households to promotion performance so promo teams can see who a promotion actually reached and moved.
* Merchandising — household views of newness-led acquisition and assortment relevancy by life stage.
* Enterprise growth — an acquisition and reactivation waterfall across drivers (marketing including Roundel, promotions, brand marketing, newness and assortment, new stores), plus who the acquired households are.

**Analytics & Data Fluency — Must Have**  
  
Strong working knowledge of analytics and data concepts, with the ability to partner effectively with Analytics and Data Science teams. You should be comfortable with:

* Household and guest-level analytics, cohorts and segmentation
* Entity resolution and identity concepts (guest-to-household mapping, match rates, stability)
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data quality, reconciliation and metric definitions in a semantic layer
* Privacy, consent and responsible use of guest and household data

**Building data products with Data Engineering**  
  
You work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs and data contracts, prioritising the backlog, and making trade-off calls with DE on design, cost and sequencing.  
  
**Platform & ecosystem stewardship**  
  
Solid understanding of our data platform and cloud environment (GCP, BigQuery, Power BI). You make household data easy to discover, access and consume — through the certified gold layer, documented data products and self-serve paths for analysts and downstream platforms.  
  
**Trust, governance & data quality — critical**  
  
Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. Household data drives audience targeting, measurement and executive reporting, so an unstable household ID or a wrong definition ripples across every team that uses it. You own certification, quality monitoring, access and consent controls for the household product line.  
  
**Stakeholder partnership**  
  
You will work with partners across Marketing, Roundel, Loyalty, Promotions and Merchandising to gather requirements, clarify competing asks, and communicate progress, trade-offs and impact clearly to stakeholders and leadership.  
  
**What you’ll bring**

* 3–5 years in product management (or 5+ years in closely related data, analytics or engineering roles with product exposure), with experience on customer or household data products, CDP / customer 360, identity, data platforms, or AdTech/MarTech and retail media.
* Strong understanding of customer and household analytics — lifecycle (acquisition, retention, reactivation), segmentation, cohorts and life-stage modelling.
* Familiarity with identity resolution and householding concepts, and with how household data powers audiences, measurement and personalisation.
* Hands-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritising a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (lakehouse, data mesh or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, privacy and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Experience translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and working effectively with cross-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong product management practices and excellent communication with Data Engineering, Analysts, Data Scientists and business stakeholders.
* Nice to have: exposure to marketing measurement (attribution, MTA, MMM), promotions or merchandising analytics, or third-party data enrichment.

title: Sr. Manager, Digital Product Management
description:
**Work Schedule**

**Environmental Conditions**

**Job Description**

When you're part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll do meaningful work that enables our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As the world leader in serving science, our digital ecosystem powers billions of dollars in customer interactions and supports scientists, researchers, healthcare professionals and industrial customers around the globe. Our Digital Customer Experience organization is responsible for defining and delivering the future of digital commerce across our digital experiences.

As a Senior Digital Product Manager, APAC, you will serve as the regional product leader connecting Asia Pacific market performance, customer needs and commercial priorities to Thermo Fisher Scientific's global digital product strategy. You will develop a fact-based point of view on where Digital can improve customer outcomes and commercial performance across the region, with particular attention to the different market structures, customer behaviors, dealer models and platform maturity that shape digital adoption in APAC.

This role is intentionally positioned in-region. You will work closely with regional Commercial, Marketing, and eBusiness leaders while partnering with global Product Management, UX, Analytics and platform teams. Your responsibility is not simply to represent regional requests. You will co-create product direction with the markets, distinguish local requirements from scalable patterns and ensure regional insights influence enterprise product decisions.

Success requires strong product judgment, commercial acumen and the ability to operate across a complex portfolio of global and localized digital experiences. You will be expected to understand revenue and funnel performance across the region, develop hypotheses about performance drivers, identify opportunities for experimentation and bring a clear recommendation back to the broader product organization. You will also identify successful regional capabilities and operating models that may warrant broader global scale.

**How You Will Make an Impact**
===============================

**Regional Product Vision and Strategy**
----------------------------------------

* Define and evolve the digital product vision for APAC, grounded in customer evidence, regional commercial priorities, competitive context and measurable business outcomes.
* Translate differences across markets into a contextualized regional strategy that clarifies what should be globally standardized, regionally adapted or locally differentiated.
* Develop and maintain a multi-year regional product roadmap that connects APAC priorities to global platform and experience roadmaps.
* Distinguish business requests from underlying customer and commercial problems, then recommend the most effective product intervention.
* Identify opportunities that span markets, sites or organizational boundaries and drive alignment on reusable capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
* Bring a clear APAC point of view into global product planning, investment discussions and roadmap trade-offs.

**Revenue, Funnel and Market Performance Leadership**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Develop command of digital revenue, engaged traffic, funnel performance, adoption and conversion across APAC markets and the digital platforms available to local teams.
* Partner with Finance, Commercial and regional stakeholders to understand performance versus plan and prior year, identify meaningful trends and explain the drivers behind regional variation.
* Build hypotheses that distinguish macroeconomic or market softness from addressable digital performance gaps.
* Bring regional insights back into the corporate product organization so market learning informs enterprise priorities, investment decisions and roadmap sequencing.

**Customer, Market and Dealer Insight**
---------------------------------------

* Establish a disciplined customer and market insight cadence using direct customer engagement, Sales and service feedback, behavioral analytics, CAS or satisfaction signals and competitive benchmarking.
* Develop a strong understanding of dealer and distributor personas across APAC, including which needs are common across markets and which are country-specific.
* Partner with UX and Research to validate customer problems before committing to solutions and ensure regional experiences reflect real customer behavior.
* Monitor local competitors, digital commerce practices and emerging market behaviors to identify opportunities for differentiation.

**Global-to-Local and Local-to-Global Product Leadership**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Accelerate adoption of global digital capabilities across APAC by translating enterprise products into relevant regional use cases, enablement plans and measurable adoption outcomes.
* Identify successful regional capabilities, market practices or customer solutions that have the potential to scale beyond a single country.
* Build the business and customer case for when localized innovation should be standardized or incorporated into global platforms.
* Anticipate dependencies across markets and product portfolios and proactively align roadmaps to reduce fragmentation.

**Cross-Functional Product Leadership**
---------------------------------------

* Serve as a strategic product partner to APAC Marketing, eBusiness and regional leadership teams.
* Make and communicate prioritization recommendations when customer, regional, commercial and technical needs compete for investment.
* Clearly articulate expected customer and business outcomes, trade-offs, risks and strategic rationale to both senior executives and delivery teams.
* Create operating mechanisms that keep regional teams informed while avoiding a model centered on status reporting or request intake.
* Influence without direct authority and create momentum across globally distributed teams.

**Product Discovery and Delivery**
----------------------------------

* Lead discovery for regional customer and commercial problems before committing teams to specific solutions.
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product outcomes, requirements and MVP strategies that enable UX and Engineering teams to execute effectively.
* Determine the smallest meaningful intervention needed to validate a hypothesis and define criteria for scaling, iterating or stopping.
* Balance immediate market needs with the development of reusable global or regional platform capabilities.
* Maintain accountability for customer and business outcomes throughout the product lifecycle rather than measuring success primarily through feature delivery.

**Minimum Qualifications**
==========================

* Bachelor's degree required.
* 7+ years of experience in Digital Product Management, Digital Commerce, Customer Experience or closely related roles.
* Demonstrated experience defining product strategy and owning roadmaps for customer-facing digital products.
* Experience leading product decisions in complex, cross-functional and geographically distributed environments.
* Experience using revenue, funnel, behavioral analytics, customer insights and experimentation to make prioritization and investment decisions.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer and business problems into product strategy, measurable outcomes and executable roadmaps.
* Strong ability to communicate strategy, recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, commercial leaders and technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with dealer or distributor portals, localized commerce models, market expansion or regional digital transformation.
* Experience delivering digital commerce capabilities for B2B customers, distributors, dealers, procurement organizations or enterprise purchasing workflows.
* Experience managing digital revenue or funnel performance and translating business performance into product interventions.
* Experience with global digital platforms that must support regional and market-specific requirements.
* Experience collaborating across cultures and time zones and influencing teams without direct authority.
* MBA or advanced business education.

**Key Capabilities for Success**
================================

* Regional strategic product leadership: Builds a clear product point of view from customer, commercial and market evidence rather than serving primarily as a conduit for requests.
* Commercial acumen: Understands revenue, funnel and market performance and can identify where Digital has meaningful levers to change outcomes.
* Customer and market grounding: Uses direct customer evidence, analytics, Sales insight, competitive context and emerging market or technology signals to challenge assumptions and guide priorities.
* Systems thinking: Understands how local market decisions interact with global platforms, shared capabilities and the broader customer journey.
* Global-local judgment: Recognizes when a market need should be localized, when a global capability should be adopted and when regional innovation has potential for enterprise scale.
* Influence and alignment: Builds trust across regional and global teams while remaining comfortable making recommendations and difficult trade-offs.
* Clear communication: Synthesizes complex performance and customer signals into a concise point of view for executive, commercial and technical audiences.
* Ownership: Takes accountability for customer and business outcomes from discovery through delivery, adoption and optimization.

title: Senior Product Manager Disruption Management
description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

**Role Overview**

  

This role will own the product vision for simplifying and automating how schedule changes are identified, evaluated, communicated, and resolved, helping airlines reduce manual servicing while delivering a better traveller experience.

The Senior Product Manager will work across airline operations, reservations, servicing, reaccommodation, notifications, digital channels, and partner ecosystems to build scalable capabilities that support airlines with different business models, workflows, and levels of automation.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

**Product Strategy & Ownership**

  

Define how the product evolves from manual and rules-based servicing towards increasingly **automated, intelligent, and self-service schedule change management** .

* Translate airline operational challenges and traveller needs into clear product requirements, features, and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritise investments based on customer value, operational impact, strategic alignment, and technical feasibility.

**Schedule Change & Airline Servicing Expertise**

* Develop solutions covering the end-to-end schedule change lifecycle, including: Detection and classification of itinerary changes.Assessment of impacted passengers and itineraries.Airline policies and reaccommodation rules.Identification and presentation of alternative flights.Automated and agent-assisted reaccommodation.Traveller notification and acceptance.Digital self-service.Ticketing and servicing considerations.Handling of ancillary products and associated services.Interline and partner-airline scenarios.Exceptions requiring manual intervention.
* Ensure solutions can support different airline policies, thresholds, workflows, and customer servicing strategies.
* Partner with adjacent product areas such as **DCS, reservations, disruption management/IROPs, retailing, customer servicing, notifications, and airport solutions** .

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Engage directly with airline customers to understand current workflows, pain points, requirements, and desired business outcomes.
* Serve as a product subject-matter expert in customer discussions, workshops, demonstrations, and roadmap reviews.
* Monitor airline industry trends and evolving expectations around automated servicing and traveller self-service.
* Balance individual airline requirements with the development of scalable product capabilities.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, operations, and other product teams to translate strategy into executable product increments.
* Develop clear epics, requirements, acceptance criteria, and business priorities.
* Make product trade-offs across customer demand, technical complexity, operational risk, and strategic value.
* Manage dependencies with upstream and downstream airline systems and product teams.
* Partner with delivery teams throughout development, testing, rollout, and adoption.

**Commercial & Business Outcomes**

* Build business cases for product investment and clearly articulate expected customer and business value.
* Define and track product success measures such as: Schedule changes resolved automatically.Reduction in manual servicing.Traveller self-service adoption.Time to resolution.Contact-centre/agent workload reduction.Customer adoption and satisfaction.
* Support commercial teams with product positioning, customer proposals, and strategic opportunities.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Significant product management experience, preferably within **airline technology, travel technology, reservations, passenger servicing, disruption management, or airline operations** .
* Strong understanding of airline passenger servicing and itinerary management.
* Experience defining product strategy and managing complex, cross-functional roadmaps.
* Ability to translate complicated airline workflows and business rules into scalable technology solutions.
* Experience working with engineering and architecture teams on highly integrated enterprise products.
* Strong customer-facing skills, including discovery, workshops, requirements discussions, and executive presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise competing customer, commercial, operational, and technology requirements.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to use data and customer insights to guide product decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with airline reservations/PSS, schedule change, reaccommodation, IROPs, ticketing, or passenger servicing.
* Knowledge of airline distribution and servicing concepts, including PNRs, segments, ticketing and EMDs.
* Understanding of interline and codeshare servicing scenarios.
* Familiarity with modern airline retailing concepts, including **Offers and Orders** , would be beneficial.
* Experience building highly automated or rules-driven airline servicing products.
* Experience with airline digital self-service and customer notification journeys.
* Experience managing products operating at significant transaction scale and requiring high availability.

### **What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will make Schedule Change progressively simpler, more automated, and more customer-friendly.

They will help move airlines away from labour-intensive servicing towards capabilities that can intelligently identify impacted travellers, apply airline policies, offer appropriate alternatives, automate routine scenarios, enable traveller self-service, and direct agents towards the exceptions that genuinely require human intervention.

Ultimately, the role will deliver measurable value across three dimensions: better traveller experiences, lower airline servicing costs, and greater operational efficiency.

### **Ideal Candidate**

This person combines airline domain expertise, strong product leadership, and customer empathy. They are comfortable moving from a detailed conversation about servicing rules or reaccommodation logic to an executive discussion about automation, customer experience, revenue protection, and operating cost.

They don't simply manage a backlog. They understand the problem, define where the product should go, and bring customers, technology teams, and business stakeholders together to get there.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

Right along with Target’s distinctive retail brand, we are constantly improving and innovating our digital shopping experience. Are you ready to excel in the fast-changing retail environment? Are you a customer service enthusiast who’s curious about the guest and can see the shopping journey through their eyes? Then you’ll have success on the Digital Strategy & Platform team, whose goal is to offer guests a seamless online shopping experience across our platforms—including Target.com and the store network’s fulfillment capabilities. Here, you’ll collaborate to create and implement the digital strategies that enrich the online experience through the right mix of personalization, simplicity and intuitiveness. Your ideas will support Target in complementing the beloved in-store shopping interaction with a convenient, reliable and instantly gratifying digital experience.  
  
We are seeking a **Sr** **Product Manager – Seller Tools & Engagement** to define and execute the strategy for how Target+ engages, guides, and enables sellers at scale.  
You will lead the strategy, vision, and execution of our Seller Portal. You will shape the ecosystem that empowers sellers, expands guest choice, and delivers scalable growth  
In this role, you will lead a charter that improves seller activation, compliance, performance, and adoption across the marketplace lifecycle. You will own the systems, signals, and experiences that shape seller behavior—driving measurable improvements in marketplace quality, operational efficiency, and seller success.  
  
This is a highly cross-functional, data-driven role requiring strong product judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to influence outcomes without authority. You will partner closely with engineering, design, operations, and analytics teams to deliver intelligent, scalable solutions that help sellers take the right actions at the right time.  
  
As a Senior Product Manager, you will take lead on - Owning seller lifecycle engagement, including activation, adoption, performance improvement, and re-engagement. Designing data-driven nudges, reminders, and interventions that influence seller behavior and improve compliance, quality, and productivity. Enabling sellers to easily understand what actions they need to take and why, reducing friction and support dependency. Driving measurable behavior change in seller success. Define KPIs for marketplace success Use data and experimentation (A/B testing, cohort analysis) to refine features and improve adoption. Drive AI/ML powered insights

* Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
