title: Forward Deployed (Value Acceleration) Consultant / Senior Consultant-2
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role

The Forward Deployed (Value Acceleration) Consultant / Senior Consultant — Life Sciences AI sits at the intersection of customer engagement and AI-native platform delivery. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing automated business process solutions ("Blueprints") using Agentforce and Life Sciences Cloud (LSC) platform capabilities — while owning the roadmap and feature lifecycle for scalable, reusable accelerators that drive measurable value for Life Sciences customers.

You will partner closely with Life Sciences customer-facing teams, engineering, GDC delivery resources, and design to transform manual, fragmented workflows in Pharma, Biotech, and MedTech into automated, AI-native solutions. You are customer-obsessed, execution-focused, and driven by the challenge of building solutions at the speed and quality that regulated industries demand.

Responsibilities

Roadmap and Solution Ownership

* Own the roadmap for Life Sciences process blueprints and AI-native accelerators, balancing strategic direction with near-term execution needs across the LSC portfolio

* Own the feature lifecycle for LS-specific blueprint components from discovery through launch and iteration

* Identify operational inefficiencies, manual processes, and automation opportunities across Life Sciences customer workflows — including HCP/HCO engagement, field force, clinical operations, and revenue cycle

Blueprint Design and Execution

* Partner with Life Sciences customer-facing leaders to map and analyze customer requirements for new AI-native solutions

* Build solution blueprints and workflow automations using current Agentforce and LSC platform capabilities

* Work directly with AI agents and prompting tools to design automated, enterprise-grade solutions appropriate for regulated Life Sciences environments

* Validate, test, and iterate blueprints for accuracy, consistency, and performance against LS customer acceptance criteria

Technical Specification and Delivery

* Translate high-level strategic goals and Life Sciences customer requirements into clear PRDs, user stories, and technical acceptance criteria

* Manage the product backlog, prioritize sprints, and drive consistent delivery using Agile methodologies

* Document solution architecture, demonstrations, and implementation guidelines — including Steel Thread validation in support of go-live readiness across Hub accounts

Customer and Market Research

* Conduct user interviews and quantitative analysis to understand Life Sciences customer pain points and identify accelerator opportunities

* Act as the voice of the LS customer within the Agentforce development process, feeding structured insights to Product Engineering and the Hub's product feedback loop

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner with Engineering and Design to ensure technical feasibility and intuitive user experiences for Life Sciences personas

* Provide structured feedback to Product Managers on feature gaps needed to support LS-specific scalability and compliance requirements

* Support rollout and enablement of blueprint solutions across Hub teams, GDC delivery resources, and SI partners (Deloitte, Slalom, and others)

* Collaborate across the Ecosystems pillar on partner readiness and SI blueprint adoption

Required Qualifications

* 3 to 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Process Automation, Business Analysis, or Solutions Consulting

* Experience building or deploying external-facing products in enterprise B2B SaaS environments

* Strong understanding of business workflow mapping, process modeling, and process improvement methodologies, with demonstrated application in Life Sciences or a regulated industry

* Proven experience translating business requirements into structured automated workflows or solutions

* Hands-on technical experience with automation tools, workflow builders, AI prompting, or low/no-code platforms

* Excellent spoken and written communication with ability to present complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical Life Sciences stakeholders

* Proven ability to collaborate with virtual and global cross-functional teams including engineering, design, and customer success

* Rigor and consistency in managing product backlogs and executing delivery

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in Life Sciences commercial operations, HCP/HCO engagement, field force automation, or clinical operations technology

* Experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud (LSC), Agentforce, or comparable CRM/AI platforms in regulated industries

* Experience with prompt design or agent-based automation solutions

* Familiarity with the Salesforce platform ecosystem (APIs, platform services, Data Cloud)

* Understanding of Life Sciences regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., GxP, HIPAA, GDPR) as they relate to CRM and workflow automation

* Experience with network effects and cold start strategies for enterprise B2B solutions

* Lean, Six Sigma, or related process improvement certification

* Pharma, Biotech, or MedTech industry background strongly preferred

Success Metrics

* Efficiency improvements and measurable reduction in manual work for Life Sciences customers

* Blueprint adoption, usage outcomes, and business value delivered (e.g., cost savings, field force productivity, HCP engagement improvement)

* Quality and clarity of roadmap feedback influencing LSC and Agentforce platform improvements

* Time-to-value and scalability of LS-specific solution deployments

* Customer satisfaction and depth of engagement with deployed solutions across the LSC portfolio

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. title: CRM Product Owner
description:
Role Overview

The **CRM Product Owner** will be responsible for driving the vision, roadmap, delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Group CRM capabilities across Sales, Marketing, and related business processes.

The role will act as a key bridge between business stakeholders, CRM data teams, functional teams, and technology delivery teams to ensure CRM solutions deliver measurable business value, strong user adoption, and high-quality client data.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

* Collaborate with business stakeholders to define a clear product vision aligned with strategic business objectives and CRM transformation priorities.
* Secure stakeholder alignment for key decisions, priorities, and delivery strategies while providing clear functional direction to development teams.
* Define and maintain the product roadmap, outlining the vision, priorities, dependencies, and delivery direction over time.
* Partner with business stakeholders to facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and requirement discussions, translating business needs into practical Dynamics 365 CRM solutions.
* Advise stakeholders on potential business solutions using Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM capabilities, with a focus on scalable, user-friendly, and value-driven outcomes.
* Prepare functional requirement documents, test case documents, and supporting delivery artefacts for new projects, enhancements, and change requests.
* Manage and continuously enhance both the Microsoft Dynamics CRM Sales and Marketing modules, ensuring configuration, processes, and user journeys are aligned with business priorities and adoption objectives.
* Drive the harmonisation and rationalisation of Group CRM across Sales and Marketing by consolidating processes, tables, fields, user journeys, and configuration principles into a more consistent, scalable, and standardised CRM operating model.
* Support CRM data cleansing and data quality improvement activities by liaising with the CRM Data Team, business stakeholders, and relevant contributors to ensure accurate, complete, and reliable client and sales information.
* Own functional testing, user acceptance testing coordination, and documentation of results for projects, enhancements, change requests, and BAU activities.
* Create and refine Product Backlog Items in Azure DevOps, translating business requirements into clear user stories in close collaboration with the development team.
* Liaise with development teams to monitor delivery progress, manage dependencies, and ensure roadmap commitments are delivered on time.
* Lead regular governance and functional review sessions with business and functional managers to assess module performance, review process effectiveness, and validate readiness before implementation.
* Contribute to application stability and continuous improvement by reviewing product progress, gathering user feedback at each iteration, and adapting the product backlog accordingly.
* Conduct user training sessions to strengthen user confidence, improve adoption, and ensure consistent adherence to CRM best practices.
* Prepare training materials, user guides, and communication artefacts to support onboarding, adoption, and effective use of CRM functionality.

Required Experience and Capabilities

* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics CRM, preferably across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Service modules.
* Strong understanding of out-of-the-box Sales capabilities, including Lead to Opportunity, Products, Price Lists, Quotes and Orders, Sales Literature, and Product Catalog.
* Experience creating Dynamics CRM views, dashboards, and reports to support operational visibility and business decision-making.
* Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator integration and related CRM sales productivity capabilities.
* Experience with Sales Accelerator, Copilot for Sales, and other CRM productivity features that improve user adoption and commercial efficiency.
* Experience enabling and adopting AI capabilities within Dynamics 365 CRM, including Copilot-assisted record summarization, lead and opportunity insights, meeting preparation, recent record changes, and guided sales productivity features.
* Understanding of AI-driven marketing capabilities in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys, including natural language journey creation, audience segmentation, AI-assisted email creation, content refinement, image recommendations, and campaign engagement optimization.
* Ability to identify practical AI use cases within CRM that improve user productivity, data quality, customer engagement, and sales effectiveness while respecting data governance, security, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience with lead generation, lead scoring, campaign-related processes, and marketing engagement capabilities within CRM.
* Hands-on experience with CRM Marketing capabilities, including customer journeys, segments, email templates, campaign orchestration, event communications, marketing forms, consent management, and campaign performance tracking.
* Good understanding of the Dynamics CRM security model, including roles, teams, access management, and governance considerations.
* Experience with Sales goal management, performance tracking, and CRM-based KPI monitoring.
* Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, and training skills, with the ability to drive CRM adoption across diverse user groups.
* Experience using data analytics, dashboards, and reporting to monitor CRM performance, data quality, and business outcomes.

• We are unified through a common purpose

• We embrace diversity and strive for inclusion

title: Product Owner, Workday, Time Tracking & Absence Management
company: Revantage Global Services India Private Limited
description:
**Position Overview**  
  
The **Experienced Product Owner** is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform. This role focuses on the **Time Tracking & Absence Management** Module. Additional module expertise is a plus.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

  

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): **Time Tracking & Absence Management** end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

  

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

  

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to configure, test, validate and deploy.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Create design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Own day-to-day delivery.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

  

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Nice to have experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**Module-specific Experience (by Role): Time & Absence**  
  
Time tracking, leave management, scheduling, and absence compliance — configuration and operational support.

* **Time Tracking:** Time entry methods (web clock, mobile, elapsed vs. in/out), time entry templates, calculation rules, overtime, and manager approval workflows.
* **Absence Management:** Leave type configuration (PTO, sick, parental, unpaid), accrual plans, carryover/payout rules, eligibility conditions, and balance adjustments.
* **Compliance:** Country-specific leave entitlements, statutory mandates (FMLA, local requirements), and leave of absence business processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Workday Pro certification in one or more relevant modules.
* Experience with third-party HR technology integrations and vendor management.
* Exposure to change management methodologies and communication planning.
* Prior experience in private equity, financial services, or multi-company real estate environments.
* Familiarity with Agile or product management frameworks (backlog management, sprint planning, road mapping tools).

**About Revantage**  
  
Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago, Revantage supports a diverse and complex ecosystem of portfolio companies (PortCos) spanning residential, commercial, logistics, hospitality, and life-sciences real estate globally — across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.  
  
Our People Technology team sits at the centre of this multi-entity, multi-jurisdictional operating model. We run a single Workday tenant that serves a federated landscape of PortCos, each with its own workforce, HR policies, compensation structures, payroll requirements, and compliance obligations. This complexity demands technology professionals who thrive in ambiguity, operate with an enterprise mindset, and can design solutions that scale across legal entities, geographies, and business models.

In accordance with applicable law, we prohibit discrimination against any applicant, employee, or other covered person based on any legally recognized basis, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed servicemember status, race, color, caste, immigration status, religion, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex, gender, gender expression, gender identity, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation or related medical conditions), age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), protected leave status, domestic violence victim status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations, if you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please email* *TalentAcquisitionIndia@revantage.com*

title: Principal - Product Owner for Biometric Authentication Solution
description:
**About the Team:**

Global Supply Chain is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose**

The Principal - Product Owner for Biometric Authentication Solution is responsible for maximising the value of a Biometric Solutions product by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. The role works closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to product strategy.

The Product Owner for Biometric Authentication Solution guides Product Analysts and works with Engineers, Architects, Testers, Service teams and external partners to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven and data-informed. The job holder makes day-to-day backlog and acceptance decisions, oversees iterative delivery and uses product performance information to improve adoption, stability, user experience and operational readiness.

The role is accountable for maintaining clarity of scope and decision making throughout discovery, refinement, design, testing, release and operation. Strategic investment, major architecture and cross-product trade-offs are escalated to the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead in line with agreed decision rights.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements and define product outcomes within guardrails set by the Product Man
* ager and Product Domain Lead.
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring epics, features and user stories are well defined and supported by relevant data on value, users, cost, risk, dependencies and process impact.
* Make backlog prioritisation decisions based on value, cost, risk, business continuity and resource capacity, escalating strategic trade-offs in line with the agreed RACI.
* Lead product delivery activities, guiding Product Analysts and working with Engineers, Architects and Testers to ensure solutions are fit for purpose, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to standards.
* Lead refinement, demonstrations, acceptance and release decisions and maintain clear traceability from business outcome through requirement, test and delivered change.
* Drive operational readiness using a structured checklist covering support model, training, continuity, configuration, runbooks, release notes, validation evidence and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, process outcomes, cycle time, stability, defects, user experience and support effort.
* Ensure product changes follow required security, data, quality, validation, change and regulatory controls and obtain specialist approvals where required.
* Builds working knowledge of the biometric platforms in scope and flags obvious opportunities (for example adoption gaps, authentication use cases) to the Product Manager with guidance.
* Support Architects in assessing design options and manage cross-product dependencies, interface impacts and release sequencing.
* Act as an escalation point for the product team and business users on functional product issues and guide resolution within agreed guardrails.
* Coordinate supplier delivery and hold external partners accountable for quality, documentation, knowledge transfer and product outcomes.
* Promote agile, iterative, value-driven and data-led delivery and use feedback and performance insights to continuously improve the product.
* Collaborates effectively with AI / ML engineers, data scientists, architects and security teams to turn biometric requirements into robust models, APIs, and services.

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Typically 5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.
* AI, agile delivery, business analysis, change, process improvement or service management certifications are desirable.
* Product lifecycle management, requirements gathering, backlog and acceptance management, agile/iterative delivery, user-centred design, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Enterprise technology, data, integration, security and service principles, with experience in biometric solutions (Nymi Bands, Windows Hello, etc.) and understanding of regulated manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and laboratory environments.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on value, process impact, risk, cost, capacity and technology dependencies.
* Experience guiding Product Analysts, Engineers, Architects and Testers through refinement, design, testing, release and adoption.
* Experience applying security, data protection, quality, validation, change and service-readiness controls.
* Experience defining product performance measures and using user, process, stability and service insights to improve outcomes.
* Experience working in agile or iterative delivery environments and coordinating suppliers or external delivery partners.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in day-to-day product work (e.g. copilot tools, AI assistants, analytics platforms, experimentation tooling) to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience leading cross-functional squads (product, engineering, data/ML, security, compliance) to deliver AI-driven features from discovery through scale-up.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain product decisions and technology constraints to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong facilitation skills for discovery, backlog refinement, prioritisation, demonstrations and acceptance discussions.
* Analytical judgement to balance value, risk, cost, complexity, urgency and operational impact.
* Ability to interpret process information, user feedback and product data to identify improvements.
* Working understanding of architecture, integration, data, security, validation, service and operational readiness.
* Strong organisation, traceability and documentation discipline.
* Collaborative approach and ability to work across global, cross-functional and supplier teams.
* Commitment to user-centred, capability-led and technology-agnostic solutions.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Product Owner: Equities Cash & Derivatives(VP)
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking an experienced Product Owner (individual contributor) to provide product leadership for Equity Research products, workflows, and platforms, with responsibility for planning, coordinating, and delivering capabilities that enable the creation, review, approval, publication, distribution, entitlement, discovery, and consumption of research content. The role manages product demand and the backlog, translates business needs into delivery-ready requirements, drives Agile execution, coordinates stakeholders, leads testing and release readiness, and provides executive reporting to support strategic, operational, regulatory, and control priorities.

**In This Role, You Will:**

Lead product delivery activities for assigned Equity Research capabilities, partnering with Research Analysts, Research Management, Technology, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Content Distribution, and Control stakeholders to manage outcomes, dependencies, risks, controls, and delivery commitments.

**Functional and Technical Skills**

**Product Management and Product Ownership**

* Execute the product vision and roadmap across Equity Research authoring, review, approval, publication, distribution, consumption, entitlements, analyst coverage, ratings, price targets, estimates, and earnings-related workflows.
* Evaluate business requests, user needs, stakeholder feedback, operational issues, control requirements, and regulatory obligations to prioritize the backlog and plan delivery.
* Manage product demand and intake, ensuring requests are documented, assessed, tracked, prioritized, and routed appropriately.
* Maintain visibility into product initiatives, intended outcomes, dependencies, milestones, capacity, risks, assumptions, and delivery commitments.
* Manage quarterly planning activities, including capacity reviews, dependency management, prioritization, sequencing, and roadmap coordination.
* Partner with Research and Product leadership to define outcomes, clarify scope and success measures, evaluate solution options, and drive delivery from discovery through implementation.
* Assess impacts across research processes, technology platforms, operating models, controls, data, content distribution channels, client-facing experiences, and downstream consumers.

**Equity Research Domain and Workflow Expertise**

* Understand end-to-end Equity Research workflows, including idea development, content creation, collaboration, supervisory review, compliance approval, publication, distribution, correction, withdrawal, and archival.
* Support products and platforms used by Research Analysts and Research Management for authoring, coverage management, ratings, price targets, estimates, models, earnings workflows, content search, and publication.
* Partner with Compliance and Legal stakeholders on disclosures, conflicts management, information barriers, supervisory controls, recordkeeping, entitlements, and other research-related obligations.
* Support research distribution through client portals, email and content feeds, market-data or third-party channels, internal platforms, APIs, and other approved delivery mechanisms.
* Understand the needs of institutional clients and internal consumers who discover, access, and use research content, while maintaining appropriate permissions and controls.
* Identify opportunities to improve analyst experience, publication timeliness, content quality, discoverability, distribution reliability, client experience, and operational efficiency.

**Agile Delivery and Requirements Management**

* Create, refine, and maintain capabilities, epics, features, user stories, business requirements, acceptance criteria, process flows, and non-functional requirements in Jira or equivalent tools.
* Translate complex research, content, data, regulatory, and operational needs into clear, testable, and actionable work items for Technology and delivery teams.
* Own backlog refinement and prioritization; lead or support sprint planning, story reviews, retrospectives, backlog reviews, and daily delivery ceremonies as needed.
* Define measurable product outcomes and connect roadmap investments to user, business, control, and operational benefits.
* Track delivery progress, resolve requirement gaps, and identify and escalate risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies in a timely manner.
* Evaluate solution options and document impacts to workflows, interfaces, data, entitlements, controls, content formats, distribution channels, and downstream consumers.

**Testing, Release Readiness and Production Governance**

* Lead or coordinate user acceptance testing, test planning, requirements traceability, evidence management, defect triage, production validation, and post-implementation reviews.
* Coordinate implementation planning, release readiness, stakeholder communications, training materials, rollout activities, support procedures, adoption, and production preparedness.
* Ensure research processes, controls, support procedures, business continuity considerations, data-quality expectations, and target operating models are documented and validated before implementation.
* Support root-cause analysis, incident remediation, production issues, audit and compliance requests, and sustainable corrective actions.
* Monitor product performance, adoption, service health, user feedback, content-delivery effectiveness, and operational outcomes to drive continuous improvement.

**Stakeholder Coordination and Governance**

* Coordinate Research Analysts, Research Management, Product, Technology, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Content Distribution, Risk, and Control stakeholders to drive delivery activities and decisions.
* Lead discovery sessions, working groups, planning meetings, governance reviews, execution checkpoints, demonstrations, and cross-workstream coordination.
* Maintain action, decision, issue, risk, assumption, and dependency logs; establish clear owners and drive timely resolution of blockers.
* Manage and respond to internal and external inquiries related to product capabilities, roadmap commitments, controls, research workflows, and ongoing initiatives.
* Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders and influence decisions without direct authority in a global, matrixed organization.

**Data, Content, Process Improvement, Automation and AI Enablement**

* Identify and execute opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and scale research-product and operational processes.
* Use product analytics, workflow data, content metadata, user feedback, and service metrics to identify friction points and inform prioritization.
* Develop dashboards, metrics, and management reporting covering roadmap delivery, adoption, publication and distribution outcomes, testing, risks, controls, incidents, and operational readiness.
* Partner with Technology and data teams to improve content metadata, taxonomy, search, discoverability, lineage, data quality, permissions, and distribution reliability.
* Assess appropriate uses of automation and AI-supported capabilities for documentation, analysis, content workflows, search, testing, reporting, and communication, with human review and applicable privacy, security, intellectual-property, conduct, and regulatory safeguards.

**Executive Communication**

* Create concise, executive-ready presentations and updates that explain product outcomes, roadmap status, adoption, trade-offs, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.
* Translate complex research, platform, data, content, operational, and regulatory issues into clear, outcome-oriented conversations and practical recommendations.
* Communicate credibly with Research specialists, Technology partners, Operations teams, control functions, and senior leaders across global businesses.
* Facilitate difficult prioritization and scope discussions while maintaining transparency on capacity, sequencing, delivery risk, and expected benefits.

**Change Mindset, Collaboration and Ownership**

* Work effectively at the intersection of Equity Research domain expertise, product management, product ownership, business analysis, and delivery management.
* Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and seek to understand end-to-end research processes, technology platforms, content and data flows, controls, distribution channels, and user workflows.
* Challenge assumptions constructively, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions.
* Operate with ownership, accountability, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a bias toward action while managing multiple priorities with limited oversight.
* Demonstrate adaptability and continuous learning, including responsible adoption of emerging product, data, automation, analytics, and AI capabilities.

Risk and Control Mindset

* Embed risk and control considerations into product design, backlog prioritization, requirements, testing, release readiness, implementation, and ongoing product management.
* Ensure product capabilities and delivery processes align with applicable research regulations, disclosure and conflicts requirements, information barriers, supervisory expectations, recordkeeping, entitlements, resiliency, data security, privacy, and internal risk frameworks.
* Identify and escalate delivery, operational, conduct, technology, data, content, regulatory, and third-party risks in a timely manner.
* Support audit, compliance, resiliency, control-remediation, and business-continuity activities, ensuring actions are traceable and sustainably closed.
* Ensure responsible use of AI and automation with appropriate awareness of confidentiality, data privacy, information security, intellectual property, explainability, governance, and regulatory requirements.

**Required Qualifications :**

. 5+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

* 5+ years of experience across Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Equity Research, market data, content management, publishing, financial services technology, or related functions.
* Experience supporting Equity Research products, market-data solutions, content-management platforms, publishing workflows, or client-facing content-distribution capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience gathering and documenting business requirements, managing product backlogs, prioritizing demand, and partnering with Technology teams to deliver solutions.
* Working knowledge of end-to-end product delivery, including discovery, requirements, solution evaluation, testing, release readiness, implementation, adoption, production support, and continuous improvement.
* Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, planning, prioritization, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives and competing priorities while maintaining quality, accuracy, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create executive-ready presentations and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Ability to operate effectively in a demanding, fast-paced, global, and highly matrixed environment.

**Desired Qualifications / Skills**

* Deep knowledge of Equity Research workflows, including content creation, supervisory review, compliance approval, publication, distribution, correction, withdrawal, and archival.
* Understanding of analyst coverage management, ratings, price targets, estimates, financial models, earnings-related workflows, disclosures, conflicts management, and information barriers.
* Experience with research authoring and publishing platforms, content-management systems, client portals, entitlements, search, APIs, feeds, and third-party research-distribution channels.
* Knowledge of market-data products, financial information platforms, data vendors, and content standards used by Equity Research organizations.
* Experience working directly with Research Analysts, Research Management, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Marketing, Content Distribution, and Technology stakeholders.
* Experience delivering regulatory, compliance, audit, resiliency, information-security, privacy, or control-remediation initiatives.
* Experience using product analytics, dashboards, metrics, workflow tools, automation, or low-code capabilities to improve user and business outcomes.
* Understanding of data governance, metadata, taxonomy, lineage, data quality, identity and access management, and content-entitlement controls.
* Familiarity with APIs, cloud-enabled platforms, integration patterns, and non-functional requirements such as availability, performance, resilience, security, and scalability.
* Self-motivated, intellectually curious, adaptable, collaborative, and execution-focused, with the ability to learn independently and operate with limited supervision.

Work Arrangement, Shift Timings & Flexibility

* **Work Model:** Hybrid working model with a minimum requirement of three (3) days per week from office.
* **Flexibility:** The role requires reasonable flexibility to attend stakeholder meetings or calls as needed during US business hours and to provide support for weekend activities, as required, particularly during release and deployment windows.

**Posting End Date:**

8 Nov 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

c. Please be prepared to provide accurate information and supporting documentation in connection with any lawful employment and education verification conducted by Wells Fargo.

title: Advanced Software Engr
description:
As a Technical Product Owner here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for providing guidance through the product lifecycle, ensuring technical solutions are developed and delivered on schedule. You will collaborate with product management to align solutions with market and customer demand. You will be responsible for mitigating technical risks associated with new product development and providing rapid issue resolutions to minimize disruption. Through effective team leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and proactive risk management, you will contribute to the organization's competitiveness by delivering high-quality, market-relevant products.

  

YOU MUST HAVE

* BTech/BE or higher in Instrumentation / Chemical / Computer Science or another related field
* Business analysis in a complex and Cross-Functional Stakeholder environment
* 3+ Years of experience in working with Industrial Automation Domain. Prior experience with DCS/PLC/Operator Training Simulator systems would be added advantage
* Candidates with prior experience in Process Industry would be preferred.
* 2+ years’ experience in Agile development environments as a Product Owner/Business Analyst
* Proficient in multiple Agile frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, design thinking, UX, and other frameworks. Must have good hands on with JIRA and Confluence tools usage.
* Strong understanding of software development methodologies and processes
Proven ability to apply analytical and critical thinking skills to solve, or lead the solving of, strategic problems of high complexity on a large scale  

WE VALUE

* Certifications in product management or agile methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner).
* Expert stakeholder management and commercial acumen to link both business and technical functions across a broad portfolio / large stakeholder group
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
* Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving capability.

  

Key Responsibilities:

* Consult product stakeholders to understand business drivers and translate them into functional and non-functional requirements
* You will work with Product Managers to evaluate the product Roadmap to identify features for development and identify "definition of done" for each feature
* Engage with customers/prospects with unique ability to create partnerships over contractual relationships
* Manage different stakeholders from across businesses and arrive at win-win solutions. Collaborate with stakeholders to define and prioritize technical requirements.
* Lead robust, fast (through) inceptions (identify scope, value, solution and release plan) and Own prioritized actionable backlogs
* Manage scope and drive trade-off decisions in conjunction with external stakeholders while balancing business requirements with technical requirements
* Elicit, capture, analyze, refine and document business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and other technical documentation
* Drive the development of technical specifications and ensure alignment with overall product strategy
* Provide technical guidance to the development team throughout the product lifecycle
* Research and analyze industry trends and benchmarking information as they apply to the HCI (Honeywell Connected Industrial) business model and domain area needs
* Dissect high-level information into details and communicate details in a manner understood by relevant audiences
* Attend standups, grooming meetings, estimation meetings, retrospectives and other key meetings for the scrum team
* Co-own Release Plans and communicate changes to stakeholders regularly
* Define Product roadmap based on various requirements gathered from consumers.
* Follow complete lifecycle of project benefit, including reporting back on adoption, business value and customer satisfaction post go-live
* Identify blockers that will impact timeline, scope, cost or other product variables and escalate to the appropriate stakeholders
* Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Assistant Branch Manager
description:
Job Description – Assistant Branch Manager (ABM)

Industry: NBFC

SalesReports To: Branch Manager (BM) / Cluster Manager (CM)Location: Branch

1. Job Purpose

The Assistant Branch Manager is responsible for supporting the Branch Manager in managing daily branch operations, business development, customer service, employee supervision, and achievement of business targets across Gold Loans, Insurance, and Investment products while ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

2. Key Roles & ResponsibilitiesA. Gold Loan Business

* Promote and generate new Gold Loan business through customer acquisition and referrals.
* Ensure achievement of daily, monthly, and annual Gold Loan targets.
* Assist in gold appraisal, purity verification, valuation, and loan processing as per company policy.
* Ensure proper documentation, KYC verification, and customer eligibility checks.
* Monitor loan renewals, overdue accounts, and customer follow-ups.
* Ensure safe custody of pledged gold and adherence to security procedures.
* Monitor daily gold loan transactions and ensure accuracy in system entries.
* Develop new customer relationships and improve existing customer retention.

B. Insurance Business

* Promote and sell insurance products offered by the company.
* Achieve assigned insurance business and login targets.
* Identify potential customers and generate insurance leads.
* Explain product features, benefits, eligibility, and terms to customers.
* Coordinate with insurance companies for policy issuance and customer service.
* Follow up on pending proposals, renewals, and policy-related requirements.
* Ensure proper documentation and compliance during policy sales.

C. Investment Business

* Promote and mobilise investment products offered by the company.
* Generate new investment leads and acquire potential investors.
* Maintain relationships with existing investors and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Follow up on investment renewals and maturity-related requirements.
* Explain investment schemes, terms, interest rates, tenure, and applicable conditions accurately.
* Achieve assigned investment mobilisation targets.
* Ensure proper documentation and compliance with company policies.

D. Branch Operations & Administration

* Support the Branch Manager in the overall functioning of the branch.
* Ensure smooth opening and closing of the branch as per company timings.
* Monitor daily transactions, cash handling, and operational activities.
* Ensure proper maintenance of registers, records, vouchers, and customer files.
* Monitor branch cleanliness, infrastructure, security, and asset maintenance.
* Ensure proper utilisation of company assets and resources.
* Coordinate with the Regional Office and Head Office for operational requirements.
* Ensure compliance with internal audit observations and corrective actions.

E. Team Management & Supervision

* Support the Branch Manager in supervising branch employees.
* Allocate daily activities and monitor individual employee performance.
* Motivate team members to achieve business targets.
* Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, discipline, and productivity.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with employees regarding business performance.
* Assist in training and guiding new employees on products and operational procedures.
* Report employee performance issues and operational concerns to the Branch Manager.
* Ensure proper coordination and teamwork among all branch employees.

F. Customer Relationship Management

* Ensure excellent customer service and customer satisfaction.
* Handle customer queries, complaints, and service-related issues.
* Build long-term relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer grievances.
* Maintain professional communication with customers and business associates.
* Encourage repeat business and customer referrals.

G. Compliance & Risk Management

* Follow all applicable RBI guidelines, KYC/AML requirements, and internal company policies.
* Ensure proper verification of customer documents and transaction details.
* Prevent operational irregularities, fraud, and unauthorised transactions.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer information and company data.
* Ensure adherence to gold loan security and insurance/investment compliance procedures.
* Immediately report suspicious activities, discrepancies, and policy violations to the Branch Manager.
* Support internal and statutory audits and ensure timely compliance.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance Area

Key Indicators

Gold Loan

Daily login, disbursement and outstanding growth

Insurance

Monthly insurance business and login achievement

Investments

Investment mobilisation and renewal

Customer Service

Customer satisfaction and complaint resolution

Team Performance

Individual and branch target achievement

Operations

Accuracy of transactions and documentation

Compliance

Audit observations and policy adherence

Discipline

Attendance, punctuality and reporting

Business Development

New customer acquisition and retention

4. Qualification & Experience

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 2–5 years of experience in NBFC, banking, or financial services.
* Experience in Gold Loan operations, Insurance, and Investment products is preferred.
* Good communication, sales, and customer-handling skills.
* Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with financial software/HRMS.
* Ability to manage a team and achieve business targets.

5. Required Skills & Competencies

* Leadership and team management.
* Sales and business development.
* Gold Loan operational knowledge.
* Insurance and investment product knowledge.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and decision-making.
* Communication and negotiation.
* Time management and target orientation.
* Compliance awareness and operational discipline.

6. Reporting & Accountability

The Assistant Branch Manager shall report directly to the Branch Manager and shall be accountable for assigned business targets, operational responsibilities, customer service, employee coordination, and compliance.

Work Location: In person

description:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. * Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

  

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 5+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

title: Senior Product Manager, Checkout

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the team and the role**
-------------------------------

The Checkout Experience team owns one of the most important moments in the buyer journey: helping customers complete their purchase with confidence, speed, and clarity. The space includes guest and member checkout, express payment experiences, checkout success, and key dependencies across cart, payments, shipping, and post-purchase experiences.

  
  

We are looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to lead complex, high-impact checkout initiatives that reduce friction, improve buyer trust, and unlock conversion at scale. * Influence cross-functional stakeholders and align teams around tradeoffs, sequencing, and success metrics.
* Contribute to the longer-term vision for checkout, including personalization, modernized flows, and AI-assisted experiences.
  

  

**What you will bring**

* Experience owning multiple customer-facing products or features end to end in a consumer, ecommerce, marketplace, or payments environment.

title: Product Manager
description:
Lab49 is an award winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.

We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.

Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier-one investment banks and many of the largest buy-side firms globally.

Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production.

We are seeking a Product Manager, who will be working with our clients in the high frequency trading space. One who has the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; .

### **Responsibilities**

* Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; should be comfortable facilitating discussions and working on cross-functional teams.
* Process Design: Lead sessions to understand current state processes and pain points; leverage this analysis and understand key requirements to help shape the future state process design and gain alignment across HCM and business stakeholders.
* Analytical Skills and Data Acumen: Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making. They should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and other reporting tools to analyze data.
* Requirements gathering and documentation acumen: Ability to gather, document and clearly articulate product requirements (i.e., user stories, data migration requirements, etc.).
* Technical Aptitude: Candidate should have a basic understanding of software development principles and be comfortable working with technical teams.
* Test Strategy & Execution: Work with functional and technical teams to shape the end-to-end testing strategy, spanning functional test and UAT; help test solution rigorously (along with HCM and business stakeholders) to surface and resolve critical defects ahead of a program’s launch
* Project & Change Management: Help project manage key deliverables, while helping execute against an innovative communication and training strategy – from drafting stakeholder messaging to creating high-quality learning collateral
* Understanding of Total Rewards Concepts (optional – specific to Rewards pillar): A foundational understanding of total rewards principles, including compensation structures, benefits packages (health, retirement, etc.), and other employee benefits is ideal.
* Oracle Core experience (optional): Foundational knowledge and understanding of Oracle HRIS including data management, system optimization and functionality

**Why Lab49?**

Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.

title: Principal Specialist - Product
description:
**About Udhyam**

Udhyam Learning Foundation (Udhyam) is on a mission towards Making Bharat Entrepreneurial. We believe that entrepreneurship is a powerful way to channelize an individual's potential. Entrepreneurship enables agency and allows an individual to work on their strengths while creating value for the world.

**Our programs**

  

* **Udhyam Vyapaar** focuses on nano businesses in India, and solving large problems faced by them, at scale; having already enabled an income uplift for close to 10,000 entrepreneurs.
  
* **Udhyam Shiksha** works on developing entrepreneurial mindsets among the youth and enabling them to achieve their potential, having impacted ~40,00,000 learners across 12 Indian states.
  

The goal for Udhyam is to build a thriving and supportive ecosystem, where every individual feels empowered to define their own path.

**Why this role exists**

Vyapaar works with nano-entrepreneurs: small shop owners, street vendors, home-based producers and a growing number of rural nano-entrepreneurs, many of them women. They run on thin margins, with patchy networks and limited digital literacy, and rarely in English.

Field operatives, M&E, and program and operations teams all need technology, and today those needs reach the tech team as separate requests. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to set the product vision and turn these needs into one roadmap, grounded in time spent in the field. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Head of Technology.

**What you'll own**

***Vision and strategy***

* Set a 2–3 year product vision for how technology and AI can help Vyapaar reach more nano-entrepreneurs and make field operatives more effective

* Own the product roadmap, combining field, monitoring (M&E) and operational requirements

* Prioritize with evidence (impact on nano-entrepreneurs, effort, cost, risk) and be clear about what we won't build

* Identify where AI meaningfully helps, and where it doesn't

***Field discovery***

* Spend about 20% of your time with field operatives and nano-entrepreneurs in rural and urban locations

* Run user research and quick prototypes with low-literacy, multilingual users

***Delivery and outcomes***

* Write requirements engineers can build from; make scope, sequencing and build-or-buy calls with them

* Plan pilots and rollouts with field teams, designing for multiple languages, voice and low-end Android

* Define success metrics, track adoption and outcomes, and work with M&E on impact measurement

* Make sure products respect privacy and consent, including India's DPDP Act

***Stakeholders***

title: Sr. SW Engineer
description:

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Software Development Engineers are expert problem-solvers and builders who design, implement, and improve software applications and systems. * Experience in debugging and troubleshooting software issues.
* Experience in code review and applying coding standards.
* Experience in test planning and execution for software features.
* Experience in responding to support requests and deploying fixes.
* Experience in using software developer tools for code creation and maintenance.

Preferred Qualifications:

* 3 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD).
* Experience building and testing enterprise-scale web services (minimum one year).
* Experience working on client-facing project or technical teams (minimum one year).
* Experience in integrating feedback into design and solution fixes.
* Experience in mentoring junior engineers and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Risk Manager I (Audits), Relay Product Excellence
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As a Risk Manager of the Quality & Audits team, you will be responsible for providing the overall management for a team of employees and direct leadership to the audit and investigation team, overseeing and developing employee performance and process improvement activities. This team conducts quality audits and risk reviews across multiple identity verification and compliance programs with investigatory resources and tools to validate identity. The group has responsibility for taking appropriate actions on accounts to protect Amazon from risk of account takeover and to prevent/mitigate fraud. The team aims and works towards zero fraud, zero account takeovers, zero false positives, and zero scams of any kind. The team seeks the best possible trade-off between customer experience and risk related losses, and when they have to make difficult choices, they will err towards the customer experience.  
  
You will be responsible for building and maintaining SOP's, implementing, managing and reporting through Metrics, Service Level Agreements and Key Performance Indicators through Strategic Leadership and Vision, Daily Operational Management and Continuous Process improvements. You will be responsible for building operational cadences and review mechanisms to enable the team to achieve performance standards. You will have a strong voice in the forecasting accuracy of audits and investigations, the necessary staffing requirements to achieve SLAs, and in ensuring all coaching, training needs are met. You will be a functional Operations owner, who works closely with the global program owners to design and deploy business strategies for enhanced Customer experience, including SLAs, First Contact Resolution, feedback on policies and decision quality and overall tools enhancements.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Manage a team of auditors and investigators across multiple identity verification and compliance programs
* Provide data analysis and conduct investigations as needed
* Pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed
* Take appropriate action to identify and help minimize the risk posed by fraud or abuse patterns and trends
* Identify and eliminate root causes of defects in order to drive efficiency in Amazon's operations
* Understand the business impact of trends and make data-driven decisions based on available data
* Systematically escalate problems or variances in information and data to the relevant owners and teams
* Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed
* Create narratives outlining weekly findings and variances to goals, and present these findings in review forums
* Achieve operational excellence and drive process improvements
* Develop employees and their skill sets to expand team capabilities
* Manage and execute for defined metrics and quality, maintain clear metrics on audit and investigation handling volumes, performance, and decision quality
* Drive operational efficiencies across all processing areas whilst improving internal and external customer experience
* Willing to work in rotational shifts in a 24x7 environment

  
About the team  
It's no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. Within Amazon's middle mile transportation network, our team provides scalable solutions across identity verification, quality audits, and process improvement programs – ensuring operational compliance and protecting the network from fraud and abuse. We proactively monitor processes, conduct risk reviews, and drive continuous improvement across multiple programs serving both North America and Europe. Our mission is zero fraud, zero account takeovers, and zero false positives – while always prioritizing the customer experience.
