* **REGULATORY COMPLIANCE:** Leads the team in promoting consistent application of accounting policies and internal controls related to product costing. Partners with process owners and FinOps to address gaps identified through audits and reviews.
* **COST ANALYSIS & REPORTING:** Leads the team in reviewing and interpreting cost and inventory results to identify business drivers, risks, and opportunities. Communicates insights and recommendations to business leaders and follows up with stakeholders on resulting actions.
* **SYSTEM & PROCESS CHANGE:** Represents regional product costing needs in SAP projects, system changes, and business initiatives. Guides the team in assessing process and business impacts, aligning stakeholders on key decisions, and supporting the adoption of agreed solutions.
* **INDUSTRY EXPERTISE:** Leads the team to stay abreast of industry regulations and cost accounting standards, ensuring compliance and driving continuous improvement in regional product costing practices.
* **TEAM MANAGEMENT:** Manages team members to achieve the organization’s goals by ensuring productivity, communicating performance expectations, creating goal alignment, giving and seeking feedback, providing coaching, measuring progress and holding people accountable, supporting employee development, recognizing achievements and lessons learned, and developing enabling conditions for talent to thrive in an inclusive team culture.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum requirement of 4 years of relevant work experience. Typically reflects 5 years or more of relevant experience.
* Intermediate level of SAP product costing knowledge and substantial experience applying it to costing processes, system and process changes, and business decisions.

title: Oracle Incentive Compensation Product Owner
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

Would you like to become a part of a company that uses the newest technology platforms in communications, software, video and services? Do you want to work with people who help save other people’s lives? Do you consider yourself to be a creative thinker and complex problem solver? If the answer is yes, join our rapidly expanding IT team.
  
Our IT organization isn’t just here to support our business. We’re here to reinvent it – by changing the way our customers, partners and employees interact with our company. To do that, we’re looking for people who bring great ideas and who make our partners’ ideas better. Intellectually curious advisors (not order takers) who focus on outcomes to creatively solve business problems. People who not only embrace change, but who accelerate it.

**Job Description**
-------------------

As the Oracle Incentive Compensation (OIC) Product Owner, you will drive the strategic implementation, optimization, and governance of our global Incentive compensation platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT engineering teams, ensuring incentive compensation plans, crediting logic, and payout calculations align with business strategy and operate seamlessly. By applying a data-driven approach and scalable product management principles, you will enhance accuracy and deliver high-impact automated compensation solutions. The role will involve driving the successful delivery of the solution while considering the end-to-end view.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Product Vision & Roadmap:** Define and maintain the product roadmap for Oracle Incentive Compensation for new acquisitions, aligning with global sales strategy.
* **Backlog Management:** Author detailed user stories, define acceptance criteria, and prioritize the sprint backlog to ensure the engineering team delivers maximum business value.
* **Requirements Gathering and Analysis:** Collaborate with stakeholders, customers, and internal teams to gather requirements. Conduct research, stakeholder analysis, and user feedback analysis to inform product decisions.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Collaborate with Sales Operations, Finance, and HR to translate complex compensation plans and quota models into functional system requirements.
* **Process Optimization:** Identify opportunities to automate manual processes.
* **UAT & Quality Assurance:** Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new releases, ensuring accurate incentive calculations.
* **Data and Process Governance:** Ensure seamless data flow between OIC (actuals/payouts) and upstream and downstream systems.
* **Data Driven / Prioritization:** Bring a data-driven approach to the product and provide insights into how the product is performing and capturing business value. Using those data insights, prioritize effectively to drive the product forward using data insights to make decisions

**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

* **Experience:** 6+ years of experience in Product Ownership or Business Analysis, specifically within the **Oracle Incentive compensation/Sales planning** suite.
* **Core Expertise:** Deep functional knowledge of **Oracle Incentive Compensation** (Rules engine, Plan components, Credits, and Payouts) and Sales planning process
* **Agile Mastery:** Proven track record working in an Agile/Scrum environment, managing ceremonies and using tools like Jira. Leading cross-functional teams and curating product backlogs.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Ability to troubleshoot complex logic within compensation formulas and SQL-based data sets.

* **Domain Knowledge:** Deep comprehension of product features, industry standards, and security protocols.
* **Solving:** Skill in maneuvering through ambiguous scenarios and resolving operational roadblocks independently.
* **Proactive Execution:** High initiative with a focus on achieving strategic objectives autonomously.
* **Analytical Aptitude:** Exceptional capacity for synthesizing intricate requirements into actionable functional specs.
* **Communication & Leadership:** Superior written and verbal skills, proficient at driving consensus across diverse stakeholder groups.

**Travel Requirements**
-----------------------

None

**Relocation Provided**
-----------------------

None

**Position Type**
-----------------

Experienced

**Referral Payment Plan**
-------------------------

No

***EEO Statement***

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: Group Product Manager

We are looking for a **Group Product Manager** Leader passionate about building customer-centric products and experiences. In this role, you will help define product vision and strategy, collaborate closely with engineering and design teams, engage directly with customers, and deliver productivity solutions in a flagship app in the M365 suite. Our teams are building the next generation of AI capabilities in the M365 suite for millions of users worldwide to improve how people communicate, organize information, and get work done, all while working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

Set direction and priorities for your area, make the hard trade-offs, and hold the line on scope, sequencing and quality. Ensure consistent delivery excellence through Microsoft methodologies, quality standards and governance.

* Drive alignment across cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders to achieve shared outcomes.

* Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and communicate results and impact to leadership.
* Support go-to-market efforts by partnering with marketing, sales, and business teams to drive adoption and customer success.
* Foster a culture of innovation, customer obsession, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Lead and develop product managers through coaching, clear expectations and accountability. Model Microsoft's Model, Coach, Care leadership culture — creating an environment where people grow and perform at their best. Partner with capacity and resource teams to align the right skills to the right work at the right time. Own the professional development of the people in your area, including onboarding, ongoing feedback and career growth, and provide managers with in-depth insight into their performance.

* Bachelor's Degree AND 10+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
  + OR equivalent experience.

* Exceptional analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills; data-driven by default.
* Excellent communication, writing and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated use and adoption of AI in real-life product practices, applying AI agents and tools to research, analysis, specification, prototyping and decision-making, and raising that bar across the team.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Staff, AI Product Manager
description:
**Job Purpose:**

  

**How This Differs from Traditional Product Management**
========================================================

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

* Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems.
* Work with probabilistic systems, defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight.
* Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to AI agents and workers, and how they hand off.

Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes

  

* Owns the Orchestration and Automation platform tower and its roadmap.
* Takes consolidation decisions across the low and medium code platform estate.
* Acts as the platform consultant for business teams building on the estate.

Owns the governance model that defines what a citizen developer may build unsupervised

**Responsibilities**:

  

**Platform Portfolio & Consolidation**
--------------------------------------

* **Map capability against actual usage** across the whole low and medium code estate, and recommend what consolidates, what stays, and what retires.
* **Quantify value rigorously.** Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, manual effort removed, licence cost avoided, automations running in production.
* **Develop deep automation pattern recognition** so you can spot the workflows worth automating and the ones that should be fixed at source instead.

**Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping**
------------------------------------------------

* **Shape the platform roadmap.** Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized platform work, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader AI Platforms & Tools portfolio.
* **Make trade-off recommendations.** When two business sponsors both want platform investment, define the success metrics, run the analysis, and recommend where effort goes.
* **Protect engineering focus.** Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes.

**Required Skills:**

  

* 16+ years of progressive experience in enterprise platform leadership, with a meaningful part of it spent owning a platform or platform estate end to end: roadmap, architecture direction, operations, and lifecycle.
* Demonstrated track record of taking a platform from fragmented or underused to well run: consolidation calls made, adoption grown, and the operating model that sustained it.
* Experience running a platform in a regulated enterprise, with working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain and the data, decisions, and constraints inside it.
* Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML, covering LLMs, agentic systems, AI agents and workers, data and evaluation patterns, sufficient to set architecture direction, challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Experience leading engineers directly while also leading a far larger citizen developer community through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking.
* A platform product heritage: roadmap shaping, lifecycle and version management, vendor and licensing ownership, service levels, and stakeholder alignment across a large and varied user base.

**Preferred skills**:

  

* Deep, hands-on Microsoft Power Platform experience is mandatory: Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse at enterprise scale, including environment strategy, ALM, licensing, and the governance model around them.
* Has owned a low or medium code automation platform at enterprise scale and run a citizen developer or self-service programme covering thousands of users, with guardrails that held under pressure.
* Fluent with the wider low and medium code agent and workflow stacks that sit alongside Power Platform, such as Copilot Studio, n8n, and the equivalents from the major cloud vendors.

**Skills**

AI Platforms, Change Management, Data Analysis, Microsoft ALM, Microsoft Power Apps, Microsoft Power Automate, Microsoft Power Platform, Roadmap Development, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis

We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. title: Associate Director - Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

**Job Purpose**

The Associate Director - Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability is responsible for maximising the value of a specific Product by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Senior Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability guides Product Analysts and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead.
* Co-create the product vision and roadmap with the business and own the value case, including the expected benefits and how they are measured.
* Own and manage the Product backlog, ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead (clear RACI boundary).
* Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Product Analysts and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.

* Own and prioritise the AI product backlog, translating Engineering, EHS and Sustainability needs into clear AI use cases, epics, features and acceptance criteria.

* Lead AI-enabled product delivery across business stakeholders, engineers, architects, data specialists, security, quality and third-party providers.
* Ensure responsible and compliant use of AI, including appropriate human oversight, data protection, security, validation, traceability and regulated change controls.
* Monitor AI product performance after release, using operational metrics, user feedback and evaluation results to identify improvement priorities.

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* Typically 5+ years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
* Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
* Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
* Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.
* Experience owning or delivering an AI, Generative AI, advanced analytics or intelligent automation product.
* Experience translating business problems into prioritised AI use cases, product requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Experience leading cross-functional delivery involving business SMEs, architects, engineers, data teams, security and compliance functions.
* Experience defining and monitoring AI product KPIs, evaluation criteria, adoption measures and benefits realisation.
* Experience delivering technology products in a regulated or highly controlled environment, with appropriate governance, validation and change control.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
* Skilled in coaching and guiding Product Analysts and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
* Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
* Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
* Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.
* AI product management: Ability to identify, assess and prioritise AI use cases based on business value, feasibility, data availability, risk and cost.
* Generative AI understanding: Good working knowledge of large language models, Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents and human-in-the-loop solutions.
* AI evaluation: Ability to define acceptance criteria and performance measures covering accuracy, relevance, consistency and user value.
* Responsible AI and risk management: Understanding of privacy, security, transparency, human oversight and risks such as unsupported or misleading outputs
* Stakeholder communication: Ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations and trade-offs clearly to business and technology stakeholders.

title: Senior Product Manager - Engineering, EHS & Sustainability
description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

The Senior Product Manager - Engineering, EHS & Sustainability is accountable for maximising the value of a coherent product family or business capability domain supporting Engineering (asset management and capital projects management), EHS, or Sustainability by translating business strategy, process needs and user outcomes into a clear product vision, roadmap and investment plan. Operating within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Domain Lead, the Product Manager balances business value, user experience, technical feasibility, cost, risk, compliance and operational sustainability throughout the product lifecycle.

The Senior Product Manager works closely with Product Owners, Business Process Owners, Architects, Engineers, Service Managers, Data and Cyber Security teams and external partners. The role sets product outcomes and priorities, guides delivery choices and ensures that Product Owners have sufficient strategic context and decision guardrails to manage backlogs and releases effectively. The Product Manager remains accountable for the overall coherence of the product roadmap and for demonstrating that investment is improving business performance, adoption, reliability and user experience.

The role also identifies opportunities for simplification, standardisation, automation and responsible use of data and AI. Recommendations should remain capability-led and technology-agnostic, with solutions selected because they deliver the required outcome and can be integrated, secured, validated, supported and sustained within the enterprise environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with Business Process Owners, functional leaders and users to understand strategic priorities, process pain points and unmet needs and translate these into clear product outcomes.
* Define and maintain the product vision, strategy and roadmap for an assigned product or capability area, aligned to domain strategy and enterprise technology direction.
* Develop outcome-based investment proposals and contribute to business cases by defining value hypotheses, costs, benefits, risks, assumptions, dependencies and measures of success.
* Set prioritisation guardrails for Product Owners and make roadmap trade-offs based on value, cost, urgency, risk, compliance, operational continuity, capacity and technical dependencies.
* Guide Product Owners and delivery teams so that epics, features and releases remain aligned to product outcomes and do not become disconnected collections of requirements.
* Partner with Solution and Enterprise Architects to assess solution options and ensure designs are secure, integrated, scalable, supportable and aligned to architecture and data standards.
* Establish and review product performance measures covering adoption, process outcomes, stability, service effort, user experience, delivery flow and benefit realisation; use insights to adjust priorities.
* Ensure product initiatives comply with required governance for cyber security, data protection, quality, validation, change control, service readiness, continuity and records management.
* Lead product-level vendor and solution evaluations using transparent, capability-led criteria and contribute to commercial decisions, supplier performance reviews and lifecycle planning.
* Manage product risks, technical debt, dependencies and obsolescence, ensuring decisions and escalations are documented and addressed through the appropriate governance forums.
* Drive adoption and operational readiness by ensuring business change, training, support model, documentation, release communications and onboarding needs are reflected in plans.
* Promote iterative, user-centred and data-led ways of working and create a culture focused on measurable outcomes, learning, simplification and continuous improvement.
* Identify and prioritise AI opportunities based on business value, user needs, data readiness, technical feasibility, risk and total cost of ownership.
* Define the product vision, roadmap, outcomes and investment case for AI-enabled capabilities across Engineering, EHS and Sustainability.
* Lead AI initiatives from discovery and experimentation through delivery, adoption, scaling and benefits realisation.
* Define measurable success criteria for AI products, including business outcomes, adoption, user experience, output quality, reliability and operational impact.
* Ensure AI-enabled products meet responsible AI, cybersecurity, privacy, validation, human-oversight and service-readiness requirements.

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Professional certifications in product management, agile delivery, portfolio management, finance or change leadership are desirable.
* Typically 5+ years of experience in product management, digital transformation, technology delivery, business systems, manufacturing technology, supply chain technology or a related discipline
* Proven experience developing a product vision and roadmap for a product, platform or defined capability area.
* Proven experience in the following business domains:
* Engineering: Plant Maintenance, Calibration, Validation; Content Management, Capital Project Management
* EHS: Incident& Accident Management, Occupational Health, Industrial Hygiene, Chemical Compliance;
* Sustainability: Energy Efficiency, Renewable and Clean Energy, Waste Management
* Experience translating business priorities and user needs into product outcomes, investment proposals and delivery priorities.
* Experience working with Product Owners and cross-functional delivery teams throughout discovery, design, delivery, release, adoption and operation.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on value, cost, risk, compliance, operational impact, resource capacity and technical dependencies.
* Experience defining product measures and using adoption, process, stability, service and user-experience insights to improve performance.
* Experience contributing to business cases, forecasting costs, tracking benefits and supporting funding decisions.
* Experience operating within governance requirements covering architecture, cyber security, data protection, quality, validation, change and service readiness.
* Experience evaluating suppliers or solution options and managing vendor contributions to product outcomes.
* Experience influencing senior functional stakeholders in a global matrix organisation.
* Experience developing product strategies, roadmaps or business cases for AI-enabled, data-driven or advanced analytics products.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams spanning Product, Engineering, Data/ML, Cyber Security, Compliance and business SMEs.
* Experience taking AI-enabled features from discovery and experimentation through release, adoption and scale-up.
* Experience defining value hypotheses, success measures and acceptance criteria for AI use cases.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools, such as Copilot, AI assistants, analytics or experimentation platforms, to support product discovery, backlog refinement and stakeholder communication.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to convert ambiguous business challenges into clear product choices and roadmaps.
* Strong communication, facilitation and influencing skills across business, technical and operational audiences.
* Commercial and financial acumen, including the ability to evaluate cost, value, benefits, risk and total cost of ownership.
* Ability to use data and evidence to challenge assumptions, prioritise investment and evaluate product performance.
* Working understanding of enterprise architecture, integration, data, cyber security, validation, service and operational resilience.
* Ability to create alignment across teams with different objectives, cultures, geographies and levels of technical knowledge.
* Strong judgement, accountability and escalation discipline, with a clear understanding of decision rights.
* Commitment to technology-agnostic, capability-led evaluation and to simple, reusable and supportable solutions.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in day-to-day product work (e.g. copilot tools, AI assistants, analytics platforms, experimentation tooling) to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience leading cross-functional squads (product, engineering, data/ML, security, compliance) to deliver AI-driven features from discovery through scale-up.
* Strong understanding of generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation and analytics from a product-management perspective.
* Ability to assess whether a business problem is appropriate for AI or would be better addressed through process simplification, rules, automation or conventional technology.
* Ability to translate Engineering, EHS and Sustainability needs into clear AI product outcomes, use cases and roadmap priorities.
* Understanding of AI-specific product risks, including inaccurate outputs, poor data quality, inappropriate automation, limited explainability and user over-reliance.
* Ability to define and use business, adoption, quality, risk and operational measures to evaluate AI product performance

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: FuSa SW Product Owner
description:
* **Major Accountabilities:**

  Contribute to the development and execution of Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) activities for software components and systems, ensuring compliance with automotive safety standards and regulations.

  Identify potential failure modes, assess their effects on system safety, and define mitigation strategies to eliminate or reduce associated risks, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with project objectives.

  Ensure compliance with automotive safety standards, regulations, and guidelines, such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, and SAE J3061, throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC), from requirements analysis to release documentation.

  Apply expertise in embedded systems to assess and enhance the functional safety of software components and systems deployed in automotive environments, leveraging knowledge of microcontroller architectures, real-time operating systems (RTOS), and automotive communication protocols.

  Collaborate with hardware engineers and system architects to integrate functional safety requirements into the design and development of embedded systems, ensuring the safety and reliability of automotive software applications.

  Participate in the design and development of safety-critical algorithms for automotive applications, employing rigorous engineering practices and methodologies to ensure the integrity and reliability of algorithmic implementations.

  Conduct algorithm SW maturity assessments and fault analysis to identify potential weaknesses or vulnerabilities in algorithm designs, implementing corrective actions as necessary to mitigate safety risks and improve overall system robustness.

  Define and document safety requirements for software components and systems, ensuring alignment with system-level safety goals and objectives.

  Establish traceability between safety requirements and system-level requirements, facilitating the verification and validation of safety-critical software functions and features throughout the development life cycle.

  Develop and maintain technical documentation related to functional safety engineering activities, including safety requirements specifications, safety case documentation, and verification and validation reports.

  Engage with internal and external stakeholders, including project teams, customers, and regulatory authorities, to communicate safety-related information, address concerns, and solicit feedback on functional safety engineering activities.

  Act as a subject matter expert on functional safety topics, providing guidance and support to project teams and stakeholders to facilitate informed decision-making and ensure compliance with safety standards and regulations.

title: Lead Digital Product Manager - Agentic Operations
description:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Digital Product Manager for Agentic Operations who will lead the day-to-day management, optimization, governance, and performance of AI agents that support Marketing business operations. This role combines product ownership, operations management, AI fluency, analytics, risk management, and stakeholder engagement to ensure agentic solutions deliver reliable, measurable, and compliant business outcomes.

* Manage operational guardrails for agent and LLM usage, ensuring agent activity stays within defined thresholds for time, cost, risk, autonomy, escalation, and business-approved use.
* Establish and monitor controls that prevent unmanaged agent behavior, including runaway loops, excessive retries, unsupported tool use, policy exceptions, and outputs that exceed approved risk tolerance.
* Oversee the resilience of agent operations by defining fallback paths, failover routines, human-in-the-loop escalation, exception handling, and continuity plans when agents, models, tools, or knowledge sources are unavailable or degraded.
* Monitor and improve agent response-time performance across priority workflows, identifying latency drivers and partnering with technology teams to optimize routing, orchestration, caching, context handling, and service-level expectations.

* Maintain visibility into token usage, model consumption, cost trends, and capacity requirements at the agent, workflow, business area, and portfolio levels.
* Translate token, cost, latency, risk, and usage data into capacity management recommendations that keep the agentic operating model aligned with business-area strategic priorities.
* Develop executive-ready reporting that communicates agent health, performance, resilience, risk posture, capacity consumption, and recommended prioritization decisions.

title: Operations specialist, CSBA
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you customer obsessed, flexible, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, hungry and passionate about e-commerce? Are you an experienced professional with a strong work ethic and a bias for action? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you. The ideal candidate is energized by digging into messy data, forming a hypothesis, finding the root cause, and driving a fix to closure across multiple teams and locations. We are looking for an Operations Specialist who shares Amazon's passion for the customer, someone who understands that a dependable delivery and fulfillment experience is central to how both sellers and buyers experience the Amazon platform.  
  
In this role, you will work closely with sellers, seller support, customer service, sales, and third-party carriers to identify delivery and fulfillment issues that sellers face, and resolve their acute and short-term problems. You will investigate why sellers struggle with or leave fulfillment programs, separate seller-owned gaps from Amazon-owned gaps, and recommend specific fixes. You will also partner with product management teams to translate recurring seller pain points into longer-term features and programs that improve the seller and customer experience.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Monitor operational performance and partner with other teams (third-party carriers, customer service, seller support, product, operations) to resolve performance issues and keep metrics within goal.  
Monitor and drive seller-impacting operational tickets and escalations to resolution within defined service levels, flagging anything at risk of breaching its window ahead of time.  
Run structured deep dives into seller friction and program attrition: pull and sanity-check the data yourself, form a hypothesis, establish the root cause with transaction-level evidence, identify whether the gap sits with the seller or with Amazon, and recommend a fix.  
Review and investigate incoming seller issues and feedback from multiple sources, and route each finding to the right team with a clear owner and next step, leaving nothing open at the end of the week.  
Size cost and savings opportunities across marketplaces and fulfillment methods, explaining what the numbers mean rather than passing dashboard output through unchanged.  
Build and run recurring operational reports (including automating them where possible) and produce weekly business-review inputs that lead with the headline metric, the week-over-week movement, and the reason for any change.  
Gather and analyze seller contacts and feedback to develop seller-experience improvement suggestions, and work with Product Managers on solutions.  
Must be open to working on Saturday and Sunday, with any other 2 days of the week off.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of data-driven business operations processes experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
* Experience with Excel

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
* Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies

title: Product Owner - ERM
description:
**Job Title: Product Owner – ERM**

* The Product Owner turns business vision into customer value by acting as the voice of the customer and the primary point of contact for demand for the team. The role manages and prioritises a transparent product backlog, translates user and business needs into actionable items, and assures clear linkage through the golden thread from strategy to delivery. Working closely with business users, Product and Technology leads, Architects and the Agile Team, the Product Owner enables the realisation of agreed OKRs and delivers compliant, secure and scalable outcomes. The role also provides delivery assurance, supports product roadmap development and balances new change with operational resilience and institutional risk considerations.

**In this role, you will:**

* Define, communicate and cascade the product vision, value proposition, OKRs and roadmap across the end-to-end team so everyone remains aligned on what is to be built and why.
* Own the backlog end-to-end by managing intake and demand, expressing backlog items with acceptance criteria, prioritising demand and keeping the backlog visible, transparent and clear.
* Translate customer and business needs into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria, including decisions on what not to build where value is not evidenced.
* Build, refine and maintain a rolling wave product roadmap aligned to wider Value Stream and SVS goals, the Future State Architecture and re-use of existing assets where possible.
* Work with the Agile Team to evaluate solution options through prototyping, user research and early, continuous feedback on incremental releases.
* Make trade-off decisions based on value, risk and dependencies, including balancing short-term and long-term priorities, operational resilience and change.
* Accept or reject release-ready and released solutions against the Definition of Done and agreed acceptance criteria, and sign off product releases on behalf of users where required.
* Align and actively manage stakeholders across Business and Technology, resolve conflicting priorities and maintain clear communication with users and key stakeholders.
* Provide delivery assurance by inspecting outcomes, evaluating progress, supporting Agile ceremonies, PI and QPI events, and protecting team focus on prioritised work items.
* Ensure compliance, risk management and operational resilience are addressed within product scope, while supporting Agile, SAFe, CoE and Community of Practice best practices.

**To be successful you will:**

* Strong product management capability, with strategic thinking and a clear orientation towards value creation and delivery outcomes.
* Agile and SAFe acumen, including backlog ownership, prioritisation, delivery assurance and decision-making under uncertainty.
* Ability to identify and understand customer and business needs, and translate them into actionable backlog items, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing, negotiation and conflict resolution across Business and Technology.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to align stakeholders to the product vision, roadmap and OKRs.
* Awareness of compliance, institutional risk, operational resilience and quality requirements within product scope.

**Desirable (nice to have):**

* Critical thinking, analytical problem-solving and data management literacy.
* Technology services awareness and the ability to work closely with Architects in keeping with the Future State Architecture and re-use of assets where possible.
* Experience of building and maintaining rolling wave product roadmaps and supporting PI or QPI planning events.
* Leadership without line management, including a coaching mindset and the ability to help enable high-performing, self-managed teams.
* Continuous improvement mindset and willingness to participate in relevant Centres of Excellence and Communities of Practice.

**Additional Notes**

* This role owns backlog, prioritisation and value decisions within product scope, but does not carry direct line management responsibility, technical implementation decisions, budget ownership or enterprise-wide strategy setting.
* The Product Owner is expected to maintain a robust single intake management process, preserve the golden thread from strategy to delivery, meet the Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and make consistent use of the tooling spine.
* Good practice includes maintaining a transparent, well-groomed backlog, engaging stakeholders early and often, using data and feedback to inform decisions, prioritising based on value and risk, and ensuring compliance and security are built in rather than bolted on.
* Common pitfalls include acting as a mini project manager instead of a value owner, dictating technical solutions, allowing the backlog to become stale or unprioritised, overpromising or providing poor communication.

title: Manager, Mortgage Disclosure
description:
**About the team**

The Mortgage Disclosures team delivers accurate, timely, and compliant initial and revised loan disclosures that help borrowers understand their mortgage terms and progress confidently through the lending process. The team partners with Loan Officers, Processing, Underwriting, Closing, Compliance, and technology teams to maintain a consistent disclosure experience.

We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

**About the role**
------------------

As Manager, Mortgage Disclosures, you will lead a team of Disclosure Analysts responsible for the timely preparation, review, delivery, and tracking of mortgage disclosures. You will own operational performance across compliance, quality, turnaround time, and customer experience while building scalable workflows and developing a high-performing team.

  

**What You’ll Do**
==================

  

* Lead, coach, and develop Mortgage Disclosure Analysts; establish clear performance expectations and provide ongoing feedback, training, and career support.
* Own daily disclosure operations, including queue management, workload distribution, capacity planning, escalation handling, and service-level performance.

* Maintain robust controls and audit readiness for disclosure workflows, documentation, system records, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Own onboarding, calibration, quality reviews, SOPs, job aids, and change communications for the Disclosure team.
* Drive continuous improvement through process redesign, automation opportunities, Encompass enhancements, and clearer cross-functional handoffs.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

**Who you are**
---------------

  

* 7+ years of U.S. residential mortgage experience in disclosures, processing, closing, compliance, or a related mortgage-operations function, including 2+ years of people leadership or team-lead experience or 5+ sole Experience in encompass Disclosure and closing.
* Strong knowledge of mortgage disclosure workflows, including Loan Estimates, Closing Disclosures, redisclosures, fee accuracy, and timing requirements.
* Experience with Encompass or a comparable loan origination system and document-generation or e-signing tools.
* Demonstrated ability to manage high-volume operations through quality, productivity, turnaround-time, and compliance metrics.
* Strong analytical judgment, written and verbal communication, coaching, and cross-functional stakeholder-management skills.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

title: Senior Product Manager I (Adtech)
description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  
  
**Job Description**

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead products and capabilities that measure national and local television audiences across linear broadcast, cable, and streaming environments. This role sits at the intersection of media measurement, data science, technology, and client needs—turning complex viewing signals into trusted, actionable audience insights for programmers, advertisers, agencies, and other media stakeholders.

The ideal candidate understands how television is bought, sold, distributed, and measured across fragmented platforms. You will define product strategy, translate industry requirements into an actionable roadmap, and guide cross-functional teams from concept through launch and ongoing improvement.

What you’ll do

* Own product strategy and roadmap for cross-platform television audience measurement capabilities spanning national and local markets.
* Translate customer, market, and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, success metrics, and prioritized investments.
* Partner with data science, engineering, research, operations, sales, and customer success to deliver scalable, reliable measurement products.
* Drive measurement solutions across linear and streaming environments, including audience estimates, reach and frequency, impressions, demographic reporting, time-shifted viewing, and deduplicated cross-platform audiences.
* Evaluate the integration and use of viewing data from panels, return-path data, set-top boxes, smart TVs, streaming platforms, and other data sources while maintaining methodological rigor.
* Lead discovery with clients and industry stakeholders to identify unmet needs and validate product direction.
* Define operating models and quality standards that support data accuracy, comparability, transparency, and timely delivery across national and local markets.
* Communicate product vision, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
* Mentor product managers and contribute to stronger product practices, decision frameworks, and team development.

 **Qualifications**

What you bring

* 6+ years of experience in product management, media measurement, audience analytics, advertising technology, streaming, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience taking data-intensive products from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of television and video ecosystems, including broadcast, cable, streaming, connected TV, local markets, ad-supported programming, and media buying.
* Familiarity with audience measurement concepts such as ratings, share, reach, frequency, impressions, demographics, viewing duration, co-viewing, time shifting, and cross-platform duplication.
* Experience working with large-scale data sets, data partnerships, APIs, and/or analytical platforms; comfort partnering deeply with technical teams.
* Ability to balance methodological integrity, customer value, operational feasibility, and commercial priorities.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Experience influencing without direct authority in a matrixed, cross-functional environment.

Success in this role

In the first year, you will establish a clear roadmap for cross-platform television measurement, strengthen alignment between customer needs and delivery teams, and launch improvements that increase trust, usability, and coverage across national and local audiences.

Why join us

You will help shape the next generation of television audience measurement as viewing continues to fragment across traditional and streaming platforms. This is an opportunity to influence an industry-critical product area, work with sophisticated data and technology, and make measurement more transparent, comparable, and useful for the marketplace.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Product Manager - Power & Industrial Products
description:
**Job Description**

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

1. Position Purpose

The Product Manager for Mors Smitt RMS Power & Industrial Products is accountable for

the commercial and technical success of the assigned product portfolio throughout its

lifecycle. The role develops portfolio strategy and recommendations in alignment with

the Engineering Director and leadership team, translating market insight, customer

needs and business objectives into sustainable growth, profitability and product

innovation.

The Product Manager serves as the voice of the customer and market within the

organisation, leading cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Sales, Operations,

Supply Chain and Quality to deliver competitive, compliant and profitable products.

This role is critical to driving portfolio growth, sustaining legacy products and

introducing the next generation of utility protection solutions.

2. Key Responsibilities

2.1 Product Strategy and Roadmap

* Own the development, maintenance and recommendation of product and

technology strategies for the assigned portfolio, ensuring alignment with the

* Engineering Director, business leadership team and RTPE strategic objectives.
* Develop clear product roadmaps, portfolio positioning and business cases.
* Analyse market, customer and competitor data to inform long-term product

direction.

* Ensure alignment with RTPE and Wabtec strategic objectives.

2.2 Product Lifecycle Management

* Manage the full product lifecycle from introduction to end-of-life.
* Accountable for portfolio performance, including revenue, margin, cost,

reliability and competitiveness.

* Monitor product performance, quality, reliability and obsolescence status.
* Own and maintain all product data and collateral (datasheets, specifications,

approvals, test reports).

* Ensure compliance documentation is accurate, current and accessible.
* Drive sustaining engineering priorities, including cost reduction, obsolescence

and reliability improvements.

* Drive actions to improve margin, cost position and portfolio competitiveness.
* Own portfolio revenue, margin, growth and market competitiveness targets.
* Develop annual portfolio plans, forecasting demand, investment requirements

and strategic priorities.

* Identify opportunities for portfolio expansion, rationalisation and technology

refresh.

* Recommend investment decisions supported by market, technical and financial

analysis.

* Own the commercial success of new product introductions from concept

through market launch.

2.3 Product Requirements Management

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Regulatory and Trade Services (ARTS Tech)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

ARTS Tech is seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer to build services that make the cross-border movement of products, software, and technology secure, lawful, and seamless. You will design and operate scalable systems that support trade classification, import and export controls, product compliance, and global expansion. This role offers the opportunity to solve complex greenfield problems, work with emerging Amazon businesses, and deliver durable solutions used across Amazon's global footprint.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate scalable distributed services for cross-border trade and regulatory compliance.
* Translate ambiguous business and regulatory requirements into simple, maintainable technical solutions.
* Own the architecture and delivery of major features, including effort estimation and rollout planning.
* Build reliable, secure, and observable systems that meet performance and availability goals.
* Collaborate with product managers, compliance specialists, UX designers, and engineers across Amazon.
* Participate in code reviews, operational support, and continuous improvement.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to hiring and team development.

  
A day in the life  
You will work with product, compliance, and engineering partners to clarify customer needs, review designs, and build services that operate at Amazon scale. A typical day may include writing and reviewing code, resolving production issues, making architecture decisions, and planning delivery with your Scrum team. You will own the systems you build, use operational data to improve them, and help teammates grow through thoughtful design and code reviews.  
  
About the team  
Amazon Regulatory and Trade Services (ARTS) Tech builds systems that enable the secure, lawful, and efficient movement of products, software, and technology across international borders. Our solutions support trade classification, duties and import costs, export and import restrictions, and product compliance. We serve Amazon businesses—including Global Store, Direct Imports, Devices, Robotics, and Physical Stores—as well as sellers, vendors, carriers, customs brokers, and freight forwarders. We value ownership, pragmatic engineering, operational excellence, and collaborative problem solving.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Staff Engineer, Software
description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

Do you have a passion for innovative ideas and groundbreaking discoveries? With over $1 billion invested annually in R&D, at Thermo Fisher Scientific you’ll help solve some of the world’s toughest challenges, from giving cancer patients hope, ensuring safe drinking water and helping law enforcement tackle cases through forensics. We empower our teams to put science into meaningful action and give our R&D colleagues the autonomy, resources and tools they need to take science a step beyond.

**How you will make an impact**

You will be part of an innovative software team that develops instrument software that control an instrument and allows scientists to interact with instrument features intuitively. You will work closely with product managers and engineering teams around the world to develop the instrument. You will work on sophisticated solutions using full stack technology and reusable UI components.

**What you will do**

* Design and implement features based on requirements and specifications.
* Well verse in object-oriented programming and functional code design.
* Develop a novel UX, implementing the design provided by an internal team
* Development and support of GUI, analysis, communications, and instrument control software
* Integration of algorithms & mathematical functions for identification and quantification of data collected by instruments
* Understand the business needs, analyze the workflows, and carry out integrations across different sub-components.

**How you will get here**

**Education:**

Degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience

**Experience, Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* 10+ years of software development experience in the software industry, preferably involving hardware and software integrations. Candidates with varying levels of experience are encouraged to apply and may be considered for positions commensurate with their experience.
* 10+ years of knowledge of current software development methodologies, cybersecurity, recent trend in cybersecurity and its remediation methodology.
* 3+ years strong experience in AI tools, techniques, solutions using LLMs, RAG, AI agents
* 10+ years of strong experience with modern web technologies and full-stack development is required.
* Experience in source control (i.e., GitHub) and CI/CD pipeline.
* Previous experience of developing web applications using front-end technologies like Angular, React, VueJS and Electron is a plus.
* Proven background in core Java or Python.
* Good understanding of data structures, design patterns, object-oriented design, and algorithms used in programming.
* Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills. Ability to manage high priority tasks and adapt to changes in priorities. Effectively communicates and illustrates ideas; contributes critically and positively to a team.

**Leadership Skills**

* **Strategic Leadership :** Sets a clear vision, aligns priorities, and drives execution toward business goals.
* **Decision-Making :** Makes timely, data-driven decisions while balancing business priorities and risks.
* **Communication & Influence :** Communicates with clarity and inspires alignment across diverse teams and levels.
* **Results Orientation :** Translates strategy into measurable outcomes while maintaining focus on quality and continuous improvement.

**About Thermo Fisher Scientific**

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with an annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 130,000 colleagues delivers an unrivalled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

title: Senior Manager - SN Automation Engineering Product Analyst
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The SERVICENOW Automation Engineering Product Analyst supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with the Automation Engineering Architect, they help shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Automation Engineering Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product. In addition, this role supports the iTSM Service Catalog and will work in partnership with SERVICENOW Automation Engineering Architect for conversational/automation of forms and MSP service catalog factory for basic forms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
* Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
* Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
* Document functional and technical specifications needed to deliver changes and support configuration or code delivery by providing clear design inputs; maintain configuration repositories and version updates where applicable.
* Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
* Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
* Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
* Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to identify and implement automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)

**Area of Specialisation**

* Strong business knowledge in a relevant functional domain (e.g., IT, Finance, R&D), with the ability to analyse business challenges using structured frameworks, model end-to-end processes (e.g., BPMN), and support delivery through familiarity with Agile practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban).

**Experience Required**

* Overall 10 years and typically 2–4 years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments; building process flows and facilitating stakeholder sessions.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.

**Skills/Background**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

**Skills**
