title: Staff, AI Product Management (Global Functions)
description:
**About the Role:**

GSK’s Enterprise AI team, a highly skilled applied AI group, translates the promise of AI into measurable impact across every major group at GSK — R&D, Medical, Commercial, Supply Chain, HR, Legal, Finance, and beyond. Bionic pods — AI product managers, forward deployed engineers, full-stack engineers, data engineers, and digital workers — embed directly with scientific and business teams to build AI products that change outcomes.

We are hiring a Staff, AI Product Manager (Director level equivalent role) to own a major slice of our Global Functions portfolio and act as the strategic counterpart to the engineers and digital workers in your pod, setting the forward deployed strategy they execute against. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can identify and shape high-value AI opportunities across the key areas of Global Functions - HR, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, or Finance, build the case to fund and deploy against them, and ensure FDEs are working on what matters most. You will not manage engineers; you will shape what they build in your domain and how we measure whether it worked.

**Why This Role Exists:**

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. Enterprise AI has no separate strategy layer: the AI Product Manager sets the forward deployed strategy, and the pod executes it. This role closes that gap at this level by ensuring the engineers we deploy are working on the right things.

In this role you will be the person who:

* Owns a clear domain or capability area within the Enterprise AI opportunity portfolio.
* Identifies, sizes, and shapes the highest-value AI opportunities in that domain.
* Partners daily with forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads to scope and steer engagements end-to-end.
* Builds the business and executive alignment the pod needs to land and scale.

**How This Differs from Traditional Product Management:**

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

* Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems rather than evolving an established platform.
* Work with probabilistic systems — defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight instead of fixed functional requirements.
* Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to digital workers, and how they hand off.
* Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes, not features shipped or system uptime.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Opportunity Identification & Value Sizing:**

* **Hunt for high-value AI opportunities** within your assigned domain at GSK; develop a structured pipeline of opportunities ranked by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value.
* **Quantify value rigorously.** Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, cost avoided, scientific productivity gained.
* **Develop deep domain pattern recognition** so you can spot AI-shaped problems in workflows the business itself hasn’t yet articulated.

**Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping:**

* **Shape the opportunity portfolio in your domain.** Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized opportunities, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader Enterprise AI portfolio.
* **Make trade-off recommendations.** When two business sponsors both want an FDE pod, defines the success metrics, run the analysis and recommend where engineers go.
* **Protect engineering focus.** Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes.

  

**Engineering Partnership & Enablement**

* **Be the strategic counterpart to forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads in your domain.** Translate ambiguous business problems into crisp problem statements, prototypes, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can build against.
* **Shape engagements end-to-end.** Define scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways before kick-off, then stay close as engineers execute.
* **Surface re-use and platform leverage** when a one-off solution should become a reusable capability.
* **Design the human–digital split.** Decide which tasks the pod’s digital workers own, where engineers and business users stay in the loop, and how evaluation and oversight make that safe.

**Stakeholder Alignment & Communication**

* **Operate fluently with VP-level business and scientific leaders.** Run conversations that turn fuzzy ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements.
* **Build sponsor coalitions** that secure data access, change-management commitment, and air cover for your engagements.
* **Communicate impact clearly** in language that connects AI work to patients, science, and enterprise outcomes.

**Measurement, Learning & Iteration**

* **Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework** to every engagement in your domain and improve it with what you learn.
* **Run honest post-mortems** and feed lessons back into how your domain selects opportunities.

**Required Functional Experience:**

* 18+ years of progressive experience spanning some combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML product strategy, and senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organisations.
* Demonstrated track record of identifying, scoping, prototyping, and shepherding high-value technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding into delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain — R&D, clinical, medical, manufacturing, commercial, or an enterprise function — including the data, decisions, and constraints inside it.
* Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML — LLMs, agentic systems, and digital workers, ML lifecycle, data and evaluation patterns — sufficient to leverage evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Experience operating as a senior individual contributor — leading through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking rather than headcount.
* A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software.

**Skills**

AI Platforms, AI Product Management, Generative AI, Machine Learning (ML), Production Strategy, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Roadmap, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. title: FED LEAD- L6
description:
**What You'll Do**

* Set front-end technical direction across complex programmes or multiple delivery workstreams and coordinate leads and developers towards shared outcomes.
* Own the front-end development approach, coding standards, component strategy, branching model, review practices and definition of done.
* Design scalable application architecture, component boundaries, routing, state management, data access and micro-frontend patterns where appropriate.

* Validate estimates and technical approaches, ensuring plans include appropriate testing, security and risk mitigation.
* Identify technical or delivery risks early, propose options and escalate quickly when required.

* Serve as a trusted technical adviser for senior clients, programme leadership, product, UX, back-end and QA teams.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Front-End Engineering & Architecture**

* 10+ years of progressive front-end development experience with a proven record of leading React.js, Next.js or Angular delivery.
* Deep expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, Tailwind CSS, jQuery and modern browser behaviour.
* Strong hands-on experience with React.js and Next.js, including hooks, component composition, routing, server-side rendering, static generation, data fetching and state management such as Redux Toolkit, Context or comparable approaches.
* Strong working experience with Angular, including components, services, RxJS, routing, forms, dependency injection and change detection.
* Experience designing modular, testable and maintainable front-end architectures, including monorepos, shared libraries or micro-frontends where suitable.
* Ability to evaluate frameworks and libraries, define upgrade strategies and manage compatibility, dependency and technical-debt risks.

**User Experience, Accessibility & Performance**

* Experience implementing responsive interfaces from design specifications and collaborating effectively with UX and visual design teams.
* Strong knowledge of WCAG-aligned accessibility, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation and assistive-technology considerations.
* Experience with browser developer tools, performance profiling, Core Web Vitals, bundle optimisation, lazy loading, caching and rendering performance.
* Understanding of front-end security practices, including secure authentication flows, input handling, dependency hygiene and common web risks.

**Testing, DevOps & Delivery**

* Strong unit, integration and end-to-end testing practices using Jest, React Testing Library, Jasmine, Karma, Cypress, Playwright or comparable tools.
* Experience with Git-based workflows, pull-request governance, package management and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to validate estimates, plan technical delivery and ensure adequate automated testing and risk mitigation.
* Experience working in Agile delivery and communicating decisions, trade-offs, risks and recommendations clearly to clients and stakeholders.

* Experience with other modern web delivery models and progressive web applications.
* Experience with design systems, Storybook, component documentation and visual regression testing.
* Exposure to Node.js, backend-for-frontend patterns, cloud platforms and content management systems.
* Experience with web analytics, experimentation, personalisation, observability and production telemetry.

* Hands-on lead developer who can direct a front-end team while remaining close to architecture, critical code and delivery risk.
* Calm, accountable leader who can navigate ambiguity, crucial conversations and changing priorities.
* Strong architectural judgement with the ability to explain trade-offs and influence implementation.
* Proactive risk manager who validates estimates and introduces practical mitigation.
* Client-focused communicator who builds technical rapport and recommends clear solutions.
* People-focused technical lead who develops senior and junior engineers, builds succession capability and maintains consistent engineering standards.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on enterprise-grade web products and digital transformation programmes.
* Collaborate with experienced product, design, engineering and client teams.
* Grow through hands-on delivery, knowledge sharing and modern front-end engineering practices.
* Join a flexible, inclusive and high-performing engineering culture.

title: Media Analyst
description:

Target is an iconic brand, a Fortune 50 company and one of America’s leading retailers.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Marketing organization. Target Marketing is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights and then craft every interaction to build brand love.

----------------

In this role, you will work closely with digital paid channel teams, ensuring flawless media planning, ad set-up, optimization and performance & insights. You will coordinate and support campaigns and channels across external platforms/ad servers with various buying strategies. You will be expected to identify, recommend and execute scalable operational tactics to support the brand, engagement and performance results.

This role will be accountable to participating and enforcing key business enhancements in relation to tagging, trafficking, creative rotation, dynamic capabilities, third-party verification and all other campaigns management related functions. This vital role will continuously evolve our campaign performance and ensure stringent compliance. You will bring a data-driven approach and an eye toward technological advancements that will make Target first-to-market in the digital media space. It’s critical that this role focus on efficiencies through automation, ensuring business and brand goals are consistently achieved. You will have worked in various digital media and social platforms (IG, TikTok, YouTube, DCM, DMPs, Ad Servers) and you are expected to keep pace with the Digital and Social Advertising industries and help translate relevant industry developments into recommendation and new ideas for Target that lead to more simplicity and efficiencies in nurturing Target’s external advertising presence.

**About You**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Marketing, Advertising, Economics, Business, Analytics, Data, or a related field.
* 4+ years of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, media planning, campaign management, trading, optimization, or media analytics.
* Strong hands-on experience managing large-scale paid media campaigns across programmatic, search, social, retail media, display, video, CTV, and/or other digital channels.
* Deep understanding of full-funnel performance marketing and how media impacts awareness, consideration, conversion, retention, and revenue growth.
* Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Amazon Ads, DV360, The Trade Desk, DSPs, ad servers, retail media platforms, and measurement systems.
* Proficiency with campaign management platforms, analytics platforms, BI/reporting tools, and marketing technology stacks such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, DMPs, CDPs, MMPs, or similar tools.
* Strong analytical ability with experience interpreting large datasets, identifying trends, diagnosing performance issues, and translating data into actionable recommendations.
* Understanding of brand safety, viewability, fraud prevention, inventory quality, tracking, tagging, attribution, and measurement best practices.
* Ability to evaluate creative and content assets for channel fit, messaging alignment, compliance, and performance effectiveness.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, stakeholder management, problem-solving ability, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
* Passion for media, data, analytics, technology, continuous improvement, and mentoring team members.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Implementation Engineering)
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**Forward Deployed Engineer (Implementation Engineering)**

*Embedded, hands-on engineering with enterprise customers building AI-native software delivery*

Harness builds the AI Software Delivery Platform used by engineering organizations to automate testing, deployments, application security, reliability, and cost optimization across the software delivery lifecycle. The company is led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal, founder of AppDynamics, and is backed by leading investors. Harness customers use the platform to ship software faster while maintaining strong security and governance, and the company's AI Agents are extending that automation across the entire delivery lifecycle.

We are looking for exceptional engineers to join our fast-growing global team and help build the future of AI-native software delivery.

**Position Summary**
====================

Forward Deployed Engineers work embedded inside enterprise engineering teams to design and build AI-native automation on the Harness platform. This is a hands-on, code-first role. You will write production code and scripts, build production pipelines, and connect Harness AI Agents into a customer's existing systems, staying engaged until the capability is live in production. You will work directly alongside customer engineers, turning business objectives into working software rather than documentation or advice.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Embed inside a customer's engineering organization for the length of a build engagement to design and build agent-driven automation across the software delivery lifecycle.
* Write production code connecting Harness AI Agents to a customer's pipelines, repositories, ITSM tooling, security systems, and infrastructure.
* Partner directly with customer engineering stakeholders and the broader Harness delivery team to translate an approved plan into working software.
* Prototype quickly, ship incrementally, and iterate directly with customer engineers rather than handing off a static design document.
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and share them with the broader Harness delivery organization.
* Bring direct feedback to Harness product and engineering teams based on what you learn building in real customer environments.
* Support the transition from custom build to steady-state operation so the customer can independently operate and extend what you built.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* A working, production agent integration lives in the customer's environment by the end of the engagement.
* A reusable pattern or template captured in the Solutions Factory as a direct result of the build.
* Customer engineering stakeholders are able to operate and extend the integration without an ongoing Forward Deployed Engineer presence.
* Healthy, ongoing customer adoption of the Harness platform and AI Agents beyond the specific build, achieved by working closely with the customer throughout the engagement rather than handing off at go-live.
  

**About You**
=============

* A platform engineering or software engineering background, with hands-on coding, scripting, and integration ability, not configuration-only experience. You are comfortable working directly in a customer's codebase, infrastructure workflows, and CI/CD frameworks.
* Experience building integrations against APIs, event-driven systems, or LLM and agent orchestration frameworks.
* Prior experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, architecture, or embedded consulting capacity where success was measured by working software, not documentation or advisory output.
* Strong grounding in CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code, plus depth in at least one adjacent domain, such as security, observability, or cost management, sufficient to reason about where an agent should plug into a customer's software delivery lifecycle.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity: able to work from a business objective and an agent's capability boundary to a working integration without a pre-written specification.
* Excellent stakeholder communication, able to work day to day with customer engineers while keeping internal stakeholders aligned on progress.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites for the duration of an active build.

### **Harness in the news:**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. title: Sr Product Manager, Listings, EM SX
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Every day, millions of customers rely on Amazon to give them access to one of the world's largest selection of consumer goods. Catalog is foundational to Amazon retail, acting as the base for both the customer and fulfilment shopper CX. At same time, we need to make the catalog creation process aka Listings simpler for our sellers. Our vision is to enable SPs of any size to list their selection quickly, easily and in a self-service manner. The EM SX Listings team creates tools to enable sellers to create high quality listings on amazon with minimum friction. We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own & drive improvements to simplify seller experience in listings their products on Amazon across desktop, mobile and APIs.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The primary objective of this role is to facilitate the effortless creation of Amazon listings by sellers. The role entails the crucial responsibility of empowering selling partners, comprising both sellers and vendors, to efficiently and effectively list their products on the Amazon marketplace. The goal is to ensure that these product listings maintain their buyability for the maximum possible duration, all while simplifying the process and minimizing hurdles for sellers to qualify for Amazon's platform.  
The individual in this role will have end-to-end ownership, which includes defining the overall strategy, collaborating with engineering and machine learning teams to develop solutions, and meticulously monitoring metrics to track progress across Amazon's extensive eCommerce pipeline. Furthermore, they must grasp the intricacies of emerging markets and strategize accordingly for sellers within the Amazon ecosystem. This necessitates close collaboration with numerous global teams, often requiring the ability to influence without direct authority. It is also imperative that the role holder stays abreast of the latest technological advancements, including Large Language Models, and present a product strategy that leverages these innovations to simplify the listing process.  
This role is highly influential, with significant business impact, and provides visibility to leaders both in India and across the global platform teams. Regular updates to senior leadership are essential, and it requires a high degree of ownership, a bias for taking action, and thinking on a grand scale in an environment where contributions are distributed among multiple stakeholders. Exceptional influencing skills are crucial to drive initiatives forward. Additionally, international connectivity is key, and the individual must be willing to invest in building networks with business and tech teams on a global scale.  
A successful candidate for this role should have a proven background in product management, scaling systems with extensive data sets, and a track record of delivering results in a fast-paced setting. Strong development experience, familiarity with software development cycles, and a history of managing large cross-functional projects are essential. Given the inherent ambiguity in the role, analytical thinking and superb problem-solving skills are also prerequisites, as many of the challenges are unique to Amazon's vast scale.  
  
A day in the life  

* Manage business and technical requirements, ensuring overall coordination, quality, and acting as the primary contact for global stakeholders of your products and goals.
* Collaborate with scientists, economists, and engineers to deliver scalable ML models and generate customer insights at scale, while building project roadmaps.
* Apply scientific, engineering, and business best practices to drive innovation.
* Create high-quality documents (narratives & PR FAQs) to articulate your vision and report on initiatives to senior leadership.
* Influence feature and priority decisions with tech and platform teams based on overall impact and speed to market.
* Advocate for the needs of Emerging Market customers on a global stage.

  
About the team  
The Emerging Market Seller Experience (EM SX) team envisions Amazon as the preferred marketplace for Selling Partners in Emerging Markets. They strive to simplify the process for any Selling Partner to launch and expand a successful business on Amazon. The Listings team within this group develops tools and products that reduce friction for Amazon sellers when listing their products. Serving as the voice of sellers in Emerging Markets (including IN, MENA, APAC, LATAM), they create user-friendly, scalable solutions to address their unique needs.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager to lead the strategy, design, and delivery of next-generation compliance technology solutions across traditional payments, digital assets, stablecoins, and AI-enabled compliance capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of Compliance, Product and Technology driving the development of platforms that enable scalable compliance controls while supporting business growth and innovation. The successful candidate will possess deep expertise in Financial Crime Compliance (AML, Sanctions, KYC, Transaction Monitoring), strong knowledge of Crypto and Stablecoin ecosystems, and a passion for leveraging Artificial Intelligence to transform compliance operations.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Ownership:

* Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and strategy for Compliance Technology platforms.
* Drive product innovation across AML, Sanctions Screening, Customer Due Diligence, Transaction Monitoring, Case Management, and Regulatory Reporting.
* Develop scalable compliance solutions supporting both traditional payment rails and digital asset ecosystems.
* Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for automation, operational efficiency, and risk reduction.

Financial Crime Compliance:

* Translate regulatory requirements into product features and technical capabilities.
* Design and enhance controls supporting:
  + AML/CFT
  + Sanctions Screening
  + KYC/KYB & Customer Due Diligence
  + Transaction Monitoring
  + Enhanced Due Diligence
  + Regulatory Reporting
  + Case Management & Investigations
* Collaborate with Compliance Operations teams to optimise alert management and investigation workflows.

Crypto & Stablecoin Compliance:

* Lead compliance technology initiatives supporting stablecoin-enabled payment products and digital asset ecosystems.
* Design controls for:
  + Blockchain analytics
  + Wallet screening
  + On-chain transaction monitoring
  + Travel Rule compliance
  + Crypto onboarding and risk assessment
  + Stablecoin transaction monitoring
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to embed compliance controls within digital asset products and services.
* Evaluate emerging regulatory frameworks and assess impacts on product and technology strategies.

AI & Emerging Technologies:

* Champion the application of AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Intelligent Automation across compliance programs.
* Develop AI governance, explainability, and model oversight requirements in partnership with Compliance and Risk teams.
* Evaluate AI vendors and emerging technologies to strengthen compliance capabilities.

Technical Product Delivery:

* Translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications and user stories.
* Work closely with architects and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions.
* Lead integrations with internal platforms and external providers.
* Manage product backlogs, prioritisation, UAT, production validation, and release planning.
* Leverage data analytics to identify trends, improve performance, and enable data-driven decisions.

Stakeholder Leadership:

* Serve as the primary liaison between Compliance, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Commercial teams.
* Lead requirement workshops, design reviews, and governance forums.
* Influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across global teams.
* Present strategy, roadmap progress, and key decisions to executives and leadership teams.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, or related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Compliance Technology, FinTech, Payments, or Financial Services.
* Deep understanding of:
  + AML/CFT frameworks
  + Sanctions Compliance
  + Customer Due Diligence
  + Transaction Monitoring
  + Financial Crime Investigations
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale compliance technology solutions.
* Strong knowledge of payments, money movement, and fintech ecosystems.
* Experience working within Agile product delivery environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with Crypto, Digital Assets, Stablecoins, Blockchain Analytics, or Travel Rule solutions.
* Knowledge of stablecoin regulatory frameworks and compliance controls.
* Experience implementing AI/ML-enabled compliance solutions.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data architecture, and system integrations.
* Knowledge of ISO 20022, ISO 8583, and modern payment architectures.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Associate Director - Product Owner - LES
description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

The Product Owner is responsible for maximising the value, compliance, adoption, and operational performance of the LabWare Lab Execution System (LES) used to digitise and control QC laboratory test execution. The role translates QC, Quality, site, and regulatory needs into a prioritised LabWare LES backlog and leads delivery across the product lifecycle within strategic, financial, architectural, and GxP guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. The Product Owner works closely with laboratory stakeholders, Quality, CSV, Tech, suppliers, and delivery teams to ensure LabWare LES capabilities are usable, validated, secure, supportable, inspection-ready, and aligned to standardised laboratory execution processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with QC laboratory, Quality, site, and digital stakeholders to understand laboratory execution needs and define LabWare LES outcomes that improve compliance, data integrity, analyst experience, and operational efficiency.
* Own and manage the LabWare LES product backlog, ensuring epics, features, user stories, configuration needs, master data impacts, reporting requirements, validation expectations, and dependencies are clearly defined and prioritised.
* Make backlog prioritisation decisions based on GxP impact, business value, laboratory criticality, data integrity risk, defect severity, release capacity, cost, and cross-site standardisation opportunities, escalating strategic trade-offs to the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead.
* Lead delivery activities for LabWare LES changes, guiding Product Analysts, configuration specialists, testers, CSV resources, architects, engineers, and supplier teams to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, validated, secure, supportable, and aligned to architecture and quality standards.
* Ensure LabWare LES changes support controlled laboratory execution, including electronic worksheets, procedural step guidance, calculations, specifications, instrument or system interfaces, review-by-exception, audit trails, electronic signatures, and exception handling where applicable.
* Drive operational readiness by ensuring support model impacts, SOP updates, training materials, release communications, cutover plans, hypercare, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place before deployment.
* Maintain product performance measures for LabWare LES, including adoption, release throughput, defects, incident trends, validation progress, user experience signals, support effort, and benefits realisation; use insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes comply with GxP, CSV, data integrity, security, privacy, access control, change control, and supplier governance expectations, obtaining input and approvals from Quality, CSV, Security, Architecture, and other SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects and technical teams in assessing design options, integrations, environment management, reporting, performance, and dependencies with LIMS, instruments, ERP, document management, identity management, and other connected systems.
* Act as an escalation point for LabWare LES functional issues, defects, prioritisation conflicts, and release readiness decisions, balancing business continuity, compliance risk, user impact, and delivery capacity.
* Promote agile, iterative, value-driven delivery practices while maintaining the discipline required for validated systems, including traceability from requirements through design, build, testing, approval, release, and ongoing periodic review.

**Basic Requirements:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Life Sciences or related field (or equivalent experience).

* Typically 5+ years of experience in product delivery, laboratory informatics, LabWare LIMS / LES, QC laboratory systems, or process-led technology roles in a regulated environment.
* Proven experience defining, prioritising, and delivering requirements for laboratory execution, LIMS / LES, electronic worksheets, analytical workflows, reporting, interfaces, or validated laboratory systems.
* Experience working directly with QC laboratories, Quality, CSV, IT, suppliers, and site stakeholders to translate laboratory needs into feasible, compliant, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on GxP impact, data integrity risk, user impact, business continuity, technical complexity, cost, and delivery capacity.
* Experience supporting validated system delivery, including requirements, configuration, testing, defect triage, release readiness, change control, and deployment into controlled laboratory environments.
* Familiarity with regulated change management, periodic review, audit trail review expectations, user access governance, supplier management, and quality documentation for GxP systems.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches that simplify laboratory processes, reduce manual transcription, improve right-first-time execution, and increase adoption of standardised digital laboratory ways of working.
* Experience working within agile or hybrid delivery environments while maintaining appropriate validation, traceability, and release controls for regulated systems.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's network segmentation product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.

* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

title: Product Manager - Commercial Card Product
description:

As a Product Manager (Vice President) at JPMorganChase within the Commercial and Investment Bank in the Payments Treasury unit you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you act as the voice of the customer and develop profitable products that provide customer value. You guide product launches, gather feedback, and ensure strong client experiences. You collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products with a focus on scalability, resiliency, and stability.

This role focuses on setting product direction, leading discovery, and delivering iteratively with an agile team to improve adoption, customer experience, and operational outcomes. The scope includes building partner-ready platform capabilities, supporting safe and compliant launches, and managing external integrations with networks and vendors. The role requires comfort using data to define success metrics, evaluate trade-offs, and drive prioritization decisions. The role also includes evaluating where artificial intelligence can create practical customer value within product experiences and workflows.

Job Responsibilities

* **Set** product strategy and vision for your product area to deliver clear customer value, and translate that vision into a prioritized roadmap.
* **Lead** customer discovery and market research (for example, interviews with treasury, accounts payable, and procurement; analysis of card usage, activation, and spend leakage) to identify problems worth solving and validate solutions.
* **Own** the product backlog end-to-end, including prioritization, clear requirements, and well-defined acceptance criteria that align to the strategic roadmap and value proposition.

* **Build** platform- and partner-ready capabilities by shaping application programming interface products, sandbox experiences, and developer documentation for financial technology partners, enterprise resource planning platforms, and accounts payable automation providers.
* **Coordinate** cross-functionally across the bank (risk, compliance, legal, fraud, operations, technology, and sales) to ensure launches are safe, compliant, reliable, and on schedule.
* **Manage** external partnerships and integrations with networks and vendors (for example, Visa, Mastercard, processors, and financial technology partners) to deliver new capabilities.
* **Define** and track success metrics by establishing a key performance indicator framework and reporting to leadership across adoption, spend volume, interchange revenue, Net Promoter Score, time to onboard, cost, risk posture, and reliability.
* **Evaluate** and introduce new technologies where they create client value, including artificial intelligence–driven expense categorization, enhanced fraud signals, and automated or agent-based payment flows.

* 4+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a shipped digital product, additionally 7+ years combined experience in product management, engineering, or payments roles

* Working knowledge of application programming interfaces and platform products, including the ability to read interface specifications and discuss design trade-offs with engineers.
* Comfort with data, including defining metrics and using analytics to drive decisions; ability to read or write Structured Query Language (SQL)
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, from engineering stand-ups to executive readouts.
* Experience working with risk, compliance, or legal partners in a regulated environment.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

* Demonstrated experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization.
* Experience at a financial technology firm or in a bank–financial technology partnership, including embedded finance or banking as a service.
* Commercial card, business-to-business payments, or treasury experience (for example, purchasing card, travel and expense, virtual card, accounts payable automation, or supplier enablement).
* Familiarity with card network rules, interchange economics, and issuer processing.
* Exposure to enterprise resource planning and spend platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Coupa, or Workday.
* Engineering background or technical degree.
* Experience applying artificial intelligence or machine learning in a product, with awareness of model risk governance expectations; knowledge of real-time payments rails (such as the Real-Time Payments network and the FedNow Service) and a Master of Business Administration are a plus.

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
* India
* 7189
* Employee Regular Full Time

**Job Description**
-------------------

Overview  
  
  

**Are you ready for what’s next, now?**
  
  
**About the Role**

The **Staff** **Product Manager – Data & Analytics** supports the definition and evolution of Aptean's semantic data models and Analytics Packages across business domains and products. The role translates business processes, metrics, reporting requirements, and underlying product data into reusable semantic definitions that can support analytics and AI use cases. Working closely with domain SMEs, customers, Product, Data Engineering, and Architecture, this role drives requirements from discovery through definition, technical validation, and customer validation. The role requires a strong combination of product thinking, business analysis, analytics, and hands-on understanding of relational data and data modeling.

We need a candidate who sits with an ERP SME or business user, understand the business process; inspect the underlying data/schema; define the business entities/KPIs; map source concepts to the semantic model; write requirements detailed enough for Engineering; validate the implementation (reports, AI query, or Agent outputs) with SMEs/customers.

  

**Knowledge:**

Requires strong working knowledge of data and analytics concepts, including relational data models, business entities and relationships, semantic modeling, analytical metrics/KPIs, and data transformation from operational systems into analytics-ready structures.

Requires the ability to understand business processes and reporting requirements and translate them into detailed data and semantic-model definitions. You must be comfortable analyzing source schemas, tables, fields, relationships, and existing reporting assets in partnership with Engineering and domain experts.

Requires working knowledge of product management and business analysis practices, including requirements definition, customer and SME discovery, prioritization, documentation, validation, and cross-functional product development.

Knowledge of enterprise software, ERP systems, modern cloud data platforms, BI tools, and AI-enabled analytics is preferred.

  

**Complexity:**

Works across multiple business domains, ERP/product schemas, and analytics use cases where business terminology, source data structures, and customer requirements may differ.

Translates sometimes ambiguous business questions and existing reporting requirements into standardized entities, measures, dimensions, relationships, KPIs, and semantic definitions that can be reused across products and customers.

Balances standard product requirements against ERP-specific and customer-specific requirements and identifies where extensions to the governed model are required.

Works through dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, domain SMEs, Professional Services, customers, and other stakeholders to move semantic-model and Analytics Package work from discovery through validation.

This reflects the actual scope in the resourcing case: reusable semantic models are intended to span Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, Quality and other domains, with iteration occurring across ERPs and eventually non-Aptean systems.

  

**Supervision:**

Works with a high degree of independence within defined product priorities and objectives.

Receives strategic direction from the Director, Product Management – Analytics & Data Products and independently drives assigned semantic-model domains and Analytics Package workstreams.

Coordinates work across technical and business stakeholders but does not initially have direct people-management responsibility.

Escalates significant product, data, architecture, and prioritization decisions where broader alignment is required.

  

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Define business semantics and domain models.
* Lead discovery with product SMEs, customers, and internal stakeholders to understand business processes, entities, relationships, terminology, business questions, metrics, and KPIs. Translate these inputs into detailed, reusable semantic-model requirements and domain definitions.
* Analyze source data and define source-to-semantic mappings.
* Work with Product and Data Engineering teams to understand existing products and ERP schemas, including relevant tables, fields, keys, relationships, and business logic. Define and document how source data maps to standardized business entities, dimensions, measures, and relationships within the semantic model, and identify gaps requiring transformation or extension.
* Define Analytics Packages
* Translate business questions, KPIs, reporting requirements, and semantic-model capabilities into reusable Analytics Packages across functional domains such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, and Quality. Define package requirements, measures, dimensions, reporting experiences, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.
* Driving semantic-model requirements through Engineering
* Partner closely with Data Engineering and Architecture to convert product requirements into implementable semantic-model capabilities. Clarify requirements, resolve data and business-rule questions, review model implementations against intended business semantics, identify gaps, and support prioritization through delivery.
* Validate models and packages with customers and SMEs
* Plan and conduct validation sessions with domain SMEs, customers, and implementation teams to confirm that semantic definitions, KPIs, business rules, and Analytics Packages accurately represent real-world processes and reporting needs. Convert validation findings into prioritized product requirements and model improvements.
* Standardize capabilities across products and customers
* Compare requirements and source structures across ERP products and customer environments to distinguish reusable business concepts from product- or customer-specific requirements. Help establish canonical definitions while identifying where governed extensions are necessary.
* Maintain product artifacts and semantic-model documentation
* Create and maintain clear product artifacts including business definitions, entity and relationship definitions, KPI specifications, source mappings, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision logs, Analytics Package specifications, and supporting documentation required by Engineering and downstream product teams.
* Support analytics and AI product evolution
* Use customer feedback, product usage, implementation learning, and emerging requirements to identify opportunities to improve semantic models and Analytics Packages. Support the evolution of the semantic layer as a governed business context for analytics, natural-language analytics, Analytics Agents, and broader AI and Decision Intelligence capabilities.
  

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree, Preferred fields**:** Computer Science, Information Systems, Data/Analytics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative/technical discipline.
* Master's degree: A Master's degree in a relevant technical, analytics, or business discipline is preferred but not required.

**Shift**: UK Shift

  

**Recommended:** 12+ years of relevant professional experience in product management, product analysis, business analysis, data/analytics, enterprise software, or a related discipline.

Experience should include meaningful hands-on work translating business requirements into data, analytics, reporting, or semantic-model requirements.

Experience working with enterprise applications, ERP data, analytics products, data platforms, or complex relational data environments is strongly preferred.

Experience collaborating directly with software/data engineering teams and business/domain stakeholders through discovery, requirements definition, implementation, and validation is strongly preferred.

**Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of relational data concepts, including tables, keys, joins, relationships, normalization, and dimensional/analytical modeling.
* Understanding of semantic modeling, including business entities, dimensions, measures, metrics, hierarchies, relationships, and business definitions.
* Understanding of how operational application data is transformed and modeled for analytics and reporting.
* Working knowledge of business intelligence and analytics concepts, including KPIs, dashboards, reporting, data quality, and analytical requirements.
* Understanding of product-management and business-analysis practices including discovery, requirements definition, prioritization, acceptance criteria, and validation.
* Familiarity with enterprise/ERP business processes such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, or related domains.
* Familiarity with modern cloud data and analytics platforms is preferred.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics, natural-language analytics, or semantic layers supporting AI applications is beneficial.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Strong SQL and data-analysis capability, with the ability to independently explore relational datasets and understand source schemas, relationships, and business logic.
* Ability to translate business processes and questions into entities, relationships, dimensions, measures, KPIs, and semantic definitions**.**

title: Product Manager
description:
**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as a Product Manager in the Core HCM domain . In this role, you will be responsible for leading initiatives to streamline and improve Global HR processes, ultim ately enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and employee experience across the organization in line with company policies and compliance.

**About this role:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. This is a strategic, solution-oriented position where you will collaborate with global leaders and cross-functional teams—including process owners, technology, security, and support functions—to accelerate implementation timelines, manage the product lifecycle, reduce operational issues, apply prioritization frameworks, and build a transparent, high-quality product roadmap.

The role is weighted roughly 50–70% product management and 50–30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

Feature Prioritization & Backlog Management

* Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).

Requirements & Development Oversight

* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Quality Assurance & Testing

* Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies—particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios—and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.

Stakeholder Engagement & Product Evangelism

* Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.

User-Centric Design & Feedback Loops

* Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

Training & Change Enablement

* Collaborate with change management teams to develop training materials, user guides, and communication plans that support adoption and maximize product value.

Security & Integrations Awareness

* Work with security and integration teams to understand the downstream and upstream impact of Core HCM changes (e.g., Change Job, Termination, data changes) on business process security, access, and integrations, ensuring product decisions account for these implications.

**Process**

Process Design & Documentation

* Conduct comprehensive assessments of current Hire to Retire processes (excluding Hire), particularly Change Job, Termination, and related data management workflows, to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

* Develop, implement, and maintain process documentation and guidelines, ensuring these are scalable and adaptable across regions and business units, and are clearly reflected in the supporting Workday configuration.

Process Standardization

* Develop and maintain global standards for Change Job, Termination, and data management processes to enable consistency and compliance across all regions.

* Conduct regular checks to identify variances and areas for optimization, and facilitate the sharing of best practices across regions.

Process Simplification & Automation

* Use data-driven insight (including process mining where available) to identify complex, redundant, or unnecessary steps in Change Job, Termination, and data management processes, and redesign them to remove bottlenecks and reduce errors.

* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and evaluate technology solutions that streamline processes and enhance the employee and HR user experience.

Continuous Improvement

* Implement continuous improvement initiatives—drawing on methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen where relevant—and define metrics and KPIs to measure process performance and track progress.

Change Management & Compliance

* Lead process change management activities tied to product releases, including training, documentation, and progress monitoring.

* Ensure Change Job, Termination, and data management processes comply with relevant data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements; support audits and help implement corrective actions where gaps are identified .

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (preferred).

* Minimum 7 years of experience as a Digital or Software Product Manager and/or Process Owner in the HR Technology domain.

* Deep, hands-on expertise in Workday Core HCM, with demonstrated strong expertise in the Change Job business process specifically; solid working knowledge of Termination and data management processes.

* Broad working knowledge of Workday more generally, with the ability to understand how Core HCM changes interact with other modules.

* Working knowledge of Workday security (e.g., domain and business process security) and integrations, sufficient to identify downstream impacts and collaborate effectively with specialist teams.

* Strong understanding of HR processes and systems in large, global, and matrixed organizations, including the wider Hire to Retire lifecycle.

* Strong experience working with agile methodologies and tools such as Jira (or similar), including facilitating agile ceremonies (e.g., stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives).

* Demonstrated strength in crafting clear, well-structured user stories and acceptance criteria.

* Experience in process design, standardization, and continuous improvement; familiarity with methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to develop business cases for automation and process improvements.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.

* Experience working with industrial or frontline organizations (e.g., retail, manufacturing, logistics ) is a plus.

* Passion for innovation and driving meaningful change in the HR tech landscape.

title: Software Design Engineer - LabVIEW
description:
**Role Summary:**

This position is responsible for software development of new products, with emphasis on user interfaces and device communication for wired and wireless industrial communication networks. The role also develops modular, scalable LabVIEW applications and integrates software with industrial hardware and test systems.

**Principle accountabilities:**

1. Design and code modular, scalable LabVIEW applications using Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), state machines, and producer-consumer architectures.

2. Interface LabVIEW software with NI DAQ devices, PLCs, HMIs, vision systems, electronic testers, and laboratory instruments.

3. Implement industrial communication protocols, including Modbus, HART, Foundation Fieldbus, PROFIBUS, OPC, FDT 1.2, FDT 2.0, and FDI, as applicable.

4. Develop automated test equipment (ATE), functional end-of-line test benches, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems.

5. Develop, test, and debug software code using contemporary tools and techniques.

6. Support the preparation of design documents, artifacts, and work products.

7. Work across all phases of the software development lifecycle.

8. Work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating with senior-level engineers who provide guidance on assigned tasks.

9. Continually update technical knowledge and skills.

**Educational Qualification & Experience:**

1. Bachelor’s degree **in electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Instrumentation Technology.**

2. Experience in software development for the Industrial Automation domain preferred; experience with FDT 1.2, FDT 2.0, OPC, and FDI is an advantage.

3. Experience in device description (EDDL) and device type manager (DTM) development.

4. Experience with LabVIEW application development and industrial test/measurement systems is preferred.

**Competencies and Skills:**

1. Knowledge of programming languages and technologies: C++, VC++, C#, JavaScript, SQL, XML, and EDDL.

2. Knowledge of **industrial communication protocols**, including HART, Foundation Fieldbus, PROFIBUS, Modbus, and OPC.

3. Knowledge of software concepts and frameworks: OOP, COM (MFC/ATL), and .NET (WPF/WCF).

4. Familiarity with software tools such as TFS, Subversion, MS SQL, and SQL Server.

5. Knowledge of LabVIEW is preferred.

6. Knowledge of distributed control systems and/or programmable logic controllers is an advantage.

7. Knowledge of microprocessor architecture, peripherals, and related analog/digital circuitry is an advantage.

8. Fast learner, able to work independently within a team.

9. Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and respect deadlines.

10. Customer-focused with good analytical and problem-solving skills.

11. Excellent oral and written communication skills.

title: Market Research & Intelligence Manager - APAC
description:
**About the Role**

The Market Research & Competitive Intelligence Manager will independently lead high-impact qualitative and quantitative market research and competitive intelligence initiatives that inform critical business decisions.

The Market Research & Intelligence (MR&I) team is a strategic thought partner that helps the business make smarter, faster decisions by translating customer, market, competitor, industry, and broader external signals into clear insights, strategic direction, risk awareness, and growth opportunities. The team combines primary market research, competitive and market intelligence, and AI-enabled research capabilities to help Resmed anticipate change, reduce uncertainty, and maintain a competitive advantage in a dynamic global market.

  

**What You’ll do**

As a Market Research & Competitive Intelligence Manager, you will partner with cross-functional leaders to translate business questions into rigorous research and intelligence approaches, synthesize evidence from multiple sources, and shape clear, objective recommendations for different stakeholders and business needs.

The role requires integrating insights across consumers, patients, physicians and other healthcare professionals, payers, customers, competitors, partners, and broader market forces. You will monitor current and emerging developments, connect disparate signals, distinguish meaningful change from market noise, and develop a well-supported point of view on what is changing, why it matters to Resmed, what remains uncertain, and what the business should consider next.

The ideal candidate combines deep market research expertise, strong investigative instincts, strategic business acumen, executive communication skills, and an experimental mindset toward AI and automation. The role will primarily support APAC - with emphasis on China and Japan and secondary support for Australia - while contributing to global MR&I priorities.

**What You'll Bring**

Market Research & Strategic Insights

* Independently lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative market research projects from business-question definition through research design, vendor selection, questionnaire/discussion guide development, fieldwork, analysis, reporting, and executive presentation.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into clear research questions, hypotheses, methodologies, and decision-oriented learning plans in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Integrate perspectives from consumers, patients, physicians and other HCPs, payers, customers, channels, and other stakeholders to uncover behaviors, needs, perceptions, barriers, and opportunities.
Interpret research findings and synthesize them into clear insights, implications, and strategic and tactical recommendations that enable action.  

Market & Competitive Intelligence

* Create and maintain comprehensive industry, competitor, customer, and market analyses, including market share, growth projections, market forces, landscape evolution, and emerging risks and opportunities.
* Proactively monitor and investigate competitor activity and broader external developments across healthcare policy and reimbursement, regulatory change, economics and demographics, technology and AI, consumer behavior, channel evolution, partnerships, and other forces that may materially impact the sleep and respiratory markets.
* Leverage secondary research, financial and company information, industry publications, news, conferences, expert sources, and market intelligence platforms to develop objective, evidence-based analyses.
* Provide situational analysis and intelligence support for quarterly business reviews, new product launches, portfolio and brand initiatives, strategic planning, market and landscape mapping, and ad-hoc executive priorities.
Prepare and/or oversee executive-ready intelligence briefs, presentations, landscape reviews, customized alerts, and other decision-support deliverables.  

AI, Automation & MR&I Innovation

* Leverage generative AI and agentic workflows to automate intelligence gathering, monitoring, synthesis, and knowledge retrieval, while maintaining human validation and source traceability.
Develop and continuously improve AI-enabled intelligence systems, including prompts, watchlists, taxonomies, knowledge bases, and governance practices, in partnership with MR&I and technology teams.  

Strategic Partnership, Communication & Execution

* Act as a trusted thought partner to cross-functional stakeholders, building strong relationships and aligning research and intelligence priorities to business decisions.
Craft and tailor recommendations for different stakeholder needs and levels of leadership, balancing analytical rigor with clear, concise storytelling.  

**Qualifications and Experience Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Market Research, Business, Economics, a related business or technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience; Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of market research, market intelligence, insights, strategy, consulting, or related experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex projects from definition through recommendation.
* Strong business acumen, critical thinking, facilitation, executive communication, and data storytelling skills.
* Ability to build trust quickly, work independently with stakeholders, and operate effectively in a cross-cultural, global environment.
Advanced PowerPoint and Excel capabilities; experience with market intelligence platforms (such as AlphaSense) and survey/research platforms.  

**Preferred Experience**

* Healthcare, medical devices, digital health, or adjacent industry experience.
* Familiarity with the healthcare landscape in China and Japan, with additional understanding of Australia preferred.
* Existing relationships with or experience managing Asian market research and intelligence firms.
* Bilingual Mandarin capability preferred; Japanese language capability is advantageous but not required.

Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now!
