title: Technical Product Manager
description:
We are looking for a **Technical Product Manager** to join our Technology team in India.

In this hands-on role, you will shape the technical direction of our products and SaaS offerings, working closely with functional product owners to lead architecture, design, delivery, deployment, and ongoing support. You will combine strong product ownership with hands-on technical expertise to build scalable enterprise solutions and drive AI-enabled product development.

### **How You’ll Make an Impact -**

* Define and deliver the technology strategy for products and solutions in partnership with functional product owners.
* Own the technical platform and landscape across the full product lifecycle, including deployment, hosting, licensing, SLAs, post-sales support, and continuous enhancement.
* Introduce **AI-first tools, practices, and standards** to translate user stories into actionable sprints and delivery plans.
* Act as the technical product owner and primary technical contact across multiple products and solutions.
* Lead and coordinate a small team of **AI-enabled developers** while remaining actively involved in development.
* Establish effective **QA, DevOps, CI/CD, and engineering practices** across the product portfolio.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and apply relevant innovations to keep products scalable, secure, and competitive.

### **Your Expertise -**

* **7–10 years of digital product experience**, including at least 2 years building digital products and working as a technical product owner.
* Hands-on experience using **agentic AI** for solution design, software development, and unit testing.
* Experience building at least one **product, add-on, accelerator, or framework extending a standard SAP solution**.
* Experience using **SAP BTP/BAIP or another hyperscaler platform** to build and host digital products supporting mission-critical processes.
* Strong delivery experience in at least **two** of the following technology areas:
  + ABAP and OData
  + SAPUI5, Fiori, React, or comparable UX frameworks
  + RAP, CAP, Java, or Node.js
  + SAP HANA Cloud or PostgreSQL
* Strong understanding of **multi-tenant SaaS and on-stack add-on architectures**.
* Solid knowledge of **information security and cybersecurity principles**.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.

### **Nice to Have**

* Previous experience with an enterprise software/product organization.
* Domain knowledge across **SAP ERP, SAP EWM, and/or SAP TM**.
* Understanding of **SAP S/4HANA architecture, indirect licensing, and API access policies**.
* Experience with the **SAP PartnerEdge Build** model.

### **Why Join Westernacher**

* Inspiring, innovative, and entrepreneurial working environment.
* Competitive remuneration package including salary, bonus, and benefits.
* International company culture with minimal hierarchical structure.
* Opportunity to shape and build enterprise products and SaaS solutions with real customer impact.
* Exposure to global teams, technologies, and delivery models.
* Opportunity to drive **AI-first product development** and influence the future technical direction of our solutions.

**This is Westernacher -**

Founded in 1969, Westernacher Consulting is a global business and SAP consulting company represented in 28 countries, with 1,400 consultants across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. As an SAP Gold Partner with over 30 years of experience as an SAP partner, we combine deep industry knowledge, business process expertise and technology innovation to create sustainable value for our clients.

We are 100% employee-owned, which shapes our entrepreneurial culture and our commitment to shared responsibility, long-term thinking and sustainable success. We work in partnership, challenge conventional thinking and give our people the opportunity to create meaningful impact for our clients, our company and one another.

Westernacher is committed to equal opportunity and an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make employment decisions based on qualifications, experience and business needs, in accordance with applicable local law.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa’s Risk and Identity Solutions (RaIS) group delivers advanced fraud detection and prevention solutions, ensuring seamless, secure payment experiences. The Predictive Fraud Intelligence (PFI) team develops core AI/ML products within the Visa Protect suite, empowering clients to detect and prevent fraud throughout the payment lifecycle.

As fraud vectors have rapidly evolved, PFI has significantly expanded its product portfolio and reimagined its approach to building, deploying, and monitoring real-time, low-latency AI models. We seek a seasoned AI product Manager to drive platform capabilities and tooling, accelerating model development and supporting diverse client needs.

Visa is seeking a seasoned Product Manager with a keen interest in heavy tech platforms, deep understanding of ML development lifecycle & MLOps, and a strong passion for innovation. This role is pivotal in enhancing some of the fastest fraud detection models in the world. It is an opportunity to improve the end-to-end process, bring in continuous learning, keeping them up to date to catch the latest fraud trends.

As a product leader, you will collaborate closely with Technology, Data Science, Cross-functional Product, and Regional teams to define priorities, craft solutions, and deliver key product capabilities.

Responsibilities:

* Customer-Centric Product Vision: Understand customer needs and build empathy with technical users like data scientists and data engineers to define and evolve the product roadmap.
* Data Ecosystem Leadership: Develop a deep understanding of the data lifecycle and drive strategic improvements across data sourcing, quality, and governance.
* Model Optimization: Continuously enhance existing AI/ML models to improve fraud detection accuracy and performance.
* GenAI Integration: Leverage generative AI to streamline model development, deployment, and monitoring processes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, data science, and product teams across geographies to deliver scalable, impactful solutions.
* Execution Excellence: Lead the delivery of complex, high-impact initiatives that transform the model development lifecycle and accelerate innovation.
* The successful execution of this role will be achieved through a combination of leadership, technology/AI-ML knowledge, platform thinking, innovation, passion for customers, and applied strategy.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:

* 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD
* 5+ years of professional experience with a bachelor’s degree. 2+ years in product management, focused on platforms and/or data products.
* Strong grasp of Agile methodologies and proven success in fast-paced, iterative environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional AI/ML and data science teams.
* Strategic thinker with sharp analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across global, diverse teams.
* Understanding payments, fraud and authentication landscape and ability to translate product strategy into executable plans.
* Experience in product management in payments, common services, and identity and access management.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams in global, highly matrixed organizations.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Lead Technical Product Owner
description:
We are seeking a senior sustainability professional with 15+ years of commercial-building domain experience to lead customer sustainability transformation through smart building technologies, digital platforms and Agentic AI-enabled operating models. The role acts as a trusted advisor to customers and executive stakeholders, translating energy, carbon, ESG and autonomous optimization concepts into measurable business outcomes, including energy efficiency, decarbonization, operational excellence and net-zero progress.

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Sustainability, Energy Management, Environmental Engineering or a related discipline; master's degree preferred.

* 15+ years of experience in sustainability consulting, energy management, commercial building operations, building automation, smart buildings, facility management or related industries.

* Deep knowledge of Building Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), building automation, IoT architectures and operational technology environments.

* Practical experience in sustainability assessments, energy audits, carbon accounting, building-performance optimization and decarbonization programs.

* Familiarity with LEED, WELL, GRESB, ISO 50001 and related ESG, energy and sustainability frameworks.

* Experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI frameworks, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, OpenAI or comparable AI orchestration platforms.

* Experience developing business cases and roadmaps for AI-enabled sustainability, smart-building transformation or digital operations programs.

* Demonstrated success driving innovation through emerging technologies, analytics, data-driven decisions and scalable operating models.

SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12–18 MONTHS

* Influence multiple strategic customer sustainability programs and establish a qualified pipeline of Agentic AI-enabled building optimization opportunities.

* Deliver measurable outcomes in energy reduction, carbon footprint reduction, asset uptime, faster issue detection/resolution, reduced manual effort and occupant experience.

* Create repeatable AI-enabled sustainability frameworks that can scale across customer portfolios and become a trusted advisor for ESG, energy and digital transformation initiatives.

* Demonstrate business value from autonomous decision-making, predictive optimization and intelligent building operations.

  

Sustainability Strategy & Advisory

* Lead sustainability assessments and strategic roadmaps for commercial buildings, real estate portfolios, campuses and critical infrastructure.

* Advise customers on decarbonization pathways, energy optimization, net-zero programs, ESG reporting and sustainability best practices.

* Identify opportunities to improve building performance, occupant experience, operational resilience and environmental impact.

* Provide solution consulting across discovery, assessment, solution definition, implementation support and value realization.

Agentic AI for Intelligent Building Operations

* Define and scale Agentic AI applications that autonomously monitor, analyze, recommend and optimize commercial-building operations.

* Develop use cases across energy optimization, carbon reduction, predictive maintenance, fault detection, space utilization, comfort control and ESG performance monitoring.

* Collaborate with product, engineering and data-science teams to design agent workflows, multi-agent orchestration patterns, guardrails and human-in-the-loop operating models.

* Translate customer sustainability challenges into AI-enabled solution architectures using digital twins, IoT data, BMS/EMS integration, OT systems, analytics and autonomous decision workflows.

Customer Engagement & Value Communication

* Engage C-level executives, sustainability leaders, facility managers, operations teams and engineering stakeholders as a trusted advisor.

* Develop compelling business cases covering ROI, energy savings, carbon abatement, productivity gains, asset uptime and reduced manual operational effort.

* Facilitate workshops, executive briefings and strategy sessions that align sustainability ambition with practical implementation roadmaps.

* Present recommendations, deployment plans and realized outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Solution Development, Delivery & Measurement

* Partner with sales, product management, engineering, consulting and services teams to create customer-centric sustainability and AI solutions.

* Support solution architecture and implementation planning to ensure proposed capabilities deliver measurable environmental, operational and financial outcomes.

* Define KPIs, baselines and measurement frameworks for energy intensity, carbon emissions, comfort, uptime, issue resolution and adoption.

* Establish repeatable playbooks and frameworks for AI-driven sustainability consulting and autonomous building optimization.

Innovation & Thought Leadership

* Track emerging sustainability regulations, market needs, smart-building technologies, AI/ML innovation, GenAI, Agentic AI frameworks and digital transformation trends.

* Contribute to new offerings, solution accelerators, service models and scalable frameworks for intelligent building operations.

* Represent the organization in industry forums, customer events, executive briefings and sustainability-focused engagements.

* Mentor teams and foster a culture of innovation, customer centricity, responsible AI adoption and continuous improvement.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Senior/Principal Product Analyst - Corporate Functions
description:
**About the Team:**

  

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

CGA & Corporate Secretariat Digital & Tech delivers digital solutions that support Corporate Government Affairs and the Corporate Secretariat. This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

  
  

**Job Purpose:**

  

The Corporate Functions Product Analyst supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with both the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner, helping to shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Corporate Functions Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the products supported.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner & partner with the business to realise product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
* Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
* Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
* Document functional, technical specifications needed to deliver new product, changes and support configuration or code delivery.
* Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
* Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
* Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
* Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
* Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
* Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner to identify and implement AI, automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

  

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Business knowledge in a relevant functional domain & familiarity with associated technology platforms that enable them (e.g., IT, Internal & External Communications, Corporate Secretariat), with the ability to analyse business challenges using structured frameworks, model end-to-end processes (e.g., BPMN), and support delivery through familiarity with Agile practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban).
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g.Agile methodologies)
  

  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.
  

**Skills**

Agile Kanban, Agile Methodology, Business Analysis, Corporate Secretarial Work, Documentations, Product Lifecycle, Product Ownership, Product Strategies, Requirements Gathering, Scrum (Agile), Sprint Planning, Stakeholder Management  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Director Product Management
description:
**About Target:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

**About Team & Role:**

Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.

As a Director of Product Management, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product portfolio and lead the team in delivering measurable business outcomes. You will establish short- and long-term product goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and manage product budgets and financials.

The Director of Product Management based in India is a strategic product leader responsible for accelerating Service Centre product capabilities and AI adoption, strengthening execution rigour, prioritising investments, enabling operational efficiency, and providing leadership across Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams globally and locally.

Further the role will be responsible for

* Driving day-to-day product excellence and velocity of Cross-functional teams

title: Product Manager, WhatsApp - India
description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done - people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live in India since 2020 and growing; the existing WhatsApp payments team moves across as the pillar's foundation.WhatsApp Product Managers work with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, researchers and other partners to build products. We are looking for entrepreneurial Product Managers who combine long-term strategic thinking with urgency, product craft and effective execution.  
  
  

### **Product Manager, WhatsApp - India Responsibilities:**

* Lead a complex product area by defining its vision, strategy, and measures of success, while considering the wider WhatsApp and company context.
* Identify and prioritize the most significant user and product opportunities, adapting the strategy as new evidence and context emerge.
* Translate strategy into a coherent roadmap across multiple workstreams, driving progress against goals and resolving dependencies and blockers.
* Build alignment across adjacent product teams and partner functions, resolving divergent goals and creating shared strategies where needed.
* Use qualitative research, quantitative analysis, and market insight to inform product decisions and influence the broader product organization.
* Communicate the product strategy, trade-offs, and progress with clarity to cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
* Raise the effectiveness of the team and support the growth of other PMs and cross-functional partners through mentorship and coaching.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of relevant industry experience, including at least 3 years in Product Management

* Experience leading cross-functional teams across the full product lifecycle, from defining product vision and requirements through launch, measurement, and iteration
* Experience using user research, experimentation, and large-scale data to identify opportunities, make trade-offs, and drive measurable product outcomes
* Experience integrating diverse user needs, product requirements, and competitive context into a coherent strategy
* Experience influencing across organizational boundaries and aligning senior cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Demonstrated excellence in written and verbal communication, including bringing clarity to complex product decisions
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building products for diverse international audiences and markets

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. title: Cloud & Hosting - Senior Product Owner - Observability
description:
Business Introduction

  

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**

  

The Senior Product Owner, Observability owns the backlog and roadmap for the Observability platform, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Director, Modern Engineering Platform Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.

* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs and measure the outcome with a named metric.

* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.

* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.

* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.

* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.

* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.

* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.

* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.

* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.

* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.

* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

  
  

**Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required**

* 5+ years in technology, years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.

* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.

* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.

* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.

* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.

* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.

* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.

* Hands-on expertise with modern observability tooling such as Grafana and Google Cloud Observability.

* Proven observability expertise across metrics, logs and traces, telemetry pipelines, dashboards and alerting, with accountability for reliability and cost.

* Experience delivering AI-driven or automated operations on observability data (desirable).

* Experience in a pharma, regulated or comparably complex enterprise environment (desirable).

  
  

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.

* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.

* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.

* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.

* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standard ground.

  

**Skills**

AI Observability, API Management, Automation Technology, Backlog Prioritization, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Grafana, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Product Management, Product Ownership, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

description:

* Build scalable systems and experiences, not just one-off features

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years of product management experience
* 2+ years of prior software engineering, Data Science, or Design experience
* Strong product sense with excellent design and UX judgment
* Highly data-driven, with the ability to use metrics, experimentation, and user insights to drive decisions
* Strong technical fluency and ability to work closely with engineering on architecture, tradeoffs, and execution
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong structured thinking and ability to bring clarity to ambiguous, cross-functional problems

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience working on B2B SaaS, marketplace, platform, workflow, onboarding, trust/safety, search, matching, or AI-enabled products

**Ideal candidate profile**

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of:

* Strong product judgment
* Sharp design instinct and high-quality bar
* Deep data-driven decision making
* Technical grounding from prior engineering experience
* Structured business thinking
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
* They should be able to look at a messy problem, identify the highest-leverage opportunity, craft an elegant user experience, back decisions with data, and drive execution end to end.

**Values**

* **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.

title: Assistant Branch Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead branch setup and operational readiness, drive business growth in gold lending, build and manage a high-performing branch team, and ensure strict compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory (RBI) guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branch Recruitment & Team Building:**
* Source, interview, and hire local talent for key branch roles, including Gold Valuers/Appraisers, Customer Service Officers, Relationship Managers, and Security Personnel.
* Coordinate with HR to manage local hiring pipelines, campus/walk-in drives, and employee onboarding.
* Plan branch staffing levels based on business volume and operational requirements.
* Oversee initial product, compliance, and gold-appraisal training for newly onboarded staff.
* **Business Development & Sales:**
* Drive branch sales targets for gold loan disbursements, cross-selling products, and new customer acquisition.
* Execute local marketing activities and maintain relationships with local business communities to generate leads.
* Oversee loan renewal mix and repeat customer retention strategies.
* **Gold Operations & Risk Management:**
* Ensure accurate gold testing, weighing, and purity assessment following standard appraisal protocols.
* Strictly adhere to Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits and regulatory guidelines.
* Supervise safe vault management, dual-custody procedures, and daily packet verification to protect pledged gold assets.
* **Operations & Compliance:**
* Oversee daily branch transactions, cash management, and operational workflows.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms.
* Ensure smooth internal and external audit processes and resolve audit queries promptly.
* **Portfolio & Recovery Management:**
* Track overdue loans and lead recovery efforts for early-stage delinquent accounts (0–30 days past due).
* Coordinate loan closure, redemption processes, and statutory auctions for non-performing accounts per legal guidelines.
* **Team Leadership & Customer Service:**
* Manage, mentor, and retain branch staff, providing regular performance evaluations and coaching.
* Resolve escalated customer grievances and ensure high-quality service delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Hiring & Retention:** Time-to-fill for open branch positions, staff onboarding timeline, and branch attrition rate.
* **Growth:** Total Assets Under Management (AUM) and monthly disbursement volume.
* **Risk & Portfolio:** Non-Performing Assets (NPA) percentage and audit compliance score.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–8 years in banking/NBFC operations, with proven experience in branch management, team hiring, and gold loan processing.
* **Technical Skills:** Interviewing techniques, knowledge of gold appraisal methods, basic accounting, and branch management software.
* **Soft Skills:** Talent acquisition, team leadership, conflict resolution, sales strategy, and local language proficiency.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

Minimum of 5+ years of product management experience with strong focus on building and delivering successful data products, services and capabilities Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required, such as engineering, math, science, economics, etc.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Quality Engineer  
**Project Role Description :** Enables full stack solutions through multi-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Performs continuous testing for security, API, and regression suite. Creates automation strategy, automated scripts and supports data and environment configuration. Participates in code reviews, monitors, and reports defects to support continuous improvement activities for the end-to-end testing process.
  
**Must have skills :** Java Full Stack Development  
**Good to have skills :** Spring Boot  
Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Role Summary  
We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Manager who leads from the trenches — writing production-grade code daily while simultaneously driving team delivery and technical strategy. This is not a purely supervisory role. You will be an active contributor to Java Spring Boot backend services, React frontends, and API development, while managing a team of engineers and owning end-to-end delivery. The ideal candidate is a strong individual contributor who has grown into leadership without stepping away from the keyboard.  
Key Responsibilities  
  
Hands-On Technical Contribution  
Independently design, develop, and ship full stack features using Java Spring Boot (backend) and React (frontend) with minimal direction.  
Architect and build RESTful APIs and microservices from scratch, owning the full lifecycle from design through deployment.  
Write complex Oracle SQL queries, manage schema design, performance tuning, and indexing strategies directly.  
Personally contribute to CI/CD pipeline setup, containerization, and OpenShift deployment — not just review others' work.  
Debug, optimize, and refactor production code to meet performance and scalability standards.  
Actively use and champion AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) as a daily part of your own engineering workflow.  
  
Technical Leadership  
Set architectural direction and make independent technical decisions on system design, API contracts, and data modeling.  
Conduct meaningful code reviews rooted in your own current coding experience, not just managerial instinct.  
Define and enforce engineering standards, security practices, and documentation expectations across the team.  
Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, or patterns based on direct hands-on assessment.  
  
Team Management & Delivery:  
Lead a team of engineers through agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and delivery milestones while remaining a committed coder yourself.  
Mentor and grow junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code walkthroughs, and real-time technical coaching.  
Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions — and then build them yourself.  
Manage delivery risk, technical debt, and cross-team dependencies without delegating your own engineering accountability.  
  
Required Qualifications:  
5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience.  
Currently active and proficient in Java Full Stack Development — you write Spring Boot and React code regularly, not just in the past.  
Deep expertise in RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.  
Strong Oracle Database and SQL skills — query writing, performance tuning, indexing, and data modeling done independently.  
Direct experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, and containerized deployments.  
Comfortable working independently in ambiguous environments with minimal oversight.  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (15 years full-time education preferred).  
  
Preferred Qualifications:  
OpenShift or Kubernetes hands-on deployment experience.  
Experience with API security (OAuth2, JWT) and cloud-native design patterns.  
Prior experience as a senior individual contributor who transitioned into a working management role.

  
15 years full time education

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Overview**

Security is one of the most critical challenges facing organisations today. Threats are becoming more sophisticated, enterprise environments are increasingly diverse, and AI is rapidly changing both how attacks are carried out and how security products are built and operated.

Microsoft Security is looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to help shape the next generation of security experiences across endpoint.

We are looking for a security-first product leader with strong technical depth and experience building enterprise security products. The ideal candidate brings expertise in areas such as endpoint security, Microsoft Intune, device management or mobile security, along with a strong understanding of how AI is transforming security and product development.

This role requires more than traditional product management. We are looking for someone who can use AI to fundamentally improve the PM craft, accelerating customer discovery, research, analysis, product definition and prototyping, while applying strong judgement to turn insights into the right product investments.

 **Responsibilities**

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

* Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap and execution for key endpoint, device and mobile security scenarios.

* Develop a deep understanding of customers, threat trends and emerging security challenges, and translate them into clear product opportunities.

* Partner across engineering, security research, design and product teams to drive clarity, alignment and execution of complex, cross-team security initiatives.

* Define and drive security experiences spanning endpoint protection, detection, investigation and response, device security and mobile protection.

* Identify opportunities to use AI to improve security outcomes, including faster protection, detection, investigation, response and security operations.

* Leverage AI across the product management lifecycle to accelerate customer insights, product analysis, requirements, prototyping and experimentation, enabling faster and higher-quality product decisions.

* Engage directly with enterprise customers, security operations teams and IT administrators to understand unmet needs and validate product direction.

* Make product prioritisation decisions based on security risk, customer impact, product data and business opportunity.

* Define measurable product outcomes and continuously evaluate adoption, effectiveness and customer value.

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Significant product management experience delivering complex enterprise or technical products.
* 8 + Yrs of experience in product management

* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security products or closely related enterprise security technologies.

* Proven experience taking major product capabilities from customer problem and product strategy through engineering execution, launch and adoption.

* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to engage deeply with engineering teams on architecture, design and security trade-offs.

* Strong customer orientation, with demonstrated ability to translate customer and market insights into product strategy and priorities.

* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in complex, cross-functional environments and influence without direct authority.

* Experience working with large enterprise customers and security operations or IT administration personas.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:

* Endpoint Security: Deep understanding of endpoint protection, threat detection, and endpoint detection and response across modern enterprise environments.

* Device & Mobile Security: Experience with Microsoft Intune or equivalent device management and security solutions, including mobile device/application management, device compliance, and Android/iOS security.

* Enterprise & Cross-Platform Security: Experience securing diverse environments across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, with a strong understanding of the needs of large enterprise customers, security operations teams, and IT administrators.

  
  
  

Applied Sciences IC4 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $119,800 - $234,700 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $160,200 - $261,000 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:  
https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay

title: Assistant Brand Manager, Sports, Amazon, Sports GL
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you ready to shape the future of retail by driving brand growth and optimizing customer experiences at scale? As a Retail Vendor Manager at Amazon, you'll serve as a strategic brand manager responsible for delivering measurable business impact through data-driven merchandizing and cross-channel optimization. You'll own critical input metrics that directly influence brand growth, managing everything from traffic channels and promotional strategies to customer experience design across category pages.  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of merchandizing, marketing, and operations. You'll experiment with innovative tactics to increase conversion rates, design compelling store-wide promotions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges. Your analytical insights and stakeholder management skills will drive learning from campaigns, establish best practices, and optimize the customer journey across Sports categories.

Manage multiple traffic channels for select products including site merchandizing, outbound marketing, affiliate marketing, SEO, and search engine marketing initiatives to drive brand visibility and customer engagement  
Design and execute store-wide promotions by collaborating closely with Category Managers and Instock Managers to schedule, implement, and optimize promotional campaigns that enhance customer experience  
Own the customer experience of category pages by experimenting with and optimizing merchandizing assets, designing monthly deployment of category properties, and tracking customer behavior across search, browse, and purchase  
Analyze business performance metrics and conduct research to identify problems and opportunities, engaging cross-functional teams to implement solutions that improve conversion rates and overall business impact  
Deliver consistent results by handling tactical projects, troubleshooting operational challenges, and establishing efficient processes while deriving insights from campaigns to share best practices across the organization

Your day begins with connecting with brand operations and category teams to align on priorities and review business metrics. You'll coordinate with internal program teams to address challenges and ensure seamless execution across initiatives. Throughout the day, you'll analyze customer behavior data, optimize merchandizing assets, and make data-driven decisions to improve brand performance. When opportunities or issues arise, you'll engage directly with brand partners to collaborate on solutions that drive measurable outcomes.  
  
About the team  
You'll join a dynamic team focused on delivering exceptional customer experiences through strategic brand management and innovative merchandizing solutions. Our team values collaboration, analytical rigor, and proactive problem-solving as we work together to optimize the customer journey and drive business growth. We foster an environment where experimentation is encouraged, insights are shared openly, and every team member contributes to establishing best practices that scale across the organization. Qualcomm India Private Limited

**General Summary:**

Job Title: Engineer BTSW-HOST

**Business Justification as to why this hire is required, is this a backfill or additional headcount:**

  

Additional senior engineering capacity is required to execute the architectural transition of the Synergy Bluetooth host stack from APSS to the Q6 low-power domain. The role will strengthen full-stack Bluetooth ownership, accelerate architecture and product problem solving, and enable scalable development across XR and Wearables programs.

**Job Overview - Dept Description and Job Duties:**

  

The Bluetooth Common IP team is seeking a highly analytical and hands-on Senior Engineer to design, develop, port, integrate, and sustain Bluetooth host software across APSS and Q6/LPI environments. The engineer will be a key contributor to the full-stack architecture in which Bluetooth host protocols, profiles, application services, and supporting platform interfaces progressively evolve to meet Days of Use (DOU) targets for our products in XR & Wearables.

  

This is an implementation-focused role for an exceptional developer who can work from Bluetooth specification and system architecture through detailed design, efficient C code, integration, debugging, and productization. The engineer is expected to use AI-assisted engineering responsibly to accelerate understanding, development, reviews, test creation, failure analysis, and documentation while independently validating all outputs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Bluetooth stack development: Develop and maintain Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy, and LE Audio host protocols, profiles, services, and product-specific use cases.

* Platform adaptation: Port or redesign OS, memory, threading, timer, storage, security, IPC, transport, logging, and diagnostic dependencies for a resource-constrained low-power execution environment.

* Architecture and interfaces: Define clean, scalable module boundaries and APIs between the Bluetooth stack, controller transport, audio services, offload framework, OEM applications, Android/APSS services, and Q6 platform components.

* End-to-end ownership: Own features from requirements and feasibility through design, implementation, unit testing, integration, interoperability, performance optimization, issue resolution, and release support.

* Protocol analysis: Translate Bluetooth Core and profile specifications into robust implementations and use protocol-level reasoning to diagnose failures across host, controller, transport, peer device, and application layers.

* Performance and robustness: Optimize memory footprint, compute utilization, latency, concurrency, power behavior, and recovery paths for embedded and low-power targets.

* AI-assisted engineering: Use approved AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate code comprehension, solution exploration, test generation, log triage, documentation, and repetitive development tasks. Apply engineering judgment, security discipline, source review, and thorough validation before adoption.

* Collaboration and technical leadership: Partner with Bluetooth firmware, audio, systems, platform, application, test, product, and customer engineering teams. Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, identify risks early, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly.

  

Qualifications needed

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

* 6+ years of embedded software development experience, with strong hands-on development in C/C++ for wireless connectivity or comparable embedded products.

* Strong working knowledge of Bluetooth architecture, host-controller interactions, and Bluetooth Classic/BLE protocols, with the ability to scale rapidly into unfamiliar protocols, profiles, specifications, and product use cases.

* Excellent C programming, data-structure, concurrency, memory-management, and defensive-programming skills.

* Strong analytical problem-solving ability, including decomposition of ambiguous system issues, hypothesis-driven debugging, trade-off evaluation, and root-cause isolation across software and hardware boundaries.

* Experience with IPC, multithreading, synchronization, transport interfaces, embedded storage, logging, and debugging of distributed or multi-processor systems.

* Ability to read specifications, architecture documents, code, traces, and logs and convert them into clear designs and reliable implementations.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including design documentation, technical presentations, and cross-functional reviews.

Minimum Qualifications:

* At least 3-6 years’ experience in embedded SW development using the C programming language for Wireless connectivity products

* Demonstrated ability to design, port, debug, and optimize complex software on Linux and/or RTOS environments.

* Experience porting a protocol stack to MCU, or RTOS-based low-power execution environments.

* Practical experience using enterprise-approved generative AI or coding assistants, with a strong understanding of validation, confidentiality, licensing, and secure-development expectations.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Hands-on experience with Bluetooth host stack.

* Understanding of Bluetooth controller transports and arbitration, including UART, SPI/I3C or comparable inter-processor/controller interfaces.

* Experience integrating Bluetooth audio and connectivity services, including A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, LE Audio, audio routing, and session control.

* Familiarity with Bluetooth SIG qualification, specification interpretation, interoperability events, and contribution to standards or technical working groups.

* Experience with Bluetooth sniffers, air traces, HCI snoop logs, protocol analyzers, embedded debuggers, crash dumps, and performance/power profiling.

* **Educational Requirements:**

Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics or Computer Science from an internationally recognized institution.

  

**Keywords:** C Programming, Bluetooth host Protocols, Bluetooth Profiles, LE Audio (LEA), BT, Sniffer, Air logs

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1+ year of experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

* 1+ year of experience with Database Management Software.

* 1+ year of experience with API.

* 1+ year of work experience with Git, Perforce, or Source Code Management System.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Applies Software knowledge to assist and support the design, development, creation, modification, and validation of embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs.

* Analyzes user needs and software requirements.

* Designs and implements small software features for products and systems.

* Communicate plans, risks, trade-offs, and technical information clearly to team members and business stakeholders, supporting decisions with evidence and sound engineering judgment.

**What You Will Need**

**Technical Skills**

  

* Strong experience building and shipping embedded Linux and/or Android-based products, with a practical understanding of OS architecture, system startup, resource management, and device lifecycle.

  

* Hands-on expertise with the Yocto Project, including custom layers, recipes, image generation, SDKs, reproducible builds, package management, and distro or machine configuration.

  

* Experience with Android OS or AOSP, including the Android build system, framework services, HALs, permissions, system applications, OTA updates, and platform customization.

  

* Proficiency in modern C/C++ and scripting with Python and shell; familiarity with Java or Kotlin for Android platform and application integration is a plus.

  

* Deep understanding of BSP development, U-Boot or other bootloaders, Linux kernel configuration, device drivers, middleware, and hardware abstraction layers.

  

* Experience with embedded UX technologies such as Android UI, Qt/QML, Wayland/Weston, or comparable frameworks, including performance, responsiveness, and accessibility considerations.

  

* Working knowledge of hardware and connectivity interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, USB, Ethernet, CAN, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and display or input subsystems.

  

* Strong debugging and profiling skills using tools such as GDB, perf, ftrace, kernel logs, logcat, crash dumps, tracing, and system observability tooling.

  

* Experience with CI/CD and engineering tools such as Git, Gerrit, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies.

  

* Understanding of embedded security, secure boot, code signing, key management, vulnerability response, SBOMs, and long-term product maintenance.

  

* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop creative, evidence-based solutions.

  

* Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in Agile, cross-functional, and geographically distributed development environments.

**Leadership Experience**

  

* Talented performance coach who is skilled at providing actionable feedback to team members, setting clear performance objectives, and managing team member performance.

  

* Experience executing a talent and performance-management strategy, including hiring, onboarding, development planning, succession planning, and organizational health.

  

* Demonstrated ability to communicate plans and technical information to team members and stakeholders within a business unit.

  

* Proven ability to deliver programs or other business goals on time, on quality, and within budget while managing scope, risk, dependencies, and trade-offs.

  

* Ability to balance hands-on technical depth with thoughtful delegation, coaching, and long-term team capability building.

**Education & Experience**

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field required; master's degree in a related field preferred.

title: Sr Engineering Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly technical SRE Leader to bridge software engineering and operations. You will lead a high-performing team to design, build, and maintain fault-tolerant, scalable, and highly available distributed systems. You will champion SRE best practices, reduce manual operations (toil) via automation, and partner with product development squads to embed reliability into the software delivery lifecycle

**Experience Level: 15+ yrs**

* Education: Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* Engineering Background: Strong proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on expertise with major cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, or AWS).

* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficiency with Terraform or similar orchestration tools.

* Act as an evangelist for the SRE mindset, driving a proactive rather than reactive operational culture.

* Exceptional incident command, stakeholder management and communication skills.

5. Cross-Functional collaboration

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
**Principal Product Manager – Core Intelligence and Optimization**

**Target in India | L7 Individual Contributor**

**About the Job – Principal Product Manager, Core Intelligence and Optimization**

Target’s stores operate at extraordinary scale and complexity. Every day, millions of signals across inventory, workload, space, team member activity and physical environments create opportunities to make smarter operational decisions.

As a **Principal Product Manager for Core Intelligence and Optimization**, you will help shape how Target turns those signals into intelligence.

You will be a senior product thought leader working across Core Intelligence to identify and solve some of Target’s hardest problems at the intersection of **AI, data science, operational intelligence, recommendation, optimization and automation**.

Your role will extend beyond any single product. You will explore emerging opportunities, frame ambiguous problems, incubate new intelligence capabilities and connect products across the intelligence lifecycle—from understanding operational context through recommendation and optimization.

You will influence Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX and Operations leaders across the enterprise and help shape Target's evolving approach to intelligent Store systems.

**Core Intelligence Optimization Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Shape long-term product thinking for Core Intelligence and identify emerging opportunities across intelligent systems, AI/ML, recommendation, optimization and automation.
* Develop strong product perspectives on how Target can use operational and physical signals to create differentiated Store intelligence.
* Identify complex, cross-cutting problems where intelligence can create meaningful value for guests, team members and Store operations.
* Translate ambiguous opportunities into clear problem spaces, hypotheses and product strategies.
* Help determine where Target should build reusable intelligence capabilities versus domain-specific solutions.

**Discovery, Experimentation & Incubation**

* Lead discovery for emerging intelligence opportunities that span existing product or organizational boundaries.
* Partner deeply with Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX and Operations to explore problems and potential solutions.
* Use simulation, experimentation, prototypes and data to rapidly validate hypotheses.
* Incubate new intelligence capabilities until there is sufficient evidence and clarity to scale.
* Establish measurable feedback loops that connect intelligence and recommendations to operational outcomes.
* Challenge teams to demonstrate value and learning before scaling investment.

**Enterprise Product Leadership**

* Connect intelligence capabilities across products and experiences to create coherent, reusable systems rather than isolated solutions.
* Influence product strategy and investment decisions across multiple Product groups.
* Navigate complex technical, operational and organizational trade-offs.
* Communicate sophisticated intelligence concepts in clear language that enables senior leaders to make decisions.
* Serve as a trusted product thought partner to Product Directors and senior PTUX leaders.

**Elevate Product Craft**

* Raise the quality of product discovery, strategy, experimentation and outcome measurement across Core Intelligence.
* Coach and mentor Product Managers without direct people-management responsibility.
* Introduce product practices appropriate for AI/ML and intelligence products where outputs may be probabilistic and continuously learning.
* Help teams move from feature and solution thinking toward problem, outcome and capability thinking.
* Build reusable frameworks that strengthen product decision-making across the organization.

**About You**

* 4-year college degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree is a plus.
* 8+ years of Product Management experience with significant experience solving highly complex product problems.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior individual contributor across organizational boundaries.
* Experience with AI/ML, data products, recommendation systems, optimization, intelligent platforms or similarly complex technical domains is strongly preferred.
* Exceptional problem framing, systems thinking and product judgment.
* Strong discovery and experimentation mindset.
* Ability to translate emerging technology into meaningful customer and business opportunities.
* Proven ability to influence senior Product, Technology, Data Science and business leaders without direct authority.
* Strong written and verbal storytelling skills.
* Thrives in ambiguity and is energized by problems where the answer has not yet been defined.

title: Product Owner, Workday HELP (Case & Knowledge Management)
company: Revantage Global Services India Private Limited
description:
**The Pitch**
-------------

As Product Owner for Workday HELP, you’ll own how our employees get answers and resolve HR issues: the cases, the knowledge, and the agents that make both smarter. You’ll implement, break things in sandbox, decide what ships, and turn Workday’s newest AI features into something employees actually use. This is a hands-on IC role. You will configure, test, and launch, not manage a backlog from a distance. And the exciting part: you will continue your consulting journey as we roll the implementation to our portfolio companies across the globe. Also, Workday is shipping AI faster than most teams can evaluate it. We want someone who gets excited about that, not overwhelmed by it.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Own and implement Workday HELP**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of Case Management: case categories, case types, routing, SLAs, escalation paths, security, and integrations
* Build and run Knowledge Management: article structure, authoring and approval workflows, audience targeting, and content lifecycle
* Own the HELP product roadmap, backlog, and release readiness, including triaging each Workday bi-annual release for what matters to us

**Experiment with what’s next**

* Evaluate and pilot new Workday AI capabilities as they arrive, including Illuminate and self-service agents
* Run structured experiments: define the hypothesis, configure in sandbox, test with real scenarios, and measure results
* Make clear, evidence-backed recommendations on what to adopt, defer, or skip
* Help shape our agent-led self-service approach, from deflection to guided resolution

**Make it measurable**

* Define the metrics for HR service delivery: case volume, resolution time, deflection, knowledge usage, and employee satisfaction
* Build case analytics and dashboards that show leaders what is working and where to act next

**Work across the Workday ecosystem**

* Partner with Core HCM, Talent, Recruiting, and Payroll teams so HELP works smoothly with the rest of the platform
* Work with People Operations, HR Centers of Excellence, and IT on process design, content ownership, and change management
* Coordinate with Workday and implementation partners on features, defects, and early-adopter programs

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Must-haves**

* **Hands-on Workday HELP implementation experience.** This is non-negotiable. You have taken Case Management and/or Knowledge Management from design to go-live
* **Strong Core HCM background.** You understand worker data, business processes, security, organizations, and how HELP depends on all of it
* Experience as a product owner, functional lead, or senior consultant who owns configuration, not just requirements
* Ability to translate HR service needs into clear user stories, configuration designs, and test plans
* Strong stakeholder communication across HR, IT, and business teams

**Strong plus**

* Experience implementing or piloting Workday self-service agents or Illuminate AI features
* Case management analytics experience (Workday reporting, people analytics, or dashboards on case data)

**What makes you a top candidate**

* Experience in **Peakon, Learning, or Journeys**. We want someone who sees how HELP connects to the wider employee experience, such as a Journey that triggers a case or Peakon feedback that reshapes knowledge content
* Workday certifications in HCM or related modules
* Prior experience in a shared services or global HR environment

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**
-----------------------------

* Treat every new Workday release like a gift basket and open it immediately
* Are comfortable saying “that didn’t work, here’s why, here’s what we do instead”
* Prefer building and testing over writing 40-page decks
* Care about the employee on the other end of the case, not just the configuration
* Can make a judgment call with 80% of the information

**Why This Role**
-----------------

* To bring HELP to life, hands on.
* Early access to evaluating Workday’s AI roadmap, with real influence on what we adopt
* A role built around experimentation, not maintenance
* Visible impact: every employee touches HELP
* Opportunity to grow into broader People Technology and AI-in-HR leadership as our platform scope expands
